title: HRMS 360
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<title>LIFE HRMS 360° · Human Resource Command Centre</title>
<style>
:root{
  --green:#0B5D3B; --green-d:#06331F; --green-dd:#042418; --green-l:#12764C; --green-x:#2FA46F;
  --teal:#0E7C6B; --teal-l:#14A08B;
  --gold:#B8901F; --gold-l:#D9B54A; --gold-bg:#FBF3DC; --gold-br:#EAD9A6;
  --mint:#E9F5ED; --mint-2:#D7ECE0; --mint-3:#BFDFCE;
  --ink:#12211A; --ink-2:#3C5347; --ink-3:#6A7C72; --ink-4:#95A39B;
  --cream:#FAF7EF; --cream-2:#F4EFE2; --card:#FFFFFF;
  --line:#E7E2D5; --line-2:#D8D2C2; --line-g:#DCE8E1;
  --ok:#17794E; --ok-bg:#E6F4EC; --ok-br:#BEE1CD;
  --warn:#9A6B05; --warn-bg:#FBF1DA; --warn-br:#EBD8A6;
  --crit:#9E2C22; --crit-bg:#FAE9E6; --crit-br:#EEC5BE;
  --info:#1E4E86; --info-bg:#E9F0F9; --info-br:#C6D8EE;
  --sp:#5F3C93; --sp-bg:#F0EAFA; --sp-br:#D9CBF0;
  --r:10px; --r-s:7px; --r-xs:5px;
  --sh:0 1px 2px rgba(18,33,26,.05),0 2px 6px rgba(18,33,26,.05);
  --sh-2:0 4px 16px rgba(18,33,26,.10);
  --sh-3:0 18px 48px rgba(6,35,22,.28);
  --sans:"Segoe UI",Inter,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --serif:"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --mono:"SF Mono",ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono",Consolas,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;max-width:100%}
body{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13.8px;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:1px}
.tnum{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.mono{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.8px;letter-spacing:-.2px}
.ser{font-family:var(--serif)}
hr,.sep{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);width:100%;max-width:100%;margin:12px 0}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

/* ============ LOCK SCREEN ============ */
#lock{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:900;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px;
  background:radial-gradient(1200px 700px at 20% 10%,#0E6B44 0%,#06331F 45%,#031B12 100%);overflow-y:auto}
#lock.off{display:none}
.lockcard{width:100%;max-width:430px;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh-3);overflow:hidden;animation:pop .25s ease}
.lockcard .lh{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B 60%,#0E6B44);color:#fff;padding:22px 24px 18px;text-align:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.lockcard .lh::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-40px;top:-40px;width:140px;height:140px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.lockcard .lh .lg{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:9px;padding:6px 13px;margin-bottom:12px}
.lockcard .lh .lg i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#F2D98A,#B8901F);display:block}
.lockcard .lh .lg b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.18em}
.lockcard .lh h1{margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em}
.lockcard .lh p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9FCDB4}
.lockcard .lb{padding:20px 24px 22px}
.lockrow{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}
#pass{width:100%;padding:13px 44px 13px 14px;border:2px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:10px;font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-align:center;background:#FCFAF4}
#pass:focus{border-color:var(--green);background:#fff;outline:none}
.eye{position:absolute;right:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);cursor:pointer;font-size:16px;opacity:.55}
.eye:hover{opacity:1}
.keypad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;margin:12px 0}
.keypad button{padding:11px 0;border:1px solid var(--line-2);background:#fff;border-radius:9px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--sh);font-family:var(--mono)}
.keypad button:hover{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--mint-3)}
.keypad button.act{background:var(--cream-2);font-size:12px;font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:700}
.lockmsg{min-height:20px;font-size:12.3px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px}
.lockmsg.err{color:var(--crit)} .lockmsg.ok{color:var(--ok)}
.hintbox{margin-top:14px;border:1px dashed var(--gold-br);background:var(--gold-bg);border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:11.8px;color:#6E5407}
.hintbox b{display:block;margin-bottom:4px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hintbox table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:5px}
.hintbox td{padding:3px 0;font-size:11.6px;vertical-align:top}
.hintbox code{font-family:var(--mono);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gold-br);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:11.4px;cursor:pointer}
.dots{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.dots i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--line-2);display:block;transition:.15s}
.dots i.f{background:var(--green);transform:scale(1.15)}

/* ============ MASTHEAD ============ */
.mast{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#06331F 0%,#0B5D3B 46%,#0E6B44 100%);
  color:#EAF4EE;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:0 16px;height:60px;
  box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.09) inset,0 3px 14px rgba(6,35,22,.28)}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
  border-radius:9px;padding:6px 11px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.logo b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#fff;line-height:1}
.logo i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#F2D98A,#B8901F);
  box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.6);display:block}
.mast .home{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:#EAF4EE;font-weight:600}
.mast .home:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.mast .ttl{flex:1;text-align:center;min-width:0}
.mast .ttl b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#fff;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15}
.mast .ttl span{display:block;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.34em;color:#9FCDB4;margin-top:3px;text-transform:uppercase}
.mast .user{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);
  border-radius:22px;padding:5px 14px 5px 5px;cursor:pointer}
.mast .user:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.mast .user .av{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#2FA46F,#0B5D3B);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35),0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
.mast .user b{display:block;font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;line-height:1.2}
.mast .user span{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#9FCDB4;text-transform:uppercase}
.mast .gsrch{position:relative;width:290px}
.mast .gsrch input{width:100%;padding:7px 11px 7px 30px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#EAF4EE;font-size:12.6px}
.mast .gsrch input::placeholder{color:#8FBBA4}
.mast .gsrch .mg{position:absolute;left:9px;top:6px;font-size:13px;opacity:.7}
.sdrop{position:absolute;top:38px;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:var(--sh-3);z-index:200;max-height:340px;overflow-y:auto;display:none;color:var(--ink)}
.sdrop.on{display:block}
.sdrop .it{padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-g);cursor:pointer;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center}
.sdrop .it:hover{background:var(--mint)}
.sdrop .it b{font-size:12.8px}.sdrop .it span{font-size:11.2px;color:var(--ink-3);display:block}
@media(max-width:1100px){.mast .gsrch{display:none}}
@media(max-width:900px){.mast .ttl,.mast .user span{display:none}.mast{height:54px}}

/* ============ 3D ICON CHIPS ============ */
.ic{width:26px;height:26px;flex:0 0 26px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:12.5px;
  color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#2FA46F,#0B5D3B);
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.42),inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.22),0 2px 5px rgba(6,35,22,.3);
  font-style:normal;line-height:1}
.ic.gold{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#E8C868,#A87C12)}
.ic.teal{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#28BFA9,#0B6155)}
.ic.blue{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#5A93D6,#1B4278)}
.ic.plum{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#9A78D1,#4A2C7C)}
.ic.rose{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#DE7A6C,#8A2419)}
.ic.amber{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#F0BC5E,#96650A)}
.ic.slate{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#8FA79A,#3C5347)}
.ic.lg{width:34px;height:34px;flex:0 0 34px;border-radius:10px;font-size:16px}
.ic.sm{width:20px;height:20px;flex:0 0 20px;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px}

/* ============ SHELL ============ */
.app{display:flex;min-height:calc(100vh - 60px);max-width:100%}
.side{width:244px;flex:0 0 244px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#06331F,#042418);color:#CFE3D8;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:sticky;top:60px;height:calc(100vh - 60px)}
.side-h{padding:13px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.side-h b{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;color:#8FBBA4;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800}
.side-s{padding:10px 14px 6px;display:flex;gap:6px}
.side-s button{flex:1;padding:5px 0;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);
  color:#CFE3D8;font-size:10.6px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.06em}
.side-s button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
.nav{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:4px 8px 16px}
.nav::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px}.nav::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:6px}
.ngrp{margin-bottom:3px}
.ghead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 8px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}
.ghead:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.ghead b{flex:1;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:750;color:#DCEBE3}
.ghead .n{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);color:#CFE3D8;border-radius:6px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;padding:1px 6px}
.ghead .cv{font-size:9px;color:#7FA894;transition:transform .18s}
.ngrp.open .ghead{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.ngrp.open .ghead .cv{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.gitems{display:none;padding:3px 0 6px 20px;position:relative}
.ngrp.open .gitems{display:block}
.gitems::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:9px;top:2px;bottom:8px;width:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.nav a{display:block;position:relative;padding:6px 9px 6px 14px;border-radius:7px;color:#B9D2C6;cursor:pointer;
  text-decoration:none;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.35}
.nav a::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-15px;top:12px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;
  background:#0B5D3B;border:1.5px solid #58816C}
.nav a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#fff}
.nav a.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);color:#fff;font-weight:650}
.nav a.on::before{background:var(--gold-l);border-color:#F2D98A;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(217,181,74,.18)}
.nav a span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:#7FA894;font-weight:400;margin-top:1px}
.nav a.on span{color:#A9CDBA}
.nav a .pill{position:absolute;right:8px;top:7px;background:var(--gold-l);color:#3A2B03;border-radius:9px;
  padding:0 6px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;line-height:16px}
.nav a .pill.r{background:#E8A79E;color:#5E1610}
.side-f{padding:9px 14px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);font-size:10px;color:#6E9686;line-height:1.5}
.side-f b{color:#9FCDB4}

.main{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.fbar{position:sticky;top:60px;z-index:60;background:var(--cream-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.fbar .lb{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-3);font-weight:800;margin-right:2px}
.fchip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:7px;
  padding:5px 11px;font-size:12.3px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.fchip:hover{border-color:var(--gold);background:var(--gold-bg)}
.fchip.on{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--mint-3);color:var(--green)}
.fchip.gold{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-br);color:#7A5F09}
.fchip select{border:0;background:transparent;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.wrap{padding:16px;width:100%;max-width:1660px}
.view{display:none}
.view.on{display:block;animation:fade .18s ease}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ============ PAGE HEADER ============ */
.ph{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--green);border-radius:var(--r);
  padding:14px 17px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.ph h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:25px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.12}
.ph p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:12.8px;color:var(--ink-3);max-width:880px}
.ph .kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.19em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:3px}
.ph .sp{flex:1}
.back{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--green);cursor:pointer;font-weight:650;margin-bottom:9px}
.back:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumb{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-3);margin-bottom:8px}
.crumb b{color:var(--ink-2)}

/* ============ ACCORDION (expand / collapse everywhere) ============ */
.acc{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);margin-bottom:11px;overflow:hidden;max-width:100%}
.acc>.ah{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFDF8,#FAF7EF);border-left:3px solid var(--green)}
.acc>.ah:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFDF8,#F3EFE1)}
.acc>.ah h3{margin:0;font-size:14.3px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--serif)}
.acc>.ah .sub{font-size:11.6px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.acc>.ah .sp{flex:1}
.acc>.ah .cv{font-size:10px;color:var(--ink-3);transition:transform .18s;margin-left:2px}
.acc.open>.ah .cv{transform:rotate(90deg)}
.acc>.ab{display:none;padding:13px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.acc.open>.ab{display:block;animation:fade .16s ease}
.acc>.ab.flush{padding:0}
.acc.a-gold>.ah{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FDF8E9,#FBF3DC)}
.acc.a-crit>.ah{border-left-color:var(--crit);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FDF1EF,#FAE9E6)}
.acc.a-warn>.ah{border-left-color:#C98A0B;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FDF7E8,#FBF1DA)}
.acc.a-info>.ah{border-left-color:var(--info);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F1F6FC,#E9F0F9)}
.acc.a-teal>.ah{border-left-color:var(--teal);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EFFAF8,#E4F5F1)}
.acc.a-sp>.ah{border-left-color:var(--sp);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F6F1FD,#F0EAFA)}
.acc.a-dark>.ah{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:linear-gradient(120deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B)}
.acc.a-dark>.ah h3{color:#fff}.acc.a-dark>.ah .sub{color:#A9CDBA}.acc.a-dark>.ah .cv{color:#9FCDB4}
.accbar{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mini{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);
  background:#fff;font-size:11.4px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.mini:hover{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--mint-3)}

/* ============ CARDS / GRID ============ */
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);margin-bottom:14px;overflow:hidden;max-width:100%}
.card>header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFDF8,#FAF7EF)}
.card>header h3{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;font-family:var(--serif)}
.card>header .sub{font-size:11.8px;color:var(--ink-3);font-weight:400}
.card>header .sp{flex:1}
.card>.body{padding:14px}
.card>.body.flush{padding:0}
.card.acc2{border-left:4px solid var(--green)}
.card.acc2>header{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B)}
.card.acc2>header h3{color:#fff}.card.acc2>header .sub{color:#A9CDBA}
.grid{display:grid;gap:12px;max-width:100%}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g6{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}
.g-21{grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr}
.g-12{grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr}
@media(max-width:1400px){.g6{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:1240px){.g6,.g5{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.g-21,.g-12{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
#menub{display:none}
@media(max-width:880px){.side{display:none}#menub{display:inline-flex}
 .side.show{display:flex;position:fixed;top:60px;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:120;width:250px;box-shadow:var(--sh-3)}
 .g2,.g3,.g4,.g5,.g6{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ============ TILES ============ */
.tile{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:3px solid var(--green);border-radius:var(--r-s);
  padding:13px 14px 14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);cursor:pointer;transition:transform .13s,box-shadow .13s;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--sh-2)}
.tile .v{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:27px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.05;color:var(--green)}
.tile .k{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:750;margin-top:6px}
.tile .d{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink-3);margin-top:3px}
.tile.t-gold{border-left-color:var(--gold)} .tile.t-gold .v{color:var(--gold)}
.tile.t-crit{border-left-color:var(--crit)} .tile.t-crit .v{color:var(--crit)}
.tile.t-warn{border-left-color:#C98A0B} .tile.t-warn .v{color:var(--warn)}
.tile.t-ok{border-left-color:var(--ok)} .tile.t-ok .v{color:var(--ok)}
.tile.t-info{border-left-color:var(--info)} .tile.t-info .v{color:var(--info)}
.tile.t-teal{border-left-color:var(--teal)} .tile.t-teal .v{color:var(--teal)}
.tile.t-sp{border-left-color:var(--sp)} .tile.t-sp .v{color:var(--sp)}
.bigval{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B 60%,#0E6B44);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:14px 16px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.14),var(--sh-2);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.bigval::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-30px;width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.bigval .v{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:31px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.08}
.bigval .k{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#A9CDBA;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px}
.bigval .d{font-size:11.8px;color:#CFE3D8;margin-top:4px}

/* ============ BADGES / BUTTONS ============ */
.tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:1px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10.8px;font-weight:750;line-height:19px;white-space:nowrap;border:1px solid transparent}
.t-g{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok-br)}
.t-y{background:var(--warn-bg);color:var(--warn);border-color:var(--warn-br)}
.t-r{background:var(--crit-bg);color:var(--crit);border-color:var(--crit-br)}
.t-b{background:var(--info-bg);color:var(--info);border-color:var(--info-br)}
.t-p{background:var(--sp-bg);color:var(--sp);border-color:var(--sp-br)}
.t-n{background:#F1EFE7;color:var(--ink-2);border-color:var(--line-2)}
.t-m{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green);border-color:var(--mint-3)}
.t-au{background:var(--gold-bg);color:#7A5F09;border-color:var(--gold-br)}
.dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor;display:inline-block}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r-xs);cursor:pointer;font-size:12.4px;font-weight:650;transition:.12s;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--cream);border-color:var(--ink-4)}
.btn.p{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#12764C,#0B5D3B);border-color:#0B5D3B;color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18),var(--sh)}
.btn.p:hover{filter:brightness(1.09)}
.btn.g{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#D9B54A,#B8901F);border-color:#A87C12;color:#3A2B03}
.btn.s{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#14A08B,#0B6155);border-color:#0B6155;color:#fff}
.btn.d{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#B8443A,#9E2C22);border-color:#9E2C22;color:#fff}
.btn.sm{padding:3px 9px;font-size:11.4px}
.btn.lg{padding:10px 20px;font-size:14px}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.btnrow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}

/* ============ TABLES ============ */
.tw{width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto}
table.tb{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.2px}
table.tb th{background:#F6F2E6;color:var(--ink-2);font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:800;text-align:left;padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);white-space:nowrap}
table.tb td{padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-g);vertical-align:middle}
table.tb tbody tr:hover{background:var(--mint)}
table.tb tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:#FCFAF4}
table.tb tbody tr:nth-child(even):hover{background:var(--mint)}
table.tb td.r,table.tb th.r{text-align:right}
table.tb td.c,table.tb th.c{text-align:center}
table.tb tr.click{cursor:pointer}
table.tb tfoot td{background:var(--cream-2);font-weight:800;border-top:2px solid var(--line-2);padding:10px 12px}
.tb .nm{font-weight:650}
.tb .sm2{font-size:11.3px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.tb .big{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.pos{color:var(--ok);font-weight:700}.neg{color:var(--crit);font-weight:700}
.amber{color:var(--warn);font-weight:700}.blu{color:var(--info);font-weight:700}
.empty{padding:34px 16px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-3)}
.empty b{display:block;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink-2);margin-bottom:4px;font-family:var(--serif)}

/* ============ FORMS ============ */
.filters{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFDF8,#F6F2E6);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:13px;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-end}
.fl{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:140px}
.fl label{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.11em;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:800}
.fl input,.fl select,.fl textarea{padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r-xs);background:#fff;width:100%}
.fl input:focus,.fl select:focus{border-color:var(--teal)}
.fg{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;margin-bottom:11px}
.fg label{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink-2)}
.fg label .rq{color:var(--crit)}
.fg input,.fg select,.fg textarea{padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r-xs);background:#fff;width:100%}
.fg input.bad,.fg select.bad{border-color:var(--crit);background:#FEF7F6}
.fg .hint{font-size:10.8px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.sec{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:16px 0 10px}
.sec b{font-size:15.5px;font-weight:650;font-family:var(--serif)}
.sec span{font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3)}
.sec i{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--line);display:block;max-width:100%}

/* ============ BLOCKS ============ */
.note{border-radius:var(--r-s);padding:11px 13px;font-size:12.6px;border:1px solid;line-height:1.55}
.note b{display:block;margin-bottom:2px;font-size:12.9px}
.n-i{background:var(--info-bg);border-color:var(--info-br);color:#173C68}
.n-w{background:var(--warn-bg);border-color:var(--warn-br);color:#6E4C05}
.n-c{background:var(--crit-bg);border-color:var(--crit-br);color:#7A211A}
.n-g{background:var(--ok-bg);border-color:var(--ok-br);color:#0F5636}
.n-m{background:var(--mint);border-color:var(--mint-3);color:var(--green)}
.n-p{background:var(--sp-bg);border-color:var(--sp-br);color:#452B6B}
.n-a{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-br);color:#6E5407}
.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:12.8px}
.kv:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.kv span{color:var(--ink-3)}
.kv b{font-weight:700;text-align:right}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tabs a{padding:7px 13px;font-size:12.8px;font-weight:650;color:var(--ink-3);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-1px}
.tabs a:hover{color:var(--green)}
.tabs a.on{color:var(--green);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 11px;border-radius:20px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:650}
.chip:hover{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-br)}
.chip.on{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#12764C,#0B5D3B);color:#fff;border-color:#0B5D3B}
.bar{height:7px;background:var(--cream-2);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;max-width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#12764C,#2FA46F);border-radius:20px}
.bar i.w{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#C98A0B,#E5B441)} .bar i.c{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9E2C22,#C4574A)}
.bar i.t{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0B6155,#14A08B)} .bar i.gd{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#B8901F,#E2C25F)}
.hbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px 0}
.hbar .lb{width:150px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-2);flex:0 0 150px}
.hbar .tr{flex:1}
.hbar .vl{width:82px;text-align:right;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px}
.tline{position:relative;padding-left:20px}
.tline .ev{position:relative;padding:0 0 13px 0;font-size:12.6px}
.tline .ev::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-15px;top:5px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--mint-3)}
.tline .ev.gd::before{background:var(--gold)}.tline .ev.rd::before{background:var(--crit)}.tline .ev.bl::before{background:var(--info)}
.tline::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1px;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:1px;background:var(--line-2)}
.stepbar{display:flex;gap:0;margin-bottom:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stepbar div{flex:1;min-width:118px;padding:9px 11px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-right:0;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink-3);font-weight:650;cursor:pointer}
.stepbar div:last-child{border-right:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0 var(--r-xs) var(--r-xs) 0}
.stepbar div:first-child{border-radius:var(--r-xs) 0 0 var(--r-xs)}
.stepbar div.on{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#12764C,#0B5D3B);color:#fff;border-color:#0B5D3B}
.stepbar div.dn{background:var(--mint);color:var(--green);border-color:var(--mint-3)}
.stepbar div b{display:block;font-size:9.8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;opacity:.85;font-weight:800}

/* ============ AVATARS & CONTACT ROWS ============ */
.av2{width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-weight:800;
  font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.02em;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.3),0 2px 5px rgba(6,35,22,.22);position:relative}
.av2.lg{width:76px;height:76px;flex:0 0 76px;border-radius:16px;font-size:26px;font-family:var(--serif)}
.av2.sm{width:28px;height:28px;flex:0 0 28px;border-radius:8px;font-size:10.5px}
.av2 .st{position:absolute;right:-3px;bottom:-3px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;background:var(--ok)}
.av2 .st.i{background:var(--ink-4)} .av2 .st.n{background:var(--warn)} .av2 .st.x{background:var(--crit)}
.crow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-g);background:#fff}
.crow:nth-child(even){background:#FCFAF4}
.crow:hover{background:var(--mint)}
.crow .who{flex:0 0 216px;min-width:0}
.crow .who b{display:block;font-size:13.2px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.crow .who span{display:block;font-size:11.2px;color:var(--ink-3);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.crow .cc{flex:1;min-width:0}
.crow .cc .lb{font-size:9.4px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-4);font-weight:800}
.crow .cc .vv{font-size:12.6px;font-weight:650;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.crow .cc .vv.mono2{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.2px;letter-spacing:-.1px}
.crow .act{flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;gap:5px}
.cpy{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--line-2);background:#fff;border-radius:5px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700}
.cpy:hover{background:var(--gold-bg);border-color:var(--gold-br)}
@media(max-width:1200px){.crow{flex-wrap:wrap}.crow .who{flex:0 0 100%}.crow .cc{flex:1 1 150px}}
.chdr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:7px 12px;background:#F6F2E6;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);
  font-size:9.6px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-2);font-weight:800}
.chdr .who{flex:0 0 216px}.chdr .cc{flex:1}.chdr .act{flex:0 0 74px;text-align:right}
@media(max-width:1200px){.chdr{display:none}}

/* ============ PROFILE ============ */
.psum{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B 62%,#0E6B44);
  color:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px 18px;box-shadow:var(--sh-2);margin-bottom:13px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.psum::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-50px;top:-50px;width:190px;height:190px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045)}
.psum .nm{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1}
.psum .dg{font-size:12.8px;color:#CFE3D8;margin-top:3px}
.psum .mt{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:9px}
.psum .mt span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:20px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:11.3px}
.psum .qs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(78px,1fr));gap:8px;min-width:330px}
.psum .qs div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;text-align:center}
.psum .qs b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px}
.psum .qs span{font-size:9.4px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#A9CDBA}
@media(max-width:900px){.psum .qs{min-width:100%;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.dgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(228px,1fr));gap:9px}
.df{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-s);padding:8px 11px;background:#FCFAF4}
.df .l{font-size:9.6px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink-4);font-weight:800}
.df .v{font-size:13.2px;font-weight:650;margin-top:2px;word-break:break-word}
.docg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(168px,1fr));gap:8px}
.doc{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-s);padding:9px 11px;background:#fff;display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center}
.doc.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);border-color:var(--ok-br)}
.doc.pend{background:var(--crit-bg);border-color:var(--crit-br)}
.doc.na{background:#F4F2EC;border-color:var(--line-2);opacity:.75}
.doc b{font-size:12.2px;display:block}.doc span{font-size:10.6px;color:var(--ink-3)}

/* ============ CIRCULAR PREVIEW ============ */
.circ{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--sh-2)}
.circ .ch{background:linear-gradient(125deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B 60%,#0E6B44);color:#fff;padding:18px 20px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.circ .ch .lg{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.2em}
.circ .ch .sub{font-size:9.6px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9FCDB4;margin-top:3px}
.circ .ch h2{margin:12px 0 0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:25px;font-weight:600}
.circ .ch .pos{color:#F2D98A;font-size:13px;margin-top:5px;font-weight:700}
.circ .cb{padding:18px 20px}
.circ h4{margin:14px 0 6px;font-size:12.6px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);font-weight:800;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:4px}
.circ ul{margin:5px 0;padding-left:19px;font-size:12.7px}
.circ li{margin-bottom:3px}
.circ .cf{background:var(--mint);border-top:1px solid var(--mint-3);padding:13px 20px;font-size:12.3px;text-align:center}
.applyb{display:inline-block;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#D9B54A,#B8901F);color:#3A2B03;font-weight:800;
  padding:9px 22px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:8px;font-size:13.5px;box-shadow:var(--sh-2)}

/* ============ MODAL / TOAST ============ */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(6,35,22,.55);display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;z-index:200;padding:28px 16px;overflow-y:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.ov.on{display:flex}
.modal{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh-3);width:100%;max-width:900px;overflow:hidden;animation:pop .17s ease}
.modal.wide{max-width:1240px}
.modal.narrow{max-width:560px}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.985) translateY(7px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.modal>header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:14px 18px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#06331F,#0B5D3B);color:#fff}
.modal>header h3{margin:0;font-size:16.5px;font-weight:600;font-family:var(--serif)}
.modal>header .sub{font-size:11.5px;color:#A9CDBA}
.modal>header .sp{flex:1}
.modal>header .x{cursor:pointer;font-size:21px;line-height:1;opacity:.85;padding:0 4px}
.modal>header .x:hover{opacity:1}
.modal>.body{padding:17px;max-height:calc(100vh - 200px);overflow-y:auto}
.modal>footer{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:flex-end;padding:12px 18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--cream);flex-wrap:wrap}
#toast{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:400;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.tst{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#12211A,#06331F);color:#fff;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12.8px;box-shadow:var(--sh-3);animation:sl .18s ease;max-width:350px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold)}
.tst.ok{border-left-color:#2FA46F} .tst.err{border-left-color:#C4574A} .tst.wn{border-left-color:#E5B441}
@keyframes sl{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media print{.side,.mast,.fbar,.btnrow,.filters,.accbar,#toast,.back,.biobar,.tabs,.bulkbar{display:none!important}
  .wrap{padding:0;max-width:100%}.acc>.ab{display:block!important}.acc>.ah .cv{display:none}
  .card,.acc{box-shadow:none;break-inside:avoid}@page{size:A4;margin:12mm}}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   UPGRADE PACK v2 — biometric bar · photos · staff controls · BGV ·
   letters · documents · permissions · self-service · audit
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

/* ---------- biometric live status bar (thin) ---------- */
.biobar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#06331F,#042418);
  color:#CFE6DA;border-bottom:1px solid #0B5D3B;padding:0 10px;height:26px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;
  font-size:11px;position:sticky;top:52px;z-index:60;scrollbar-width:thin}
.biobar.on{display:flex}
.biobar .bl{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 9px 0 2px;margin-right:4px;
  font-size:9.6px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800;color:#8FBFA5;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);height:16px}
.biobar .bl i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:1px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#F2D98A,#B8901F)}
.bdot{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:1px 7px;margin:0 1px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;
  font-weight:750;font-size:10.6px;letter-spacing:.02em;color:#DDEEE4;border:1px solid transparent;line-height:18px}
.bdot:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.bdot i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.bdot i.g{background:#3FD98A;box-shadow:0 0 5px #3FD98A,0 0 0 2px rgba(63,217,138,.16)}
.bdot i.r{background:#FF6A5A;box-shadow:0 0 5px #FF6A5A,0 0 0 2px rgba(255,106,90,.16)}
.bdot i.a{background:#F5B93B;box-shadow:0 0 5px #F5B93B,0 0 0 2px rgba(245,185,59,.16);animation:bpul 1.1s infinite}
@keyframes bpul{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
.biobar .bsum{margin-left:auto;display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding-left:10px;font-size:10.2px;color:#8FBFA5}
.biobar .bsum b{color:#EAF6EF}
.biobar .bx{cursor:pointer;padding:0 6px;color:#8FBFA5;font-weight:800}
.biobar .bx:hover{color:#fff}

/* ---------- photos ---------- */
.av2 img,.pav img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:inherit}
.av2.ph{background:#DDE7E1!important}
.pav{width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;flex:none;
  border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:var(--sh-2);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#0E7C6B,#0B5D3B);
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;font-weight:600}
.pav.sm{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:10px;font-size:19px}
.phbox{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.phdrop{flex:1;min-width:240px;border:2px dashed var(--line-2);border-radius:var(--r);background:var(--cream);
  padding:16px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;transition:.14s}
.phdrop:hover,.phdrop.dragover{border-color:var(--teal);background:var(--mint)}

function openModal(title,sub,body,foot,cls){
  var overlay=document.getElementById('ov');
  var modalBox=document.getElementById('modal');
  var titleBox=document.getElementById('m-title');
  var subtitleBox=document.getElementById('m-sub');
  var bodyBox=document.getElementById('m-body');
  var footerBox=document.getElementById('m-foot');

  if(!overlay||!modalBox||!titleBox||!bodyBox||!footerBox){
    console.error('[LIFE HRMS] Modal elements are missing');
    return;
  }

  titleBox.innerHTML=title||'Details';

  if(subtitleBox){
    subtitleBox.innerHTML=sub||'';
  }

  bodyBox.innerHTML=body||(
    '<div class="note n-m">No records</div>'
  );

  footerBox.innerHTML=foot||(
    '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>'
  );

  modalBox.className='modal '+(cls||'');
  modalBox.style.display='block';
  modalBox.style.visibility='visible';
  modalBox.style.opacity='1';

  overlay.classList.add('on');
  overlay.style.display='flex';
  overlay.style.visibility='visible';
  overlay.style.opacity='1';

  document.body.classList.add('hrms-modal-open');
}

function closeModal(){
  var overlay=document.getElementById('ov');
  var modalBox=document.getElementById('modal');

  if(overlay){
    overlay.classList.remove('on');
    overlay.style.display='none';
  }

  if(modalBox){
    modalBox.style.display='';
  }

  document.body.classList.remove('hrms-modal-open');
}

var TRIES=0, LOCKED=false, IDLET=null;
function onPass(){var v=hrmsEl('pass').value;var h='';for(var i=0;i<8;i++)h+='<i class="'+(i<v.length?'f':'')+'"></i>';hrmsEl('dots').innerHTML=h}
function kp(k){var p=hrmsEl('pass');
  if(k==='clr')p.value='';else if(k==='del')p.value=p.value.slice(0,-1);else if(p.value.length<16)p.value+=k;
  onPass();if(p.value.length>=6&&ROLES[p.value])setTimeout(tryUnlock,120);}
function fillPass(c){hrmsEl('pass').value=c;onPass();hrmsEl('lockmsg').className='lockmsg';hrmsEl('lockmsg').textContent='Passcode filled — press Unlock';}
function toggleEye(){var p=hrmsEl('pass');p.type=p.type==='password'?'text':'password';hrmsEl('eyeI').style.opacity=p.type==='text'?1:.55}
function msg(t,c){hrmsEl('lockmsg').className='lockmsg '+(c||'');hrmsEl('lockmsg').textContent=t}
function tryUnlock(){
  if(LOCKED){msg('Locked out — please wait…','err');return}
  var code=hrmsEl('pass').value.trim();
  if(!code){msg('Enter your passcode','err');return}
  if(ROLES[code]){
    ME=ROLES[code];TRIES=0;
    msg('Access granted — opening HRMS 360°…','ok');
    SESSIONLOG.push({t:new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),who:ME.name,ev:'Unlocked HRMS 360° ('+ME.role+')'});
    setTimeout(function(){hrmsEl('lock').classList.add('off');hrmsEl('pass').value='';onPass();bootApp();},380);
  }else{
    TRIES++;
    if(TRIES>=3){LOCKED=true;var n=20;msg('3 wrong attempts — locked for '+n+'s','err');
      var iv=setInterval(function(){n--;msg('Locked — retry in '+n+'s','err');
        if(n<=0){clearInterval(iv);LOCKED=false;TRIES=0;msg('You may try again','')}},1000);
    }else msg('Invalid passcode — '+(3-TRIES)+' attempt'+(TRIES===2?'':'s')+' left','err');
    hrmsEl('pass').value='';onPass();
  }
}
function lockNow(){
  if(ME)SESSIONLOG.push({t:new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),who:ME.name,ev:'Locked session'});
  ME=null;hrmsEl('lock').classList.remove('off');msg('Session locked — enter passcode','');hrmsEl('pass').focus();
}

/* ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   13 · VIEW — ORG & REPORTING
   ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
function rOrg(){
  var s=scoped();
  var h=ph('EMPLOYEE 360 · STRUCTURE','Organisation & Reporting',
   'Branch → department → people. Every level expands and closes so you can read one branch at a time.','');
  var order=BRANCHES.map(function(b){return b.c}).filter(function(c){return c!=='ALL'});
  order.forEach(function(bc){
    var list=s.filter(function(e){return e.branch===bc});if(!list.length)return;
    var byD={};list.forEach(function(e){(byD[e.department]=byD[e.department]||[]).push(e)});
    var body=Object.keys(byD).sort().map(function(d){
      var k='org-'+bc+'-'+d.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g,'');
      return acc('▸ '+esc(d),byD[d].length+' people',
        '<div class="dgrid">'+byD[d].map(function(e){
          return '<div class="df" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openEmp(\''+e.id+'\')">'+
           '<div style="display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center">'+avatar(e,'sm')+
           '<div><div class="v" style="font-size:12.8px">'+esc(e.name)+'</div>'+
           '<div class="l">'+esc(e.designation)+'</div></div></div>'+
           '<div class="sm2" style="margin-top:5px;font-size:11.2px;color:var(--ink-3)">Reports to: '+esc(e.reportsTo||'—')+'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>',
        {key:k,open:false,ic:'▪',icCls:'slate'})}).join('');
    var b=BRANCHES.filter(function(x){return x.c===bc})[0];
    h+=acc('🏢 '+esc(brName(bc)),list.length+' staff · Head: '+esc(b.head||'—'),body,{key:'org-'+bc,ic:'▤',icCls:bc==='HO'?'gold':'teal',open:bc==='HO'});
  });
  return h;
}

function addAch(id){
  var e=getEmp(id);
  openModal('🏆 Add Achievement',esc(e.name)+' · '+e.id,
   '<div class="grid g2"><div class="fg"><label>Type</label><select id="ac-t"><option>Star Performer</option><option>Appreciation</option><option>Client Compliment</option><option>Long Service</option><option>Innovation</option></select></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Date</label><input type="date" id="ac-d" value="'+TODAY+'"></div></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Title <span class="rq">*</span></label><input id="ac-ti" placeholder="e.g. Highest package conversion in cluster"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Description</label><textarea id="ac-de" rows="3" placeholder="What exactly was achieved"></textarea></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Given by</label><input id="ac-by" value="'+esc(ME.name)+'"></div>',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="btn p" onclick="saveAch(\''+id+'\')">✓ Save achievement</button>');
}
function saveAch(id){
  var e=getEmp(id),t=hrmsEl('ac-ti').value.trim();
  if(!t){toast('Title is required','err');hrmsEl('ac-ti').classList.add('bad');return}
  e.achievements.unshift({date:hrmsEl('ac-d').value,type:hrmsEl('ac-t').value,title:t,desc:hrmsEl('ac-de').value,by:hrmsEl('ac-by').value});
  e.audit.unshift({date:TODAY,by:ME.name,what:'Achievement added — '+t});
  closeModal();toast('Achievement saved','ok');repaint();
}
function addWarn(id){
  var e=getEmp(id);
  openModal('⚠️ Issue Warning',esc(e.name)+' · '+e.id,
   '<div class="grid g2"><div class="fg"><label>Type</label><select id="wn-t"><option>Verbal Warning</option><option>Written Warning</option><option>Show Cause Notice</option><option>Final Warning</option></select></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Incident date</label><input type="date" id="wn-d" value="'+TODAY+'"></div></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Reason <span class="rq">*</span></label><textarea id="wn-r" rows="2" placeholder="Describe the incident factually"></textarea></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Action taken</label><input id="wn-a" placeholder="e.g. Counselled and retraining assigned"></div>'+
   '<div class="note n-w">A warning stays “Active” for 90 days and appears in the Alerts & Compliance desk.</div>',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button><button class="btn d" onclick="saveWarn(\''+id+'\')">⚠️ Issue warning</button>');
}
function saveWarn(id){
  var e=getEmp(id),r=hrmsEl('wn-r').value.trim();
  if(!r){toast('Reason is required','err');return}
  e.warnings.unshift({date:hrmsEl('wn-d').value,type:hrmsEl('wn-t').value,reason:r,action:hrmsEl('wn-a').value||'—',by:ME.name,status:'Active'});
  e.audit.unshift({date:TODAY,by:ME.name,what:'Warning issued — '+hrmsEl('wn-t').value});
  closeModal();toast('Warning recorded','wn');repaint();
}

function val(id){var el=hrmsEl(id);return el?el.value.trim():''}
function saveNewEmp(){
  var requiredFields=[
    ['ne-name','Full name'],
    ['ne-gender','Gender'],
    ['ne-dob','Date of birth'],
    ['ne-doj','Date of joining'],
    ['ne-branch','Branch'],
    ['ne-dept','Department'],
    ['ne-desig','Designation'],
    ['ne-mob','Personal mobile']
  ];

  var missing=[];

  requiredFields.forEach(function(row){
    var element=document.getElementById(row[0]);
    var value=element ? String(element.value||'').trim() : '';

    if(!value){
      missing.push(row[1]);

      if(element){
        element.classList.add('bad');
      }
    }else if(element){
      element.classList.remove('bad');
    }
  });

  if(missing.length){
    toast(
      'Missing: '+missing.join(', '),
      'err'
    );
    return;
  }

  var mobile=val('ne-mob');

  if(!/^\d{10}$/.test(mobile)){
    document.getElementById('ne-mob').classList.add('bad');

    toast(
      'Personal mobile must contain exactly 10 digits',
      'err'
    );
    return;
  }

  var relativeMobile=val('ne-relp');

  if(
    relativeMobile &&
    !/^\d{10}$/.test(relativeMobile)
  ){
    document.getElementById('ne-relp').classList.add('bad');

    toast(
      'Relative mobile must contain exactly 10 digits',
      'err'
    );
    return;
  }

  /*
   * Company is taken from the logged-in ERP environment.
   * Prefer the company attached to an existing live Employee.
   */
  var company='';

  for(var i=0;i<EMPLOYEES.length;i++){
    var source=EMPLOYEES[i].liveSource||{};

    if(source.company){
      company=source.company;
      break;
    }

    if(EMPLOYEES[i].company &&
       EMPLOYEES[i].company!=='Missing'){
      company=EMPLOYEES[i].company;
      break;
    }
  }

  if(!company){
    toast(
      'Company is Missing. Employee cannot be created.',
      'err'
    );
    return;
  }

  var fullName=val('ne-name');
  var nameParts=fullName.split(/\s+/);

  /*
   * ERPNext requires first_name.
   * Preserve the complete entered name:
   * first word → first_name
   * last word → last_name
   * middle words → middle_name
   */
  var firstName=nameParts.shift()||'';
  var lastName='';

  if(nameParts.length){
    lastName=nameParts.pop()||'';
  }

  var middleName=nameParts.join(' ');

  var formData=new URLSearchParams();

  formData.set('action','create_employee');
  formData.set('naming_series','HR-EMP-');
  formData.set('first_name',firstName);
  formData.set('middle_name',middleName);
  formData.set('last_name',lastName);
  formData.set('gender',val('ne-gender'));
  formData.set('date_of_birth',val('ne-dob'));
  formData.set('date_of_joining',val('ne-doj'));
  formData.set('status','Active');
  formData.set('company',company);

  /*
   * Actual Branch DocType name is submitted,
   * not UI branch code.
   */
  formData.set('branch',val('ne-branch'));
  formData.set('department',val('ne-dept'));
  formData.set('designation',val('ne-desig'));
  formData.set('employment_type',val('ne-type'));
  formData.set('reports_to',val('ne-mgr'));

  formData.set('personal_mobile_no',mobile);
  formData.set('cell_number',mobile);
  formData.set('personal_email',val('ne-mail'));

  formData.set(
    'person_to_be_contacted',
    val('ne-rel')
  );

  formData.set(
    'relation',
    val('ne-relr')
  );

  formData.set(
    'emergency_phone_number',
    relativeMobile
  );

  formData.set(
    'current_address',
    val('ne-addr')
  );

  formData.set(
    'permanent_address',
    val('ne-paddr')
  );

  formData.set(
    'blood_group',
    val('ne-blood')
  );

  formData.set(
    'marital_status',
    val('ne-marital')
  );

  formData.set(
    'grade',
    val('ne-grade')
  );

  formData.set(
    'default_shift',
    val('ne-shift')
  );

  formData.set(
    'custom_aadhaar_number',
    val('ne-aad')
  );

  formData.set(
    'attendance_device_id',
    val('ne-device')
  );

  formData.set(
    'holiday_list',
    val('ne-holiday')
  );

  formData.set(
    'shift_request_approver',
    val('ne-shift-approver')
  );

  formData.set(
    'company_email',
    val('ne-cmail')
  );

  formData.set(
    'pan_number',
    val('ne-pan')
  );

  formData.set(
    'provident_fund_account',
    val('ne-uan')
  );

  formData.set(
    'bank_name',
    val('ne-bank')
  );

  formData.set(
    'bank_ac_no',
    val('ne-acc')
  );

  formData.set(
    'ifsc_code',
    val('ne-ifsc')
  );

  formData.set(
    'ctc',
    val('ne-ctc')
  );

  formData.set(
    'salary_currency',
    val('ne-salary-currency')
  );

  formData.set(
    'salary_mode',
    val('ne-salary-mode')
  );

  var saveButton=document.querySelector(
    '[onclick="saveNewEmp()"]'
  );

  if(saveButton){
    saveButton.disabled=true;
    saveButton.dataset.oldText=
      saveButton.innerHTML;
    saveButton.innerHTML='Saving to ERPNext…';
  }

  var headers={
    'Accept':'application/json',
    'Content-Type':
      'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8'
  };

  if(
    window.frappe &&
    frappe.csrf_token
  ){
    headers['X-Frappe-CSRF-Token']=
      frappe.csrf_token;
  }

  fetch(
    '/api/method/life_hrms_360_api',
    {
      method:'POST',
      credentials:'same-origin',
      headers:headers,
      body:formData.toString()
    }
  )
  .then(function(response){
    return response.json().then(function(data){
      if(!response.ok){
        var serverMessage=
          data.exception ||
          data._server_messages ||
          data.message ||
          ('HTTP '+response.status);

        throw new Error(
          String(serverMessage)
        );
      }

      return data.message||data;
    });
  })
  .then(function(result){
    if(!result||!result.ok){
      throw new Error(
        result&&result.message
          ? result.message
          : 'Employee was not created'
      );
    }

    toast(
      'Employee saved in ERPNext: '+
      result.employee,
      'ok'
    );

    /*
     * Do not push into EMPLOYEES browser memory.
     * Reload from the backend so the displayed employee
     * is guaranteed to match the Employee DocType.
     */
    setTimeout(function(){
      window.location.href=
        window.location.pathname+
        '?employee_created='+
        encodeURIComponent(result.employee)+
        '&refresh='+
        Date.now();
    },900);
  })
  .catch(function(error){
    console.error(
      '[LIFE HRMS CREATE EMPLOYEE]',
      error
    );

    toast(
      'Employee creation failed: '+
      error.message,
      'err'
    );

    if(saveButton){
      saveButton.disabled=false;
      saveButton.innerHTML=
        saveButton.dataset.oldText||
        'Save employee';
    }
  });
}

function rReports(){

   '<button class="btn g" onclick="exportCSV()">📥 Export employee CSV</button><button class="btn" onclick="window.print()">⎙ Print</button>');
  var groups={};RPT.forEach(function(r,i){(groups[r.g]=groups[r.g]||[]).push({r:r,i:i})});
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(g){
    h+=acc('📂 '+g+' Reports',groups[g].length+' reports',
     '<div class="dgrid">'+groups[g].map(function(x){
       return '<div class="df" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="runRpt('+x.i+')">'+

function runRpt(i){
  var r=RPT[i];
  openModal('▤ '+esc(r.n),esc(r.d)+' · scope: '+(CUR==='ALL'?'all branches':brName(CUR)),r.f(),
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>'+
   '<button class="btn g" onclick="window.print()">⎙ Print</button>'+
   '<button class="btn p" onclick="toast(\''+esc(r.n)+' exported\',\'ok\')">📥 Export</button>','wide');
}

function logAudit(o){
  var a={id:nid('au'),ts:nowTS(),emp:o.emp||'',empName:o.emp?(getEmp(o.emp)||{}).name||'':'',action:o.action,
    field:o.field||'',from:o.from==null?'—':o.from,to:o.to==null?'—':o.to,reason:o.reason||'—',eff:o.eff||TODAY,
    reqBy:o.reqBy||meName(),appBy:o.appBy||'—',modBy:meName(),attach:o.attach||'—',status:o.status||'Completed',
    remarks:o.remarks||'—',module:o.module||'Employee'};
  AUDIT.unshift(a);
  var e=o.emp?getEmp(o.emp):null;
  if(e){e.audit2.unshift(a);e.audit.unshift({date:TODAY,by:meName(),what:o.action+(o.field?' · '+o.field+': '+a.from+' → '+a.to:'')});}
  return a;
}
function addHistory(e,h){if(!e)return;e.history.push(h);e.history.sort(function(a,b){return new Date(a.date)-new Date(b.date)})}

/* central mutation — keeps every derived field in sync across the whole app */
var FIELDLABEL={branch:'Branch',designation:'Designation',department:'Department',reportsTo:'Reporting Manager',
  employmentType:'Employment Type',status:'Employment Status',role:'Role',grade:'Grade',ctc:'CTC',
  category:'Employee Category',probation:'Probation Status',confirmationDate:'Confirmation Date',shift:'Shift'};
function applyChange(empId,o){
  var e=getEmp(empId);if(!e)return null;
  var f=o.field,from=o.from!==undefined?o.from:e[f],to=o.to;
  if(f){
    e[f]=to;
    if(f==='branch'){e.branchName=brName(to);e.empNumber='LIFE-'+to+'-'+e.id.slice(3);
      (e.duties||[]).forEach(function(){});}
    if(f==='designation'){e.role=to}
    if(f==='ctc'){e.gross=Math.round(to/12);e.basic=Math.round(e.gross*.5);e.hra=Math.round(e.gross*.2);
      e.ta=Math.round(e.gross*.1);e.da=Math.round(e.gross*.08);e.other=e.gross-e.basic-e.hra-e.ta-e.da;
      e.salaryHistory.push({date:o.eff||TODAY,ctc:to,reason:o.reason||'Salary revision'});}
    if(f==='status'){
      e.loginBlocked=LOGIN_BLOCKED.indexOf(to)>-1;
      if(to==='Notice Period'&&!e.exit)e.exit={resignDate:o.eff||TODAY,lastDate:addD(o.eff||TODAY,30),
        reason:o.reason||'Resignation',type:'Resignation',clearance:'In Progress',fnf:'Pending',rehire:'Yes'};
      if(to==='Active'){e.probation=e.status==='Probation'?'On Probation':'Confirmed'}
    }
  }
  if(o.arr==='transfer')e.transfers.push({date:o.eff||TODAY,from:from,to:to,reason:o.reason||'—',by:meName()});
  if(o.arr==='promotion')e.promotions.push({date:o.eff||TODAY,from:from,to:to,oldCtc:o.oldCtc||e.ctc,
    newCtc:o.newCtc||e.ctc,reason:o.reason||'—',by:meName()});
  if(o.arr==='duty')e.duties.push(o.duty);
  addHistory(e,{date:o.eff||TODAY,type:o.action,by:o.appBy||meName(),reason:o.reason||'',
    text:o.text||((FIELDLABEL[f]||f||o.action)+' — '+(from||'—')+' → '+(to||'—')),cls:o.cls||''});
  logAudit({emp:empId,action:o.action,field:FIELDLABEL[f]||f||'',from:from,to:to,reason:o.reason,
    eff:o.eff,attach:o.attach,remarks:o.remarks,appBy:o.appBy,module:o.module});
  return e;
}

/* ---------- approval workflow ---------- */
function needsApproval(type){return !!(APPRULES[type]&&APPRULES[type].req)&&!(ME&&ME.k==='ADMIN'&&APPRULES[type].by!=='COO')}
function raiseApproval(type,empIds,payload,desc){
  var a={id:nid('ap'),type:type,emps:empIds.slice(),desc:desc,payload:payload,
    submittedBy:meName(),submittedOn:nowTS(),approver:(APPRULES[type]||{}).by||'COO',
    status:'Pending Approval',stage:'Submitted',decidedBy:'—',decidedOn:'—',reason:payload.reason||'—',
    eff:payload.eff||TODAY,trail:[{ts:nowTS(),what:'Requested by '+meName(),st:'Requested'},
      {ts:nowTS(),what:'Submitted for approval to '+((APPRULES[type]||{}).by||'COO'),st:'Submitted'}]};
  APPROVALS.unshift(a);
  empIds.forEach(function(id){logAudit({emp:id,action:type+' requested',field:payload.field||'',
    from:payload.from,to:payload.to,reason:payload.reason,eff:payload.eff,status:'Pending Approval',module:'Approval'})});
  return a;
}
function getAppr(id){return APPROVALS.filter(function(a){return a.id===id})[0]}
function decideAppr(id,ok,note){
  var a=getAppr(id);if(!a||a.status!=='Pending Approval')return;
  a.status=ok?'Approved':'Rejected';a.stage=ok?'Completed':'Rejected';a.decidedBy=meName();a.decidedOn=nowTS();
  a.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:(ok?'Approved':'Rejected')+' by '+meName()+(note?' — '+note:''),st:a.status});
  if(ok)execApproval(a);
  else a.emps.forEach(function(id2){logAudit({emp:id2,action:a.type+' rejected',reason:note||a.reason,
    status:'Rejected',appBy:meName(),module:'Approval'})});
  toast(a.type+' '+(ok?'approved and applied':'rejected'),ok?'ok':'wn');
  badges();
}
function execApproval(a){
  var p=a.payload;
  a.emps.forEach(function(id){
    if(p.field)applyChange(id,{action:a.type,field:p.field,to:(typeof p.to==='function'?p.to(id):p.to),
      eff:p.eff,reason:p.reason,remarks:p.remarks,attach:p.attach,appBy:meName(),arr:p.arr,cls:p.cls});
    else applyChange(id,{action:a.type,text:p.text||a.desc,eff:p.eff,reason:p.reason,appBy:meName(),arr:p.arr,duty:p.duty});
  });
}

/* action router — approval-aware. Used by every staff control + bulk action */
function requestAction(type,empIds,payload,desc){
  if(needsApproval(type)&&!(ME&&ME.k==='ADMIN')){
    var a=raiseApproval(type,empIds,payload,desc);
    toast(type+' submitted for approval ('+a.id+')','wn');go('approvals');return a;
  }
  var auto=needsApproval(type)?{appBy:meName()+' · auto-approved (COO authority)'}:{};
  empIds.forEach(function(id){
    if(payload.field)applyChange(id,{action:type,field:payload.field,to:(typeof payload.to==='function'?payload.to(id):payload.to),
      eff:payload.eff,reason:payload.reason,remarks:payload.remarks,attach:payload.attach,arr:payload.arr,
      cls:payload.cls,appBy:auto.appBy,oldCtc:payload.oldCtc,newCtc:payload.newCtc});
    else applyChange(id,{action:type,text:payload.text||desc,eff:payload.eff,reason:payload.reason,
      arr:payload.arr,duty:payload.duty,appBy:auto.appBy});
  });
  if(needsApproval(type)){
    var rec=raiseApproval(type,empIds,payload,desc);rec.status='Approved';rec.stage='Completed';
    rec.decidedBy=meName()+' (COO authority)';rec.decidedOn=nowTS();
    rec.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Auto-approved under COO authority',st:'Approved'});
  }
  toast(type+' applied to '+empIds.length+' employee'+(empIds.length>1?'s':''),'ok');
  repaint();badges();
}

/* ---------- file helpers (real upload / preview / download) ---------- */
function humanSize(b){return b<1024?b+' B':(b<1048576?(b/1024).toFixed(1)+' KB':(b/1048576).toFixed(2)+' MB')}
function pickFile(accept,cb,multi){
  var i=document.createElement('input');i.type='file';if(accept)i.accept=accept;if(multi)i.multiple=true;
  i.style.display='none';document.body.appendChild(i);
  i.onchange=function(){
    var fs=Array.prototype.slice.call(i.files||[]);
    if(!fs.length){document.body.removeChild(i);return}
    var done=0,out=[];
    fs.forEach(function(f,ix){
      var r=new FileReader();
      r.onload=function(){out[ix]={name:f.name,type:f.type||'application/octet-stream',size:f.size,data:r.result};
        if(++done===fs.length){cb(multi?out:out[0]);document.body.removeChild(i)}};
      r.onerror=function(){toast('Could not read '+f.name,'err');if(++done===fs.length){cb(multi?out:out[0]);document.body.removeChild(i)}};
      r.readAsDataURL(f);
    });
  };
  i.click();
}
function downloadData(name,data,mime){
  var a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=data||('data:'+(mime||'text/plain')+';charset=utf-8,'+encodeURIComponent('LIFE HRMS 360 — demo file placeholder for '+name));
  a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();document.body.removeChild(a);
  toast('Downloaded '+name,'ok');
}
function previewData(name,type,data){
  var b='';
  if(data&&/^image\//.test(type))b='<div class="prevbox"><img src="'+data+'" alt="'+esc(name)+'"></div>';
  else if(data&&type==='application/pdf')b='<div class="prevbox"><iframe src="'+data+'"></iframe></div>';
  else if(data&&/^text\//.test(type))b='<div class="prevbox" style="text-align:left"><pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12px">'+
    esc(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob((data.split(',')[1]||'')))).slice(0,4000))+'</pre></div>';
  else b='<div class="prevbox"><div style="padding:34px"><div style="font-size:44px">📄</div>'+
    '<b style="font-size:15px">'+esc(name)+'</b><div class="sm2" style="margin-top:6px;color:var(--ink-3)">'+
    (data?'Inline preview not supported for this file type — use Download.':'This is a seeded demo record; no binary is attached. Upload a real file to enable inline preview.')+'</div></div></div>';
  openModal('👁 Preview · '+esc(name),type||'file',b,
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>'+
   '<button class="btn p" onclick="downloadData(\''+esc(name).replace(/'/g,"")+'\','+(data?'window.__pv':'null')+')">📥 Download</button>','wide');
  window.__pv=data||null;
}

PERMMENUS.forEach(function(m){PERMDEF[m[0]]={show:1,view:1,download:1,print:1,edit:0}});
['ess_internal','ess_disc','ess_mgr'].forEach(function(k){PERMDEF[k]={show:0,view:0,download:0,print:0,edit:0}});
PERMDEF['ess_salary']={show:1,view:1,download:0,print:1,edit:0};
PERMDEF['ess_medical']={show:0,view:0,download:0,print:0,edit:0};
PERMDEF['ess_profile'].edit=1;PERMDEF['ess_docs'].edit=1;PERMDEF['ess_leave'].edit=1;
var PERMRULES=[
 {id:'PR-01',scope:'Department',value:'Therapy',menu:'ess_incent',flags:{show:1,view:1,download:0,print:0,edit:0}},
 {id:'PR-02',scope:'Branch',value:'HO',menu:'ess_medical',flags:{show:1,view:1,download:0,print:0,edit:0}},
 {id:'PR-03',scope:'Designation',value:'Branch Manager',menu:'ess_mgr',flags:{show:1,view:1,download:0,print:1,edit:0}}
];
function permFor(menu,e){
  var base=Object.assign({},PERMDEF[menu]||{show:1,view:1,download:1,print:1,edit:0});
  if(!e)return base;
  var order={Role:1,Branch:2,Department:3,Designation:4,Employee:5},best=null,bs=0;
  PERMRULES.forEach(function(r){
    if(r.menu!==menu)return;
    var hit=(r.scope==='Employee'&&r.value===e.id)||(r.scope==='Branch'&&r.value===e.branch)||
      (r.scope==='Department'&&r.value===e.department)||(r.scope==='Designation'&&r.value===e.designation)||
      (r.scope==='Role'&&r.value===e.category);
    if(hit&&order[r.scope]>=bs){bs=order[r.scope];best=r}
  });
  if(best)base=Object.assign(base,best.flags);
  return base;
}
function can(menu,flag,e){var p=permFor(menu,e);return !!p[flag]&&!!p.show}
function setPermDefault(menu,flag,v){PERMDEF[menu][flag]=v?1:0;if(flag==='show'&&!v){}

function photoFoot(e){

   (PHTMP?'<button class="btn d" onclick="photoRemove(\''+e.id+'\')">🗑 Remove</button>':'')+

   '<button class="btn g" onclick="photoAuto(\''+e.id+'\')">✨ Use generated avatar</button>'+
   '<button class="btn p" onclick="photoSave(\''+e.id+'\')">💾 Save photo</button>';

function photoRefresh(e){hrmsEl('m-body').innerHTML=photoBody(e);hrmsEl('m-foot').innerHTML=photoFoot(e);wirePhotoDrop(e.id)}
function photoPick(id){
  var e=getEmp(id);
  pickFile('image/*',function(f){
    if(!/^image\//.test(f.type)){toast('Please choose an image file','err');return}
    PHTMP=f.data;photoRefresh(e);toast('Image loaded — press Save photo to apply');
  });
}
function photoAuto(id){var e=getEmp(id);PHTMP=genPhoto(e);photoRefresh(e);toast('Generated avatar applied — press Save')}
function photoRemove(id){
  var e=getEmp(id);
  confirmDo('Remove profile photo','This employee will fall back to the default avatar everywhere.',
   '<div class="note n-w">'+esc(e.name)+' ('+e.id+') — photo will be removed from Employee Master, 360, reports and letters.</div>',
   function(){e.photo=null;e.photoBy=null;e.photoOn=null;
     logAudit({emp:id,action:'Profile photo removed',field:'Photograph',from:'On file',to:'Default avatar',module:'Employee'});
     addHistory(e,{date:TODAY,type:'Photo',text:'Profile photograph removed',by:meName(),cls:''});
     PHTMP=null;closeModal();repaint();toast('Photo removed','wn')},true);
}
function photoSave(id){
  var e=getEmp(id);
  if(!PHTMP){toast('No image selected','err');return}
  var had=!!e.photo;
  e.photo=PHTMP;e.photoBy=meName();e.photoOn=TODAY;
  e.docs['photo']='uploaded';
  logAudit({emp:id,action:had?'Profile photo replaced':'Profile photo uploaded',field:'Photograph',
    from:had?'Previous photo':'Default avatar',to:'New photo',module:'Employee'});
  addHistory(e,{date:TODAY,type:'Photo',text:'Profile photograph '+(had?'replaced':'uploaded'),by:meName(),cls:''});
  closeModal();repaint();toast('Photo saved — now used on every screen','ok');
}
function wirePhotoDrop(id){
  var d=hrmsEl('phdrop');if(!d)return;
  d.ondragover=function(ev){ev.preventDefault();d.classList.add('dragover')};
  d.ondragleave=function(){d.classList.remove('dragover')};
  d.ondrop=function(ev){ev.preventDefault();d.classList.remove('dragover');
    var f=(ev.dataTransfer.files||[])[0];if(!f)return;
    if(!/^image\//.test(f.type)){toast('Please drop an image file','err');return}
    var r=new FileReader();r.onload=function(){PHTMP=r.result;photoRefresh(getEmp(id));toast('Image loaded — press Save photo')};
    r.readAsDataURL(f)};
}

function newBGV(a){
  if(bgvFor(a.id))return bgvFor(a.id);
  var b={id:nid('bg'),app:a.id,name:a.name,desig:a.desig,branch:a.branch||'MP',mobile:a.mobile||'',
    email:a.email||'',photo:genPhoto({id:a.id,gender:a.gender||'Male',name:a.name}),
    status:'Not Started',assignedTo:'',assignedOn:'',started:'',completed:'',result:'',verifiedBy:'',
    approval:'Pending',approvedBy:'',approvedOn:'',remarks:'',files:[],checks:{},docsChecked:{},trail:[]};
  BGVCHECKS.forEach(function(c){b.checks[c[0]]={st:'Pending',by:'',on:'',note:''}});
  b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'BGV requirement created on candidate selection',by:meName()});
  BGVS.unshift(b);
  logAudit({action:'BGV requirement created',field:'Candidate',from:'Selected',to:b.name,module:'Recruitment'});
  return b;
}
function getBGV(id){return BGVS.filter(function(b){return b.id===id})[0]}
function bgvClsFor(s){return s==='Cleared'?'t-g':s==='Failed'?'t-r':s==='Conditional'?'t-y':
  s==='Completed'?'t-m':s==='In Progress'?'t-b':s==='Reverification Required'?'t-r':'t-n'}
function bgvProgress(b){
  var done=0,tot=0;BGVCHECKS.forEach(function(c){tot++;if(b.checks[c[0]].st==='Verified'||b.checks[c[0]].st==='Not Applicable')done++});
  return Math.round(done/tot*100);
}

   '<button class="btn" onclick="go(\'applicants\')">👔 Applicant tracker</button>'+

  var pend=BGVS.filter(function(b){return b.approval!=='Approved'}).length;
  h+='<div class="grid g6" style="margin-bottom:13px">'+
   tile('Total BGV',BGVS.length,'All candidates','')+
   tile('Not started',BGVS.filter(function(b){return b.status==='Not Started'}).length,'Awaiting assignment','t-warn')+
   tile('In progress',BGVS.filter(function(b){return b.status==='In Progress'||b.status==='Assigned'}).length,'Being verified','t-info')+

   tile('Conditional / failed',BGVS.filter(function(b){return b.status==='Conditional'||b.status==='Failed'}).length,'Needs decision','t-crit')+
   tile('Pending approval',pend,'Blocking appointment','t-gold')+'</div>';
  h+=acc('🔎 BGV register',BGVS.length+' records',
   tw('<table class="tb stick"><thead><tr><th>Candidate</th><th>Position</th><th>Assigned to</th><th>Assigned</th>'+
    '<th class="c">Checks</th><th>Status</th><th>Result</th><th>Approval</th><th class="r">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
   (BGVS.length?BGVS.map(function(b){
     return '<tr class="click" onclick="bgvOpen(\''+b.id+'\')"><td><div style="display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center">'+
      '<div class="pav sm" style="width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:8px"><img src="'+b.photo+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover"></div>'+
      '<div><div class="nm">'+esc(b.name)+'</div><div class="sm2">'+b.id+' · '+b.app+'</div></div></div></td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(b.desig)+'<div class="sm2">'+brName(b.branch)+'</div></td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(b.assignedTo||'—')+'</td><td>'+(b.assignedOn?fmtD(b.assignedOn):'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="c">'+bar(bgvProgress(b))+'<div class="sm2">'+bgvProgress(b)+'%</div></td>'+
      '<td>'+tag(b.status,bgvClsFor(b.status))+'</td><td>'+(b.result?tag(b.result,bgvClsFor(b.result)):'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td>'+(b.approval==='Approved'?tag('Approved','t-g'):b.approval==='Rejected'?tag('Rejected','t-r'):tag('Pending','t-y'))+'</td>'+
      '<td class="r" onclick="event.stopPropagation()"><button class="mini" onclick="bgvOpen(\''+b.id+'\')">🔍 Open</button>'+
      (b.status==='Not Started'?' <button class="mini" onclick="bgvAssign(\''+b.id+'\')">👤 Assign</button>':'')+
      (b.status==='Completed'&&b.approval==='Pending'&&ME.k==='ADMIN'?' <button class="mini" onclick="bgvApprove(\''+b.id+'\',1)">✔ Approve</button>':'')+
      '</td></tr>'}).join(''):emptyRow(9,'No BGV records yet','Move a candidate to “Selected” in the applicant tracker to create one.'))+
   '</tbody></table>'),{key:'bgv-reg',flush:true,ic:'🔎',icCls:'gold'});
  return h;
}
function bgvNewManual(){
  var sel=APPLICANTS.filter(function(a){return a.stage==='Selected'||a.stage==='Offer Released'});
  openModal('＋ New BGV request','Pick a selected candidate',
   (sel.length?'<div class="dgrid2">'+sel.map(function(a){return '<div class="doccard" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="bgvCreateFor(\''+a.id+'\')">'+
     '<div class="ft"><div class="ic2">👤</div><div><b>'+esc(a.name)+'</b><div class="mt2">'+esc(a.desig)+' · '+a.id+'</div></div></div>'+
     '<div class="mt2">'+(bgvFor(a.id)?'BGV already exists':'Create BGV record')+'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>':
    '<div class="note n-w">No candidate is currently at the Selected stage. Advance someone in the Applicant Tracker first.</div>'),
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>','wide');
}
function bgvCreateFor(appId){
  var a=getApp(appId);if(!a)return;
  var b=newBGV(a);closeModal();go('bgv');toast('BGV '+b.id+' created for '+a.name,'ok');
}

  var body='<div class="phbox" style="margin-bottom:12px">'+
   '<div class="pav"><img src="'+b.photo+'" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover"></div>'+

   df('Candidate',esc(b.name))+df('Applicant ID',b.app)+df('Position',esc(b.desig))+df('Branch',brName(b.branch))+
   df('Mobile',b.mobile||'—')+df('Email',esc(b.email||'—'))+
   df('Verification assigned to',esc(b.assignedTo||'—'))+df('Assigned date',b.assignedOn?fmtDL(b.assignedOn):'—')+
   df('Verification status',tag(b.status,bgvClsFor(b.status)))+df('Progress',bgvProgress(b)+'%')+
   df('Verification result',b.result?tag(b.result,bgvClsFor(b.result)):'—')+
   df('Verified by',esc(b.verifiedBy||'—'))+df('Completion date',b.completed?fmtDL(b.completed):'—')+
   df('Approval status',b.approval==='Approved'?tag('Approved','t-g'):(b.approval==='Rejected'?tag('Rejected','t-r'):tag('Pending','t-y')))+
   df('Approved by',esc(b.approvedBy||'—'))+'</div></div></div>';
  body+='<div class="tw"><table class="tb"><thead><tr><th>Verification check</th><th>Status</th><th>By</th><th>On</th><th>Note</th>'+
   (ME.edit?'<th class="r">Set</th>':'')+'</tr></thead><tbody>'+
   BGVCHECKS.map(function(c){var k=b.checks[c[0]];
     return '<tr><td><b>'+c[1]+'</b></td><td>'+(k.st==='Verified'?tag('Verified','t-g'):k.st==='Failed'?tag('Failed','t-r'):
      k.st==='Not Applicable'?tag('N/A','t-n'):tag(k.st,'t-y'))+'</td><td>'+esc(k.by||'—')+'</td><td>'+(k.on?fmtD(k.on):'—')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="sm2">'+esc(k.note||'—')+'</td>'+(ME.edit?'<td class="r"><button class="mini" onclick="bgvCheck(\''+b.id+'\',\''+c[0]+'\')">✎ Update</button></td>':'')+'</tr>'}).join('')+
   '</tbody></table></div>';
  body+='<div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:12px"><div class="fg"><label>Documents checked</label><div class="flagbox">'+
   ['Aadhaar','PAN','Degree certificate','Relieving letter','Payslips','Address proof','Police clearance','Council registration'].map(function(d){
     return '<span class="flag '+(b.docsChecked[d]?'on':'')+'" onclick="bgvDoc(\''+b.id+'\',\''+d+'\')">'+(b.docsChecked[d]?'✔ ':'')+d+'</span>'}).join('')+'</div></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Attachments ('+b.files.length+')</label><div class="btnrow">'+
   (ME.edit?'<button class="btn sm" onclick="bgvAttach(\''+b.id+'\')">📎 Attach evidence</button>':'')+
   b.files.map(function(f,i){return '<button class="mini" onclick="previewData(\''+esc(f.name).replace(/'/g,'')+'\',\''+f.type+'\',BGVS.filter(function(x){return x.id===\''+b.id+'\'})[0].files['+i+'].data)">📄 '+esc(f.name)+'</button>'}).join('')+
   '</div></div></div>';
  body+='<div class="fg" style="margin-top:8px"><label>Remarks</label><textarea id="bg-rm" rows="2">'+esc(b.remarks||'')+'</textarea></div>';
  body+='<div class="hist" style="margin-top:10px">'+b.trail.slice().reverse().map(function(t){
    return '<div class="hv"><div class="dt">'+t.ts+'</div><div class="ds">'+esc(t.what)+(t.by?' — '+esc(t.by):'')+'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>';
  var foot='<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>';
  if(ME.edit){
    foot+='<button class="btn" onclick="bgvAssign(\''+b.id+'\')">👤 Assign / reassign</button>';
    foot+='<button class="btn" onclick="bgvSaveRemarks(\''+b.id+'\')">💾 Save remarks</button>';
    foot+='<button class="btn s" onclick="bgvResult(\''+b.id+'\')">🏁 Record result</button>';
  }
  if(ME.k==='ADMIN'&&b.status!=='Not Started')
    foot+='<button class="btn d" onclick="bgvApprove(\''+b.id+'\',0)">✕ Reject BGV</button>'+

  openModal('🔎 Background Verification · '+esc(b.name),b.id+' · '+b.status,body,foot,'wide');
