function bgvAssign(id){
  var b=getBGV(id);
  openModal('👤 Assign verification',esc(b.name),
   '<div class="fg"><label>Verification assigned to <span class="rq">*</span></label><select id="bg-a">'+opts(BGVAGENTS,b.assignedTo)+'</select></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Assigned date</label><input id="bg-d" type="date" value="'+(b.assignedOn||TODAY)+'"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Target completion</label><input id="bg-t" type="date" value="'+addD(TODAY,7)+'"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Instructions</label><textarea id="bg-i" rows="2" placeholder="Specific checks to prioritise"></textarea></div>',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>'+
   '<button class="btn p" onclick="bgvDoAssign(\''+id+'\')">Assign</button>');
}
function bgvDoAssign(id){
  var b=getBGV(id);b.assignedTo=hrmsEl('bg-a').value;b.assignedOn=val('bg-d')||TODAY;
  b.status='Assigned';b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Assigned to '+b.assignedTo+(val('bg-i')?' — '+val('bg-i'):''),by:meName()});
  logAudit({action:'BGV assigned',field:b.name,from:'Not Started',to:b.assignedTo,module:'Recruitment'});
  closeModal();repaint();toast('BGV assigned to '+b.assignedTo,'ok');
}
function bgvCheck(id,key){
  var b=getBGV(id),k=b.checks[key],lbl=BGVCHECKS.filter(function(c){return c[0]===key})[0][1];
  openModal('✎ '+lbl,esc(b.name),
   '<div class="fg"><label>Status</label><select id="bc-s">'+opts(['Pending','In Progress','Verified','Failed','Not Applicable'],k.st)+'</select></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Verified by</label><input id="bc-b" value="'+esc(k.by||b.assignedTo||meName())+'"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Date</label><input id="bc-d" type="date" value="'+(k.on||TODAY)+'"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Note / finding</label><textarea id="bc-n" rows="2">'+esc(k.note||'')+'</textarea></div>',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>'+
   '<button class="btn p" onclick="bgvSaveCheck(\''+id+'\',\''+key+'\')">💾 Save</button>');
}
function bgvSaveCheck(id,key){
  var b=getBGV(id),k=b.checks[key],lbl=BGVCHECKS.filter(function(c){return c[0]===key})[0][1];
  k.st=hrmsEl('bc-s').value;k.by=val('bc-b');k.on=val('bc-d');k.note=hrmsEl('bc-n').value.trim();
  if(b.status==='Assigned'||b.status==='Not Started')b.status='In Progress';
  if(!b.started)b.started=TODAY;
  b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:lbl+' → '+k.st+(k.note?' ('+k.note+')':''),by:meName()});
  if(bgvProgress(b)===100&&b.status==='In Progress'){b.status='Completed';b.completed=TODAY;
    b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'All checks completed — awaiting result and approval',by:meName()})}
  logAudit({action:'BGV check updated',field:lbl,from:'—',to:k.st,module:'Recruitment'});
  closeModal();bgvOpen(id);repaint();toast(lbl+' → '+k.st,'ok');
}
function bgvDoc(id,d){var b=getBGV(id);b.docsChecked[d]=!b.docsChecked[d];
  b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Document '+(b.docsChecked[d]?'checked':'unchecked')+' — '+d,by:meName()});bgvOpen(id)}
function bgvAttach(id){
  var b=getBGV(id);
  pickFile('',function(f){b.files.push({name:f.name,type:f.type,size:humanSize(f.size),data:f.data,date:TODAY,by:meName()});
    b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Evidence attached — '+f.name,by:meName()});
    logAudit({action:'BGV evidence attached',field:b.name,to:f.name,attach:f.name,module:'Recruitment'});
    bgvOpen(id);toast('Evidence attached','ok')});
}
function bgvSaveRemarks(id){var b=getBGV(id);b.remarks=hrmsEl('bg-rm').value.trim();
  b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Remarks updated',by:meName()});toast('Remarks saved','ok');bgvOpen(id)}
function bgvResult(id){
  var b=getBGV(id);
  openModal('🏁 Verification result',esc(b.name),
   '<div class="fg"><label>Verification status</label><select id="br-s">'+opts(BGVSTATUS,b.status)+'</select></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Result</label><select id="br-r">'+opts(['','Cleared','Conditional','Failed','Reverification Required'],b.result)+'</select></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Verified by</label><input id="br-b" value="'+esc(b.verifiedBy||b.assignedTo||meName())+'"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Completion date</label><input id="br-d" type="date" value="'+(b.completed||TODAY)+'"></div>'+
   '<div class="fg"><label>Remarks</label><textarea id="br-m" rows="2">'+esc(b.remarks||'')+'</textarea></div>',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>'+
   '<button class="btn p" onclick="bgvSaveResult(\''+id+'\')">💾 Save result</button>');
}
function bgvSaveResult(id){
  var b=getBGV(id),was=b.status;
  b.status=hrmsEl('br-s').value;b.result=hrmsEl('br-r').value;b.verifiedBy=val('br-b');b.completed=val('br-d');b.remarks=hrmsEl('br-m').value.trim();
  b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Result recorded — '+b.status+(b.result?' / '+b.result:''),by:meName()});
  logAudit({action:'BGV result recorded',field:b.name,from:was,to:b.status+(b.result?' · '+b.result:''),module:'Recruitment'});
  closeModal();repaint();toast('BGV result saved','ok');
}
function bgvApprove(id,ok){
  var b=getBGV(id);
  if(ok&&b.status!=='Cleared'&&b.status!=='Completed'&&b.status!=='Conditional'){
    toast('Complete the verification checks before approving','err');return}
  confirmDo(ok?'Approve background verification':'Reject background verification',esc(b.name)+' · '+b.id,
   '<div class="dgrid">'+df('Candidate',esc(b.name))+df('Position',esc(b.desig))+df('Status',b.status)+
   df('Result',b.result||'—')+df('Checks completed',bgvProgress(b)+'%')+df('Decision',ok?'<b>Approved</b>':'<b>Rejected</b>')+'</div>',
   function(){
     b.approval=ok?'Approved':'Rejected';b.approvedBy=meName();b.approvedOn=nowTS();
     if(ok&&!b.result)b.result='Cleared';
     if(ok)b.status='Cleared';
     b.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'BGV '+(ok?'approved':'rejected')+' by '+meName(),by:meName()});
     logAudit({action:'BGV '+(ok?'approved':'rejected'),field:b.name,from:'Pending',to:b.approval,module:'Recruitment',appBy:meName()});
     closeModal();repaint();badges();toast('BGV '+b.approval,ok?'ok':'wn');
   },!ok);
}

/* ---------- appointment approval (BGV-gated) ---------- */
function apptFor(appId){return APPOINTS.filter(function(a){return a.app===appId})[0]}
function newAppoint(a){
  if(apptFor(a.id))return apptFor(a.id);
  var r={id:nid('ao'),app:a.id,name:a.name,desig:a.desig,branch:a.branch||'MP',
    dept:a.dept||'Therapy',ctc:a.ctc||300000,doj:addD(TODAY,10),grade:'G2',type:'Full-Time',
    status:'Pending',approvedBy:'',approvedOn:'',override:null,letter:null,trail:[{ts:nowTS(),what:'Appointment approval raised',by:meName()}]};
  APPOINTS.unshift(r);return r;
}
function rAppoint(){
  var sel=APPLICANTS.filter(function(a){return ['Selected','Offer Released','Joined'].indexOf(a.stage)>-1});
  sel.forEach(function(a){newBGV(a);newAppoint(a)});
  var h=ph('RECRUITMENT · CONTROL','Appointment Approval',
   'Appointment letters cannot be approved until mandatory background verification is approved. A COO/HR override is available and always records a reason plus an audit entry.',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="go(\'bgv\')">🔎 Background verification</button>'+
   '<button class="btn g" onclick="go(\'letters\')">📨 HR letters</button>');
  h+='<div class="wf">'+['Selected','Background Verification','BGV Approval','Appointment Approval','Appointment Letter','Onboarding','Activation']
   .map(function(s,i){return '<span class="s '+(i<3?'done':(i===3?'cur':''))+'">'+s+'</span>'}).join('')+'</div>';
  h+=acc('📜 Appointment queue',APPOINTS.length+' candidates',
   tw('<table class="tb stick"><thead><tr><th>Candidate</th><th>Position</th><th>Branch</th><th>Proposed DOJ</th>'+
    (ME.salary?'<th class="r">CTC</th>':'')+'<th>BGV</th><th>Appointment</th><th class="r">Action</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
   (APPOINTS.length?APPOINTS.map(function(r){var b=bgvFor(r.app)||{status:'Not Started',approval:'Pending'};
     var ok=b.approval==='Approved';
     return '<tr><td><b>'+esc(r.name)+'</b><div class="sm2">'+r.id+' · '+r.app+'</div></td>'+
      '<td>'+esc(r.desig)+'<div class="sm2">'+esc(r.dept)+'</div></td><td>'+brName(r.branch)+'</td><td>'+fmtD(r.doj)+'</td>'+
      (ME.salary?'<td class="r tnum">'+moneyK(r.ctc)+'</td>':'')+
      '<td>'+tag(b.status,bgvClsFor(b.status))+'<div class="sm2">'+(ok?'Approved':'Approval pending')+'</div></td>'+
      '<td>'+(r.status==='Approved'?tag('Approved','t-g'):r.status==='Rejected'?tag('Rejected','t-r'):tag('Pending','t-y'))+
        (r.override?'<div class="sm2">⚠ Override used</div>':'')+'</td>'+
      '<td class="r"><button class="mini" onclick="apptOpen(\''+r.id+'\')">🔍 Open</button>'+
      (r.status==='Pending'?' <button class="mini" onclick="apptApprove(\''+r.id+'\')">'+(ok?'✔ Approve':'🔒 Blocked')+'</button>':'')+
      (r.status==='Approved'&&!r.letter?' <button class="mini" onclick="apptLetter(\''+r.id+'\')">📨 Letter</button>':'')+
      '</td></tr>'}).join(''):emptyRow(ME.salary?8:7,'No candidates awaiting appointment','Advance an applicant to “Selected”.'))+
   '</tbody></table>'),{key:'ap-q',flush:true,ic:'📜',icCls:'gold'});
  h+=acc('🔐 Appointment control rule','Mandatory gate',
   '<div class="note n-w"><b>Background Verification approval is required before Appointment Letter approval.</b>'+
   'Only an authorised COO / HR Admin override can bypass this gate. The override always requires a written reason and creates an audit entry.</div>',
   {key:'ap-rule',ic:'🔐',icCls:'rose',open:false});
  return h;
}
function getAppt(id){return APPOINTS.filter(function(a){return a.id===id})[0]}
function apptOpen(id){
  var r=getAppt(id),b=bgvFor(r.app)||{};
  openModal('📜 Appointment · '+esc(r.name),r.id+' · '+r.status,
   '<div class="dgrid">'+df('Candidate',esc(r.name))+df('Applicant',r.app)+df('Designation',esc(r.desig))+
   df('Department',esc(r.dept))+df('Branch',brName(r.branch))+df('Proposed joining date',fmtDL(r.doj))+
   df('Grade',r.grade)+df('Employment type',r.type)+(ME.salary?df('Proposed CTC',money(r.ctc)):'')+
   df('BGV status',b.status?tag(b.status,bgvClsFor(b.status)):'—')+
   df('BGV approval',b.approval==='Approved'?tag('Approved','t-g'):tag(b.approval||'Pending','t-y'))+
   df('Appointment status',r.status==='Approved'?tag('Approved','t-g'):tag(r.status,'t-y'))+
   df('Approved by',esc(r.approvedBy||'—'))+df('Approved on',r.approvedOn||'—')+
   df('Override',r.override?('<b class="neg">'+esc(r.override.reason)+'</b> — '+esc(r.override.by)):'Not used')+
   df('Appointment letter',r.letter?('<b>'+r.letter+'</b>'):'Not generated')+'</div>'+
   '<div class="hist" style="margin-top:10px">'+r.trail.slice().reverse().map(function(t){
     return '<div class="hv"><div class="dt">'+t.ts+'</div><div class="ds">'+esc(t.what)+'</div></div>'}).join('')+'</div>',
   '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>'+

     (ME.k==='ADMIN'?'<div class="fg" style="margin-top:10px"><label>Override reason <span class="rq">*</span></label>'+

     '<button class="btn" onclick="closeModal()">Close</button>'+

     (ME.k==='ADMIN'?'<button class="btn d" onclick="apptOverride(\''+id+'\')">⚠ Override & approve</button>':''),'wide');

function apptOverride(id){
  var r=getAppt(id),reason=hrmsEl('ov-r')?hrmsEl('ov-r').value.trim():'';

   '<div class="note n-c"><b>'+esc(r.name)+'</b>Appointment will be approved without an approved background verification.</div>'+
   '<div class="dgrid" style="margin-top:8px">'+df('Reason',esc(reason))+df('Authorised by',esc(meName()))+df('Timestamp',nowTS())+'</div>',
   function(){apptDoApprove(id,{reason:reason,by:meName(),on:nowTS()})},true);
}
function apptDoApprove(id,override){
  var r=getAppt(id);
  r.status='Approved';r.approvedBy=meName();r.approvedOn=nowTS();r.override=override;
  r.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Appointment approved by '+meName()+(override?' — OVERRIDE: '+override.reason:'')});
  logAudit({action:'Appointment approved'+(override?' (BGV override)':''),field:r.name,from:'Pending',to:'Approved',
    reason:override?override.reason:'BGV approved',appBy:meName(),module:'Recruitment',
    status:override?'Approved with override':'Completed'});
  var a=getApp(r.app);
  if(a&&a.stage==='Selected'){a.stage='Offer Released'}

  toast('Appointment approved for '+r.name+(override?' (override recorded)':''),'ok');

}
function apptLetter(id){
  var r=getAppt(id);
  if(r.status!=='Approved'){toast('Approve the appointment first','err');return}
  var tpl=getTpl('appointment');
  var data={'Employee Name':r.name,'Employee ID':'(on joining)','Designation':r.desig,'Department':r.dept,
    'Branch':brName(r.branch),'Joining Date':fmtDL(r.doj),'Effective Date':fmtDL(r.doj),
    'Reporting Manager':'Branch Manager','Salary':ME.salary?money(r.ctc):'as per offer','Company Name':'Life Slimming and Cosmetic Clinic Pvt. Ltd.',
    'Grade':r.grade,'Employment Type':r.type,'Date':fmtDL(TODAY)};
  var html=renderTpl(tpl,data);
  var lt={id:nid('lt'),tpl:tpl.id,name:tpl.name,emp:null,cand:r.name,date:TODAY,by:meName(),body:html,ver:tpl.ver};
  LETTERS.unshift(lt);r.letter=lt.id;
  r.trail.push({ts:nowTS(),what:'Appointment letter '+lt.id+' generated from template v'+tpl.ver});
  logAudit({action:'Appointment letter generated',field:r.name,to:lt.id,module:'HR Letters'});
  var o=ONBOARD.filter(function(x){return x.name===r.name})[0];
  if(o){o.blocked=false;o.appointed=true;o.letter=lt.id}
  letterPreview(lt.id);
  toast('Appointment letter generated — onboarding unlocked','ok');
}

  if(!su||!m){toast('Subject and message are required','err');return}
  var rec=window.__cmIds?window.__cmIds.map(getEmp).filter(Boolean):commRecipients(g,v);
  var sched=val('cm-s');
  var c={id:nid('cm'),type:t,subj:su,msg:m,to:(window.__cmIds?'Selected employees':(g==='All employees'?g:g+': '+v)),
    toIds:rec.map(function(e){return e.id}),prio:hrmsEl('cm-p').value,send:send?(val('cm-d')||TODAY):'',sched:sched,
    status:send?'Sent':(sched?'Scheduled':'Draft'),read:0,ack:hrmsEl('cm-a').value==='Required',acked:0,
    by:meName(),attach:window.__bkAttach?window.__bkAttach.name:''};

  rec.forEach(function(e){addHistory(e,{date:TODAY,type:'Communication',text:t+' — '+su,by:meName(),cls:''})});

function cpSet(menu,flag,v){
  PERMDEF[menu][flag]=v?1:0;
  if(flag==='show'&&!v){PERMFLAGS.forEach(function(f){if(f!=='show')PERMDEF[menu][f]=0})}
  if(flag!=='show'&&v)PERMDEF[menu].show=1;
  logAudit({action:'Employee visibility changed',field:(PERMMENUS.filter(function(m){return m[0]===menu})[0]||[menu,menu])[1]+' · '+flag,
    from:v?'No':'Yes',to:v?'Yes':'No',module:'Control Panel'});
  repaint();toast((PERMMENUS.filter(function(m){return m[0]===menu})[0]||[0,menu])[1]+' · '+flag+' → '+(v?'Yes':'No'),'ok');
}
function cpRule(k,v){APPRULES[k].req=!!v;
  logAudit({action:'Approval rule changed',field:k,from:v?'Direct':'Required',to:v?'Required':'Direct',module:'Control Panel'});
  repaint();toast(k+' → '+(v?'requires approval':'applies directly'),'ok')}
function cpRole(r,a,v){ROLEPERM[r][a]=v?1:0;
  logAudit({action:'Role permission changed',field:r+' · '+a,from:v?'Denied':'Allowed',to:v?'Allowed':'Denied',module:'Control Panel'});
  repaint()}

     }).map(function(b){

     }).join('');

function cpRuleSave(){
  var flags={};
  Array.prototype.forEach.call(hrmsEl('pr-f').querySelectorAll('.flag'),function(el){flags[el.getAttribute('data-f')]=el.classList.contains('on')?1:0});
  var r={id:'PR-'+pad(PERMRULES.length+1),scope:hrmsEl('pr-s').value,value:hrmsEl('pr-v').value,menu:hrmsEl('pr-m').value,flags:flags};
  PERMRULES.push(r);

function cpRuleDel(id){
  var r=PERMRULES.filter(function(x){return x.id===id})[0];

    PERMRULES=PERMRULES.filter(function(x){return x.id!==id});

(function(){

  /*
   * One central employee scope for every employee-based tab.
   */
  window.hrmsEmployeeScope=function(){
    return EMPLOYEES.filter(function(employee){

      if(
        ME &&
        ME.br!=='ALL' &&
        employee.branch!==ME.br
      ){
        return false;
      }

      if(
        CUR!=='ALL' &&
        employee.branch!==CUR
      ){
        return false;
      }

      if(
        CURDEPT!=='ALL' &&
        employee.department!==CURDEPT
      ){
        return false;
      }

      if(
        CURSTAT!=='ALL' &&
        employee.status!==CURSTAT
      ){
        return false;
      }

      return true;
    });
  };

  /*
   * Replace the original scoped() globally.
   */
  scoped=function(){
    return window.hrmsEmployeeScope();
  };

  /*
   * Rebuild status options using statuses that really exist
   * in the Employee DocType response.
   */
  window.hrmsBuildStatusFilter=function(){
    var select=document.getElementById('stsel');

    if(!select){
      return;
    }

    var statuses=[];

    EMPLOYEES.forEach(function(employee){
      var status=String(
        employee.status||''
      ).trim();

      if(
        status &&
        status!=='Missing' &&
        statuses.indexOf(status)===-1
      ){
        statuses.push(status);
      }
    });

    var preferredOrder=[
      'Active',
      'Inactive',
      'Suspended',
      'Left'
    ];

    statuses.sort(function(a,b){
      var ai=preferredOrder.indexOf(a);
      var bi=preferredOrder.indexOf(b);

      if(ai===-1){
        ai=999;
      }

      if(bi===-1){
        bi=999;
      }

      if(ai!==bi){
        return ai-bi;
      }

      return a.localeCompare(b);
    });

    select.innerHTML=
      '<option value="Active">Active employees</option>'+
      '<option value="ALL">All statuses</option>'+
      statuses
        .filter(function(status){
          return status!=='Active';
        })
        .map(function(status){
          return '<option value="'+
            esc(status)+
            '">'+
            esc(status)+
            ' employees</option>';
        })
        .join('');

    select.value=CURSTAT||'Active';
  };

  /*
   * Preserve selected status when moving between tabs.
   */
  setStat=function(status){
    CURSTAT=status||'Active';

    if(select){
      select.value=CURSTAT;

      'Status: '+
      (CURSTAT==='ALL'
        ? 'All employees'
        : CURSTAT+' employees'),
      'ok'
    );
  };

   * Wrap the final boot function.
   */
  var activeDefaultOriginalBoot=bootApp;

    CURSTAT='Active';

    CURSTAT='Active';

    var statusSelect=
      document.getElementById('stsel');

    if(statusSelect){
      statusSelect.value='Active';
    }

    repaint();
    badges();
  };

})();

(function () {

  var HRMS_API =
    "/api/method/life_hrms_360_api";

  /*
   * Read and clean Frappe error messages.
   */
  function hrmsApiError(data, fallback) {
    var message = "";

    try {
      if (data && data._server_messages) {
        var messages = JSON.parse(
          data._server_messages
        );

        if (messages.length) {
          var parsed = JSON.parse(messages[0]);
          message =
            parsed.message ||
            parsed.title ||
            "";
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      message = "";
    }

    if (!message && data) {
      message =
        data.exception ||
        data.exc_type ||
        data.message ||
        "";
    }

    if (
      message &&
      typeof message === "object"
    ) {
      message =
        message.message ||
        JSON.stringify(message);
    }

    return message || fallback ||
      "ERP operation failed.";
  }

  /*
   * Central authenticated ERP API request.
   */
  window.hrmsLiveRequest = function (
    action,
    payload
  ) {
    var params = new URLSearchParams();

    params.append("action", action);

    Object.keys(payload || {}).forEach(
      function (key) {
        var value = payload[key];

        if (
          value !== undefined &&
          value !== null
        ) {
          params.append(
            key,
            String(value)
          );
        }
      }
    );

    var headers = {
      "Content-Type":
        "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8",
      "X-Frappe-CSRF-Token":
        (
          window.frappe &&
          frappe.csrf_token
        ) || ""
    };

    return fetch(HRMS_API, {
      method: "POST",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: headers,
      body: params.toString()
    })
    .then(function (response) {
      return response.text().then(
        function (responseText) {
          var data = {};

          try {
            data = JSON.parse(
              responseText || "{}"
            );
          } catch (error) {
            data = {
              message: responseText
            };
          }

          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
              hrmsApiError(
                data,
                "HTTP " + response.status
              )
            );
          }

          if (
            data.exc ||
            data.exception
          ) {
            throw new Error(
              hrmsApiError(data)
            );
          }

          return data.message || data;
        }
      );
    });
  };

  /*
   * Convert the branch code displayed by the UI
   * into the real Branch DocType name.
   */
  window.hrmsLiveBranchName =
    function (value) {
      var input = String(value || "");
      var match = null;

      if (
        typeof BRANCHES !== "undefined"
      ) {
        match = BRANCHES.filter(
          function (branch) {
            return (
              branch.c === input ||
              branch.n === input
            );
          }
        )[0];
      }

      return match
        ? String(match.n || match.c)
        : input;
    };

  /*
   * Reload only after ERP confirms the save.
   */
  window.hrmsLiveSuccess =
    function (message) {
      toast(
        message ||
        "Saved successfully in ERP.",
        "ok"
      );

      window.setTimeout(
        function () {
          window.location.reload();
        },
        700
      );
    };

  window.hrmsLiveFailure =
    function (error) {
      console.error(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360 LIVE ACTION]",
        error
      );

      toast(
        error && error.message
          ? error.message
          : "ERP save failed.",
        "err"
      );
    };

  /*
   * Replace browser-memory requestAction().
   *
   * Supported:
   * - Employee status
   * - Employee Transfer
   * - Employee Promotion
   *
   * Unsupported writes are clearly marked MISSING.
   */
  requestAction = function (
    type,
    employeeIds,
    payload,
    description
  ) {
    payload = payload || {};
    employeeIds = employeeIds || [];

    if (!employeeIds.length) {
      toast(
        "No employee selected.",
        "err"
      );
      return;
    }

    var requests = [];

    /*
     * Employee status
     */
    if (payload.field === "status") {
      var validStatuses = [
        "Active",
        "Inactive",
        "Suspended",
        "Left"
      ];

      var requestedStatus =
        typeof payload.to === "function"
          ? payload.to(employeeIds[0])
          : payload.to;

      /*
       * Convert UI action labels to valid
       * Employee DocType statuses.
       */
      var statusMap = {
        "Deactivate": "Inactive",
        "Deactivation": "Inactive",
        "Activate": "Active",
        "Reactivation": "Active",
        "Reactivate": "Active",
        "Suspension": "Suspended",
        "Suspend": "Suspended",
        "Termination": "Left",
        "Terminate": "Left",
        "Mark Absconded": "Left"
      };

      if (
        validStatuses.indexOf(
          requestedStatus
        ) === -1
      ) {
        requestedStatus =
          statusMap[type] ||
          statusMap[description] ||
          requestedStatus;
      }

      if (
        validStatuses.indexOf(
          requestedStatus
        ) === -1
      ) {
        toast(
          "MISSING LIVE MAPPING: status " +
          String(requestedStatus),
          "err"
        );
        return;
      }

      employeeIds.forEach(
        function (employeeId) {
          requests.push(
            hrmsLiveRequest(
              "update_employee_status",
              {
                employee: employeeId,
                status: requestedStatus,
                effective_date:
                  payload.eff || TODAY,
                reason:
                  payload.reason ||
                  description ||
                  type
              }
            )
          );
        }
      );
    }

    /*
     * Employee Transfer
     */
    else if (type === "Transfer") {
      employeeIds.forEach(
        function (employeeId) {
          var requestData = {
            employee: employeeId,
            transfer_date:
              payload.eff || TODAY,
            reason:
              payload.reason ||
              description ||
              "Employee transfer"
          };

          if (payload.field === "branch") {
            requestData.new_branch =
              hrmsLiveBranchName(
                payload.to
              );
          }

          if (
            payload.field ===
            "department"
          ) {
            requestData.new_department =
              payload.to;
          }

          if (
            payload.field ===
            "designation"
          ) {
            requestData.new_designation =
              payload.to;
          }

          requests.push(
            hrmsLiveRequest(
              "create_employee_transfer",
              requestData
            )
          );
        }
      );
    }

    /*
     * Employee Promotion
     */
    else if (type === "Promotion") {
      employeeIds.forEach(
        function (employeeId) {
          requests.push(
            hrmsLiveRequest(
              "create_employee_promotion",
              {
                employee: employeeId,
                promotion_date:
                  payload.eff || TODAY,
                new_designation:
                  payload.to || "",
                revised_ctc:
                  payload.newCtc || "",
                reason:
                  payload.reason ||
                  description ||
                  "Employee promotion"
              }
            )
          );
        }
      );
    }

    /*
     * Do not create fake browser-memory data.
     */
    else {
      console.warn(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] MISSING LIVE API:",
        type,
        payload
      );

      toast(
        "MISSING LIVE API: " + type +
        ". No data was changed.",
        "err"
      );

      return;
    }

    toast(
      "Saving " + type +
      " in ERP...",
      "wn"
    );

    Promise.all(requests)
      .then(function (results) {
        var message =
          type + " saved in ERP";

        if (
          results.length === 1 &&
          results[0] &&
          results[0].message
        ) {
          message = results[0].message;
        }

        hrmsLiveSuccess(message);
      })
      .catch(hrmsLiveFailure);
  };

  /*
   * Replace browser-memory resignation save.
   * Creates Employee Separation as a Draft.
   */
  saveExit = function () {
    var employeeElement =
      document.getElementById("xe-e");

    var resignationElement =
      document.getElementById("xe-r");

    var lastDayElement =
      document.getElementById("xe-l");

    var typeElement =
      document.getElementById("xe-t");

    var reasonElement =

    var rehireElement =

    if (!employeeElement) {
      toast(
        "Employee field is missing.",
        "err"
      );
      return;
    }

    var employeeId =
      employeeElement.value;

    var resignationDate =
      resignationElement
        ? resignationElement.value
        : TODAY;

    var lastDay =
      lastDayElement
        ? lastDayElement.value
        : "";

    var separationType =
      typeElement
        ? typeElement.value
        : "Resignation";

    var reason =
      reasonElement
        ? reasonElement.value.trim()
        : "";

    var rehire =
      rehireElement
        ? rehireElement.value
        : "";

    if (!reason) {
      toast(
        "Separation reason is required.",
        "err"
      );
      return;
    }

    /*
     * These UI details are placed in the reason/comment
     * until dedicated structured fields are available.
     */
    var fullReason =
      reason +
      " | Type: " + separationType +
      (lastDay
        ? " | Last working day: " + lastDay
        : "") +
      (rehire
        ? " | Rehire eligible: " + rehire
        : "");

    toast(
      "Creating Employee Separation...",
      "wn"
    );

    hrmsLiveRequest(
      "create_employee_separation",
      {
        employee: employeeId,
        boarding_begins_on:
          resignationDate || TODAY,
        reason: fullReason

    .then(function (result) {
      closeModal();

      hrmsLiveSuccess(
        result.message ||

      "No data was changed.",
      "err"
    );
  };

  console.log(
    "[LIFE HRMS 360] Live action API patch loaded"
  );

})();

(function () {

      "[LIFE HRMS 360]",

      "err"

  function liveSuccess(message) {

    message

        )

    }

    toast(
      "Saving in ERP...",
      "wn"
    );

    return window.hrmsLiveRequest(
      action,
      payload
    )
    .then(function (result) {
      liveSuccess(
        (
          result &&
          result.message
        ) || message
      );

      return result;
    })
    .catch(function (error) {
      liveError(error);
      throw error;
    });

      return window.hrmsLiveBranchName(

    return value;
  }

  function realManagerId(value) {
    var selected = String(value || "");

    var employee = EMPLOYEES.filter(
      function (item) {
        return (
          item.id === selected ||
          item.name === selected ||
          (
            item.name +
            " (" +
            item.designation +
            ")"
          ) === selected
        );
      }
    )[0];

    return employee
      ? employee.id
      : selected;

  /*

  requestAction = function (

            "Deactivation": "Inactive",
            "Suspend": "Suspended",

          if (
            [
              "Active",
              "Inactive",
              "Suspended",

          if (!statusValue) {

              "MISSING STATUS MAPPING: " +

        else if (type === "Transfer") {

        else if (

            "Reporting Manager Change",
            "Employment Type Change",
            "Grade Change"
          ].indexOf(type) > -1
        ) {
          var fieldMap = {

                type,

          );

        else if (type === "Role Change") {

                payload.eff || TODAY,
              reason:
                payload.reason ||
                description ||
                "Role change",
              remarks:
                payload.remarks || ""
            }
          );

        else if (type === "Special Duty") {

        else {

      }
    );

    toast(
      "Saving " + type + " in ERP...",
      "wn"
    );

    Promise.all(requests)

        if (

          results[0] &&
          results[0].message
        ) {
          message =
            results[0].message;
        }

        liveSuccess(message);
      })

  /*

<script id="life-hrms-step-26b">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function missingHtml() {
        return '<span class="hrms-field-missing">MISSING</span>';
    }

    function hasValue(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        );
    }

    function valueHtml(value) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return missingHtml();
        }

        return esc(String(value));
    }

    function dateHtml(value) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return missingHtml();
        }

        return fmtD(value);
    }

    function statusHtml(value, completedValue) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return missingHtml();
        }

        return tag(
            String(value),
            String(value) === completedValue
                ? "t-g"
                : "t-y"
        );
    }

    function moneyHtml(value) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return missingHtml();
        }

        return money(Number(value) || 0);
    }

    function rehireHtml(value) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return missingHtml();
        }

        var normalized = String(value);

        if (
            normalized === "1" ||
            normalized === "Yes"
        ) {
            return tag("Yes", "t-g");
        }

        if (
            normalized === "0" ||
            normalized === "No"
        ) {
            return tag("No", "t-r");
        }

        return tag(normalized, "t-y");
    }

    function completedClearance(value) {
        var status = String(value || "")
            .toLowerCase();

        return (
            status === "completed" ||
            status === "cleared" ||
            status === "complete"
        );
    }

    function completedFnf(value) {
        var status = String(value || "")
            .toLowerCase();

        return (
            status === "settled" ||
            status === "completed" ||
            status === "paid"
        );
    }

    window.hrmsExtraMappers =
        window.hrmsExtraMappers || [];

    window.hrmsExtraMappers.push(
        function (data, employeeMap) {
            var rows = data.separations || [];

            Object.keys(employeeMap).forEach(
                function (employeeId) {
                    employeeMap[employeeId].exit = null;
                    employeeMap[employeeId].separations = [];
                }
            );

            rows.forEach(function (row) {
                var employee =
                    employeeMap[row.employee];

                if (!employee) {
                    return;
                }

                var separation = {
                    id: row.name || "",
                    employee: row.employee || "",
                    employeeName:
                        row.employee_name || "",
                    resignDate:
                        row.boarding_begins_on || "",
                    recordedDate:
                        row.creation || "",
                    lastDate:
                        row.custom_last_working_day || "",
                    type:
                        row.custom_separation_type || "",
                    reason:
                        row.custom_separation_reason || "",
                    rehire:
                        row.custom_eligible_for_rehire,
                    clearance:
                        row.custom_clearance_status || "",
                    clearanceCompletedOn:
                        row.custom_clearance_completed_on || "",
                    fnf:
                        row.custom_fnf_status || "",
                    fnfDate:
                        row.custom_fnf_settlement_date || "",
                    fnfAmount:
                        row.custom_fnf_settlement_amount,
                    fnfReference:
                        row.custom_fnf_reference || "",
                    fnfRemarks:
                        row.custom_fnf_remarks || "",
                    settledBy:
                        row.custom_settled_by || "",
                    boardingStatus:
                        row.boarding_status || "",
                    documentStatus:
                        row.docstatus,
                    requestedFromHrms:
                        row.custom_requested_from_hrms,
                    modified:
                        row.modified || ""
                };

                employee.separations.push(separation);

                if (!employee.exit) {
                    employee.exit = separation;
                }
            });
        }
    );

    rExit = function () {
        var scopedEmployees = scoped();

        var exitingEmployees =
            scopedEmployees.filter(
                function (employee) {
                    return !!employee.exit;
                }
            );

        var clearancePending =
            exitingEmployees.filter(
                function (employee) {
                    return !completedClearance(
                        employee.exit.clearance
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var fnfPending =
            exitingEmployees.filter(
                function (employee) {
                    return !completedFnf(
                        employee.exit.fnf
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var onNotice =
            exitingEmployees.filter(
                function (employee) {
                    return (
                        employee.status ===
                            "Notice Period" ||
                        employee.status ===
                            "Resigned" ||
                        (
                            employee.exit &&
                            employee.exit.boardingStatus !==
                                "Completed"
                        )
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var exited =
            exitingEmployees.filter(
                function (employee) {
                    return (
                        employee.status ===
                            "Inactive" ||
                        employee.status ===
                            "Terminated" ||
                        completedFnf(
                            employee.exit.fnf
                        )
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var html = ph(
            "SEPARATION · EXIT",
            "Exit & Full-and-Final Desk",
            "Live Employee Separation, clearance and F&F data from ERPNext.",
            '<button class="btn d" ' +
                'onclick="newExit()">' +
                "＋ Record resignation" +
            "</button>"
        );

        html +=
            '<div class="hrms-source-banner live">' +
                "<i>✓</i>" +
                "<div>" +
                    "<b>LIVE ERP DATA</b>" +
                    "<span>" +
                        exitingEmployees.length +
                        " Employee Separation record(s) mapped" +
                    "</span>" +
                "</div>" +
            "</div>";

        html +=
            '<div class="grid g4" ' +
                'style="margin-bottom:13px">' +
                tile(
                    "On notice",
                    onNotice,
                    "Open separation records",
                    "t-warn"
                ) +
                tile(
                    "Exited",
                    exited,
                    "Completed exits",
                    "t-n"
                ) +
                tile(
                    "Clearance pending",
                    clearancePending,
                    "Not marked completed",
                    "t-crit"
                ) +
                tile(
                    "F&F pending",
                    fnfPending,
                    "Not marked settled",
                    "t-gold"
                ) +
            "</div>";

        var registerBody = "";

        if (exitingEmployees.length) {
            registerBody =
                '<table class="tb">' +
                    "<thead>" +
                        "<tr>" +
                            "<th>Employee</th>" +
                            "<th>Branch</th>" +
                            "<th>Type</th>" +
                            "<th>Resigned</th>" +
                            "<th>Last day</th>" +
                            "<th>Reason</th>" +
                            "<th>Clearance</th>" +
                            "<th>F&F</th>" +
                            '<th class="c">Rehire</th>' +
                            "<th>ERP Record</th>" +
                        "</tr>" +
                    "</thead>" +
                    "<tbody>" +
                    exitingEmployees.map(
                        function (employee) {
                            var exit =
                                employee.exit || {};

                            var clearanceDetails =
                                statusHtml(
                                    exit.clearance,
                                    "Completed"
                                );

                            if (
                                hasValue(
                                    exit.clearanceCompletedOn
                                )
                            ) {
                                clearanceDetails +=
                                    '<div class="sm2">' +
                                    dateHtml(
                                        exit.clearanceCompletedOn
                                    ) +
                                    "</div>";
                            }

                            var fnfDetails =
                                statusHtml(
                                    exit.fnf,
                                    "Settled"
                                );

                            fnfDetails +=
                                '<div class="sm2">' +
                                "Amount: " +
                                moneyHtml(
                                    exit.fnfAmount
                                ) +
                                "</div>";

                            fnfDetails +=
                                '<div class="sm2">' +
                                "Date: " +
                                dateHtml(
                                    exit.fnfDate
                                ) +
                                "</div>";

                            fnfDetails +=
                                '<div class="sm2">' +
                                "Reference: " +
                                valueHtml(
                                    exit.fnfReference
                                ) +
                                "</div>";

                            return (
                                '<tr class="click" ' +
                                    "onclick=\"openEmp('" +
                                    employee.id +
                                    "')\">" +

                                    '<td class="nm">' +
                                        esc(employee.name) +
                                        '<div class="sm2">' +
                                            esc(
                                                employee.designation ||
                                                ""
                                            ) +
                                        "</div>" +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        valueHtml(
                                            employee.branchName
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        valueHtml(exit.type) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        dateHtml(
                                            exit.resignDate
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        dateHtml(
                                            exit.lastDate
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="sm2">' +
                                        valueHtml(
                                            exit.reason
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        clearanceDetails +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        fnfDetails +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="c">' +
                                        rehireHtml(
                                            exit.rehire
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        (
                                            hasValue(exit.id)
                                                ? (
                                                    '<a class="btn sm" ' +
                                                    'target="_blank" ' +
                                                    'onclick="' +
                                                        "event.stopPropagation()" +
                                                    '" href="/app/' +
                                                    'employee-separation/' +
                                                    encodeURIComponent(
                                                        exit.id
                                                    ) +
                                                    '">' +
                                                        esc(exit.id) +
                                                    "</a>"
                                                )
                                                : missingHtml()
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                "</tr>"
                            );
                        }
                    ).join("") +
                    "</tbody>" +
                "</table>";
        } else {
            registerBody =
                '<div class="empty">' +
                    "<b>No live separation records</b>" +
                    "No Employee Separation record exists " +
                    "for the selected scope." +
                "</div>";
        }

        html += acc(
            "🚪 Exit register",
            exitingEmployees.length + " live records",
            exitingEmployees.length
                ? tw(registerBody)
                : registerBody,
            {
                key: "ex-reg",
                cls: "a-warn",
                ic: "▤",
                icCls: "rose",
                flush: !!exitingEmployees.length
            }
        );

        var clearanceBody = "";

        if (exitingEmployees.length) {
            clearanceBody =
                '<table class="tb">' +
                    "<thead>" +
                        "<tr>" +
                            "<th>Employee</th>" +
                            "<th>Separation</th>" +
                            "<th>Clearance Status</th>" +
                            "<th>Completed On</th>" +
                            "<th>Boarding Status</th>" +
                        "</tr>" +
                    "</thead>" +
                    "<tbody>" +
                    exitingEmployees.map(
                        function (employee) {
                            var exit =
                                employee.exit || {};

                            return (
                                "<tr>" +
                                    '<td class="nm">' +
                                        esc(employee.name) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                    "<td>" +
                                        valueHtml(exit.id) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                    "<td>" +
                                        statusHtml(
                                            exit.clearance,
                                            "Completed"
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                    "<td>" +
                                        dateHtml(
                                            exit.clearanceCompletedOn
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                    "<td>" +
                                        valueHtml(
                                            exit.boardingStatus
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                "</tr>"
                            );
                        }
                    ).join("") +
                    "</tbody>" +
                "</table>";
        } else {
            clearanceBody =
                '<div class="empty">' +
                    "<b>No clearance data</b>" +
                    "Live Employee Separation records are unavailable." +
                "</div>";
        }

        html += acc(
            "📋 Clearance status",
            "Live overall clearance status",
            exitingEmployees.length
                ? tw(clearanceBody)
                : clearanceBody,
            {
                key: "ex-clr",
                ic: "▣",
                icCls: "slate",
                flush: !!exitingEmployees.length
            }
        );

        var fnfRows =
            exitingEmployees.map(
                function (employee) {
                    var exit =
                        employee.exit || {};

                    return (
                        "<tr>" +
                            '<td class="nm">' +
                                esc(employee.name) +
                            "</td>" +
                            "<td>" +
                                valueHtml(exit.id) +
                            "</td>" +
                            "<td>" +
                                statusHtml(
                                    exit.fnf,
                                    "Settled"
                                ) +
                            "</td>" +
                            '<td class="r tnum">' +
                                moneyHtml(
                                    exit.fnfAmount
                                ) +
                            "</td>" +
                            "<td>" +
                                dateHtml(exit.fnfDate) +
                            "</td>" +
                            "<td>" +
                                valueHtml(
                                    exit.fnfReference
                                ) +
                            "</td>" +
                            "<td>" +
                                valueHtml(
                                    exit.settledBy
                                ) +
                            "</td>" +
                            '<td class="sm2">' +
                                valueHtml(
                                    exit.fnfRemarks
                                ) +
                            "</td>" +
                        "</tr>"
                    );
                }
            ).join("");

        var fnfBody = exitingEmployees.length
            ? tw(
                '<table class="tb">' +
                    "<thead>" +
                        "<tr>" +
                            "<th>Employee</th>" +
                            "<th>Separation</th>" +
                            "<th>Status</th>" +
                            '<th class="r">Amount</th>' +
                            "<th>Settlement Date</th>" +
                            "<th>Reference</th>" +
                            "<th>Settled By</th>" +
                            "<th>Remarks</th>" +
                        "</tr>" +
                    "</thead>" +
                    "<tbody>" +
                        fnfRows +
                    "</tbody>" +
                "</table>"
            )
            : (
                '<div class="empty">' +
                    "<b>No F&F data</b>" +
                    "Live Employee Separation records are unavailable." +
                "</div>"
            );

        html += acc(
            "💰 Full & Final settlement",
            fnfPending + " pending",
            fnfBody,
            {
                key: "ex-fnf",
                cls: fnfPending
                    ? "a-crit"
                    : "",
                ic: "₹",
                icCls: "gold",
                flush: !!exitingEmployees.length
            }
        );

        var reasonCounts = {};

        exitingEmployees.forEach(
            function (employee) {
                var reason =
                    employee.exit &&
                    employee.exit.reason;

                if (!hasValue(reason)) {
                    return;
                }

                reasonCounts[reason] =
                    (reasonCounts[reason] || 0) + 1;
            }
        );

        var reasonNames =
            Object.keys(reasonCounts);

        var reasonBody = "";

        if (reasonNames.length) {
            var highest = Math.max.apply(
                Math,
                reasonNames.map(
                    function (reason) {
                        return reasonCounts[reason];
                    }
                )
            );

            reasonBody = reasonNames.map(
                function (reason) {
                    var count =
                        reasonCounts[reason];

                    return (
                        '<div class="hbar">' +
                            '<div class="lb">' +
                                esc(reason) +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="tr">' +
                                bar(
                                    count / highest * 100,
                                    "c"
                                ) +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="vl">' +
                                count +
                                (
                                    count === 1
                                        ? " exit"
                                        : " exits"
                                ) +

                    );

            ).join("");

            reasonBody =

                    "No live separation reasons are available." +

        html += acc(
            "📉 Attrition reasons",
            reasonNames.length + " live reasons",
            reasonBody,
            {
                key: "ex-att",
                ic: "▨",

            }
        );

    };

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 26B live " +
        "Separation/Clearance/F&F mapping loaded"
    );

<script id="life-hrms-step-26c">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function hasExitValue(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        );
    }

    function missingExitValue() {
        return (
            '<span class="hrms-field-missing">' +
                "MISSING" +
            "</span>"
        );
    }

    function exitText(value) {
        if (!hasExitValue(value)) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        return esc(String(value));
    }

    function exitDate(value) {
        if (!hasExitValue(value)) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        return fmtDL(value);
    }

    function exitMoney(value) {
        if (!hasExitValue(value)) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        return money(Number(value) || 0);
    }

    function exitStatus(
        value,
        completedValues
    ) {
        if (!hasExitValue(value)) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        var current =
            String(value).toLowerCase();

        var completed =
            completedValues.some(
                function (item) {
                    return (
                        current ===
                        String(item).toLowerCase()
                    );
                }
            );

        return tag(
            String(value),
            completed ? "t-g" : "t-y"
        );
    }

    function exitRehire(value) {
        if (!hasExitValue(value)) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        var current = String(value);

        if (
            current === "1" ||
            current === "Yes"
        ) {
            return tag("Yes", "t-g");
        }

        if (
            current === "0" ||
            current === "No"
        ) {
            return tag("No", "t-r");
        }

        return tag(current, "t-y");
    }

    function exitDocumentStatus(value) {
        if (
            value === undefined ||
            value === null
        ) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        if (Number(value) === 1) {
            return tag("Submitted", "t-g");
        }

        if (Number(value) === 0) {
            return tag("Draft", "t-y");
        }

        if (Number(value) === 2) {
            return tag("Cancelled", "t-r");
        }

        return exitText(value);
    }

    function exitErpLink(exit) {
        if (!hasExitValue(exit.id)) {
            return missingExitValue();
        }

        return (
            '<a class="btn sm" ' +
                'target="_blank" ' +
                'href="/app/employee-separation/' +
                encodeURIComponent(exit.id) +
            '">' +
                esc(exit.id) +
            "</a>"
        );
    }

    function renderExitRecord(exit) {
        return (
            '<div class="hrms-source-banner live">' +
                "<i>✓</i>" +
                "<div>" +
                    "<b>LIVE EMPLOYEE SEPARATION</b>" +
                    "<span>" +
                        exitErpLink(exit) +
                    "</span>" +
                "</div>" +
            "</div>" +

            '<div class="dgrid">' +
                df(
                    "Separation Record",
                    exitErpLink(exit)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Document Status",
                    exitDocumentStatus(
                        exit.documentStatus
                    )
                ) +

                df(
                    "Separation Type",
                    exitText(exit.type)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Separation Start Date",
                    exitDate(exit.resignDate)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Last Working Day",
                    exitDate(exit.lastDate)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Separation Reason",
                    exitText(exit.reason)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Eligible for Rehire",
                    exitRehire(exit.rehire)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Boarding Status",
                    exitStatus(
                        exit.boardingStatus,
                        ["Completed"]
                    )
                ) +

                df(
                    "Clearance Status",
                    exitStatus(
                        exit.clearance,
                        [
                            "Completed",
                            "Cleared",
                            "Complete"
                        ]
                    )
                ) +

                df(
                    "Clearance Completed On",
                    exitDate(
                        exit.clearanceCompletedOn
                    )
                ) +

                df(
                    "F&F Status",
                    exitStatus(
                        exit.fnf,
                        [
                            "Settled",
                            "Completed",
                            "Paid"
                        ]
                    )
                ) +

                df(
                    "F&F Settlement Date",
                    exitDate(exit.fnfDate)
                ) +

                df(
                    "F&F Settlement Amount",
                    exitMoney(exit.fnfAmount)
                ) +

                df(
                    "F&F Reference",
                    exitText(exit.fnfReference)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Settled By",
                    exitText(exit.settledBy)
                ) +

                df(
                    "F&F Remarks",
                    exitText(exit.fnfRemarks)
                ) +

                df(
                    "Requested From HRMS 360",
                    (
                        exit.requestedFromHrms === 1 ||
                        exit.requestedFromHrms === "1"
                    )
                        ? tag("Yes", "t-g")
                        : (
                            exit.requestedFromHrms === 0 ||
                            exit.requestedFromHrms === "0"
                        )
                            ? tag("No", "t-n")
                            : missingExitValue()
                ) +

                df(
                    "Last Updated",
                    exitDate(exit.modified)
                ) +
            "</div>"
        );
    }

    window.renderLiveExitProfile = function (
        employee,
        keyPrefix
    ) {
        var records =
            employee.separations || [];

        if (
            !records.length &&
            employee.exit
        ) {
            records = [employee.exit];
        }

        var content = "";

        if (!records.length) {
            content =
                '<div class="empty">' +
                    "<b>No separation record</b>" +
                    "No live Employee Separation record " +
                    "exists for this employee." +
                "</div>";
        } else {
            content = records.map(
                function (exit, index) {
                    var heading =
                        records.length > 1
                            ? (
                                '<div class="note n-i" ' +
                                    'style="margin:' +
                                    (
                                        index === 0
                                            ? "0"
                                            : "14px 0 8px"
                                    ) +
                                    '">' +
                                    "<b>Separation Record " +
                                    (index + 1) +
                                    "</b></div>"
                            )
                            : "";

                    return (
                        heading +
                        renderExitRecord(exit)
                    );
                }
            ).join("");
        }

        return acc(
            "18 · 🚪 Exit / Rejoin",
            records.length
                ? (
                    records.length +
                    (
                        records.length === 1
                            ? " live record"
                            : " live records"
                    )
                )
                : "Not applicable",
            content,
            {
                key: keyPrefix + "18",
                cls: records.length
                    ? "a-warn"
                    : "",
                ic: "⑱",
                icCls: "rose",
                open: false
            }
        );
    };

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 26C " +
        "Employee profile exit mapping loaded"
    );
})();

</script>

<script id="life-hrms-step-26d">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function actionElement(id) {
        return document.getElementById(id);
    }

    function actionValue(id) {
        var element = actionElement(id);

        if (!element) {
            return "";
        }

        return String(element.value || "").trim();
    }

    function actionError(error) {
        console.error(
            "[LIFE HRMS 360]",
            error
        );

        toast(
            error && error.message
                ? error.message
                : "ERP update failed.",
            "err"
        );
    }

    function actionSuccess(message) {
        closeModal();

        toast(
            message || "ERP record updated",
            "ok"
        );

        window.setTimeout(
            function () {
                window.location.reload();
            },
            700
        );
    }

    function validSeparationId(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||

                        );

(function () {

        text = text.replace(
            /"/gi,
            '"'
        );

        text = text.replace(
            /'/gi,
            "'"
        );

        text = text.replace(
            /\s+/g,
            " "
        );

        return text.trim();
    }

    function auditUser(row) {
        return (
            row.comment_by ||
            row.comment_email ||
            row.owner ||
            "ERPNext"
        );
    }

    function fieldLabel(fieldname) {
        var labels = {
            boarding_status:
                "Separation Status",
            custom_separation_reason:
                "Separation Reason",
            custom_separation_type:
                "Separation Type",
            custom_last_working_day:
                "Last Working Day",
            custom_eligible_for_rehire:
                "Eligible for Rehire",
            custom_clearance_status:
                "Clearance Status",
            custom_clearance_completed_on:
                "Clearance Completed On",
            custom_fnf_status:
                "F&F Status",
            custom_fnf_settlement_date:
                "F&F Settlement Date",
            custom_fnf_settlement_amount:
                "F&F Settlement Amount",
            custom_fnf_reference:
                "F&F Reference",
            custom_fnf_remarks:
                "F&F Remarks",
            custom_settled_by:
                "Settled By",
            docstatus:
                "Document Status"
        };

        return (
            labels[fieldname] ||
            String(fieldname || "")
                .replace(/^custom_/, "")
                .replace(/_/g, " ")
        );
    }

    function displayAuditValue(value) {
        if (
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        ) {
            return "MISSING";
        }

        if (
            value === 0 ||
            value === "0"
        ) {
            return "No";
        }

        if (
            value === 1 ||
            value === "1"
        ) {
            return "Yes";
        }

        return cleanAuditText(value);
    }

    function versionSummary(row) {
        var parsed = null;

        try {
            parsed = JSON.parse(
                row.data || "{}"
            );
        } catch (error) {
            console.warn(
                "[LIFE HRMS 360] Invalid Version data",
                row.name,
                error
            );

            return (
                "Employee Separation record changed"
            );
        }

        var changes =
            parsed.changed || [];

        if (!Array.isArray(changes)) {
            changes = [];
        }

        var summaries = changes.map(
            function (change) {
                if (
                    !Array.isArray(change) ||
                    !change.length
                ) {
                    return "";
                }

                var fieldname =
                    change[0] || "";

                var oldValue =
                    change.length > 1
                        ? change[1]
                        : "";

                var newValue =
                    change.length > 2
                        ? change[2]
                        : "";

                return (
                    fieldLabel(fieldname) +
                    ": " +
                    displayAuditValue(oldValue) +
                    " → " +
                    displayAuditValue(newValue)
                );
            }
        ).filter(
            function (summary) {
                return !!summary;
            }
        );

        if (summaries.length) {
            return summaries.join(" · ");
        }

        if (
            parsed.added &&
            parsed.added.length
        ) {
            return (
                "Employee Separation rows added"
            );
        }

        if (
            parsed.removed &&
            parsed.removed.length
        ) {
            return (
                "Employee Separation rows removed"
            );
        }

        return (
            "Employee Separation record changed"
        );
    }

    function appendUniqueAudit(
        employee,
        event
    ) {
        employee.audit =
            employee.audit || [];

        employee.separationAudit =
            employee.separationAudit || [];

        var exists =
            employee.separationAudit.some(
                function (existing) {
                    return (
                        existing.liveKey ===
                        event.liveKey
                    );
                }
            );

        if (exists) {
            return;
        }

        employee.separationAudit.push(
            event
        );

        employee.audit.push({
            date: event.date,
            by: event.by,
            what: event.what,
            liveKey: event.liveKey,
            source: "Employee Separation"
        });
    }

    window.hrmsExtraMappers =
        window.hrmsExtraMappers || [];

    window.hrmsExtraMappers.push(
        function (data, employeeMap) {
            var separationToEmployee = {};

            Object.keys(employeeMap).forEach(
                function (employeeId) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeMap[employeeId];

                    employee.separationAudit = [];

                    (
                        employee.separations || []
                    ).forEach(
                        function (separation) {
                            if (separation.id) {
                                separationToEmployee[
                                    separation.id
                                ] = employeeId;
                            }
                        }
                    );

                    if (
                        employee.exit &&
                        employee.exit.id
                    ) {
                        separationToEmployee[
                            employee.exit.id
                        ] = employeeId;
                    }
                }
            );

            (
                data.separation_comments || []
            ).forEach(function (row) {
                var employeeId =
                    separationToEmployee[
                        row.reference_name
                    ];

                var employee =
                    employeeMap[employeeId];

                if (!employee) {
                    return;
                }

                var detail =
                    cleanAuditText(
                        row.content
                    );

                if (!detail) {
                    detail =
                        "Employee Separation comment";
                }

                appendUniqueAudit(
                    employee,
                    {
                        liveKey:
                            "COMMENT-" +
                            row.name,
                        date:
                            row.creation ||
                            row.modified ||
                            "",
                        by:
                            auditUser(row),
                        what:
                            "Separation comment: " +
                            detail,
                        kind:
                            "Comment",
                        reference:
                            row.reference_name,
                        sourceName:
                            row.name
                    }
                );
            });

            (
                data.separation_versions || []
            ).forEach(function (row) {
                var employeeId =
                    separationToEmployee[
                        row.docname
                    ];

                var employee =
                    employeeMap[employeeId];

                if (!employee) {
                    return;
                }

                appendUniqueAudit(
                    employee,
                    {
                        liveKey:
                            "VERSION-" +
                            row.name,
                        date:
                            row.creation ||
                            row.modified ||
                            "",
                        by:
                            row.owner ||
                            "ERPNext",
                        what:
                            versionSummary(row),
                        kind:
                            "Version",
                        reference:
                            row.docname,
                        sourceName:
                            row.name
                    }
                );
            });

            Object.keys(employeeMap).forEach(
                function (employeeId) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeMap[employeeId];

                    employee.separationAudit.sort(
                        function (left, right) {
                            return (
                                new Date(right.date) -
                                new Date(left.date)
                            );
                        }
                    );

                    employee.audit.sort(
                        function (left, right) {
                            return (
                                new Date(right.date) -
                                new Date(left.date)
                            );
                        }
                    );
                }
            );

            window.LIFE_HRMS_SEPARATION_AUDIT = {
                comments:
                    data.separation_comments || [],
                versions:
                    data.separation_versions || []
            };
        }
    );

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 26G-B " +
        "separation audit mapping loaded"
    );
})();

</script>

        "Exit filters and Excel export loaded"
    );
})();
