<script id="life-hrms-step-26i">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function statusValue(value) {
        return String(
            value || ""
        ).trim().toLowerCase();
    }

    function hasAlertValue(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        );
    }

    function alertDate(value) {
        if (!hasAlertValue(value)) {
            return (
                '<span class="hrms-field-missing">' +
                    "MISSING" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        return fmtD(value);
    }

    function alertText(value) {
        if (!hasAlertValue(value)) {
            return (
                '<span class="hrms-field-missing">' +
                    "MISSING" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        return esc(String(value));
    }

    window.hrmsSeparationAlerts =
        function () {
            var employees =
                typeof scoped === "function"
                    ? scoped()
                    : [];

            var alerts = [];

            employees.forEach(
                function (employee) {
                    var exit =
                        employee.exit;

                    if (!exit) {
                        return;
                    }

                    var clearance =
                        statusValue(
                            exit.clearance
                        );

                    var fnf =
                        statusValue(exit.fnf);

                    var lastDate =
                        String(
                            exit.lastDate || ""
                        );

                    var fnfSettled =
                        fnf === "settled" ||
                        fnf === "completed" ||
                        fnf === "paid";

                    if (
                        clearance === "blocked"
                    ) {
                        alerts.push({
                            level: "Critical",
                            code: "CLEARANCE_BLOCKED",
                            employee: employee,
                            exit: exit,
                            title:
                                "Clearance is blocked",
                            detail:
                                exit.clearance ||
                                "Blocked",
                            date:
                                exit.clearanceCompletedOn ||
                                exit.modified ||
                                ""
                        });
                    }

                    if (
                        lastDate &&
                        lastDate < TODAY &&
                        !fnfSettled
                    ) {
                        alerts.push({
                            level: "Critical",
                            code: "EXIT_OVERDUE",
                            employee: employee,
                            exit: exit,
                            title:
                                "Exit completion overdue",
                            detail:
                                "Last working day passed; " +
                                "F&F is not settled",
                            date: lastDate
                        });
                    }

                    if (
                        lastDate &&
                        lastDate <= TODAY &&
                        !fnfSettled
                    ) {
                        alerts.push({
                            level: "Warning",
                            code: "FNF_PENDING",
                            employee: employee,
                            exit: exit,
                            title:
                                "F&F settlement pending",
                            detail:
                                exit.fnf ||
                                "MISSING",
                            date: lastDate
                        });
                    }

                    if (
                        lastDate &&
                        lastDate >= TODAY &&
                        typeof addD === "function" &&
                        lastDate <= addD(TODAY, 7) &&
                        !fnfSettled
                    ) {
                        alerts.push({
                            level: "Information",
                            code: "EXIT_DUE_SOON",
                            employee: employee,
                            exit: exit,
                            title:
                                "Last working day due soon",
                            detail:
                                "Due within seven days",
                            date: lastDate
                        });
                    }

                    var missingFields = [];

                    if (!hasAlertValue(exit.id)) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "Separation ID"
                        );
                    }

                    if (!hasAlertValue(exit.type)) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "Separation Type"
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        !hasAlertValue(
                            exit.resignDate
                        )
                    ) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "Separation Start Date"
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        !hasAlertValue(
                            exit.lastDate
                        )
                    ) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "Last Working Day"
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        !hasAlertValue(
                            exit.reason
                        )
                    ) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "Separation Reason"
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        !hasAlertValue(
                            exit.clearance
                        )
                    ) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "Clearance Status"
                        );
                    }

                    if (!hasAlertValue(exit.fnf)) {
                        missingFields.push(
                            "F&F Status"
                        );
                    }

                    if (missingFields.length) {
                        alerts.push({
                            level: "Warning",
                            code: "EXIT_DATA_MISSING",
                            employee: employee,
                            exit: exit,
                            title:
                                "Separation data is missing",
                            detail:
                                missingFields.join(", "),
                            date:
                                exit.modified ||
                                exit.recordedDate ||
                                ""
                        });
                    }
                }
            );

            alerts.sort(
                function (left, right) {
                    var priority = {
                        Critical: 1,
                        Warning: 2,
                        Information: 3
                    };

                    var levelDifference =
                        priority[left.level] -
                        priority[right.level];

                    if (levelDifference !== 0) {
                        return levelDifference;
                    }

                    return (
                        new Date(
                            right.date || 0
                        ) -
                        new Date(
                            left.date || 0
                        )
                    );
                }
            );

            return alerts;
        };

    function alertClass(level) {
        if (level === "Critical") {
            return "t-r";
        }

        if (level === "Warning") {
            return "t-y";
        }

        return "t-b";
    }

    function renderSeparationAlertTable(
        alerts
    ) {
        if (!alerts.length) {
            return (
                '<div class="empty">' +
                    "<b>No separation alerts</b>" +
                    "No live separation action is " +
                    "currently overdue or blocked." +
                "</div>"
            );
        }

        return tw(
            '<table class="tb">' +
                "<thead>" +
                    "<tr>" +
                        "<th>Priority</th>" +
                        "<th>Employee</th>" +
                        "<th>Branch</th>" +
                        "<th>Alert</th>" +
                        "<th>Details</th>" +
                        "<th>Date</th>" +
                        "<th>Separation</th>" +
                    "</tr>" +
                "</thead>" +
                "<tbody>" +
                    alerts.map(
                        function (alert) {
                            return (
                                '<tr class="click" ' +
                                    "onclick=\"openEmp('" +
                                        alert.employee.id +
                                    "')\">" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        tag(
                                            alert.level,
                                            alertClass(
                                                alert.level
                                            )
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="nm">' +
                                        esc(
                                            alert.employee.name
                                        ) +
                                        '<div class="sm2">' +
                                            esc(
                                                alert.employee.id
                                            ) +
                                        "</div>" +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        alertText(
                                            alert.employee
                                                .branchName
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        alertText(
                                            alert.title
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="sm2">' +
                                        alertText(
                                            alert.detail
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        alertDate(
                                            alert.date
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        (
                                            hasAlertValue(
                                                alert.exit.id
                                            )
                                                ? (
                                                    '<a class="btn sm" ' +
                                                        'target="_blank" ' +
                                                        'onclick="' +
                                                            "event.stopPropagation()" +
                                                        '" href="/app/' +
                                                        'employee-separation/' +
                                                        encodeURIComponent(
                                                            alert.exit.id
                                                        ) +
                                                    '">' +
                                                        esc(
                                                            alert.exit.id
                                                        ) +
                                                    "</a>"
                                                )
                                                : (
                                                    '<span class="' +
                                                        'hrms-field-missing">' +
                                                        "MISSING" +
                                                    "</span>"
                                                )
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +
                                "</tr>"
                            );
                        }
                    ).join("") +
                "</tbody>" +
            "</table>"
        );
    }

    function separationAlertPanel(
        compact
    ) {
        var alerts =
            hrmsSeparationAlerts();

        var critical =
            alerts.filter(
                function (alert) {
                    return (
                        alert.level ===
                        "Critical"
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var warning =
            alerts.filter(
                function (alert) {
                    return (
                        alert.level ===
                        "Warning"
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var information =
            alerts.filter(
                function (alert) {
                    return (
                        alert.level ===
                        "Information"
                    );
                }
            ).length;

        var tiles =
            '<div class="grid g4" ' +
                'style="margin-bottom:12px">' +
                tile(
                    "Separation Alerts",
                    alerts.length,
                    "Live action items",
                    alerts.length
                        ? "t-crit"
                        : "t-ok",
                    "go('alerts')"
                ) +
                tile(
                    "Critical",
                    critical,
                    "Blocked or overdue",
                    "t-crit",
                    "go('exitdesk')"
                ) +
                tile(
                    "Warnings",
                    warning,
                    "Pending or missing",
                    "t-warn",
                    "go('exitdesk')"
                ) +
                tile(
                    "Due Soon",
                    information,
                    "Within seven days",
                    "t-info",
                    "go('exitdesk')"
                ) +
            "</div>";

        if (compact) {
            return (
                '<div class="card">' +
                    "<header>" +
                        '<i class="ic rose">!</i>' +
                        "<h3>Separation Alerts</h3>" +
                        '<span class="sp"></span>' +
                        (
                            alerts.length
                                ? tag(
                                    alerts.length +
                                    " action items",
                                    "t-r"
                                )
                                : tag(
                                    "No alerts",
                                    "t-g"
                                )
                        ) +
                        '<button class="btn sm" ' +
                            "onclick=\"go('exitdesk')\">" +
                            "Open Exit Desk" +
                        "</button>" +
                    "</header>" +
                    '<div class="body">' +
                        tiles +
                    "</div>" +
                "</div>"
            );
        }

        return (
            tiles +
            acc(
                "🚨 Separation, Clearance & F&F Alerts",
                alerts.length + " action items",
                renderSeparationAlertTable(
                    alerts
                ),
                {
                    key: "separation-alerts",
                    cls: alerts.length
                        ? "a-crit"
                        : "",
                    ic: "!",
                    icCls: "rose",
                    flush: !!alerts.length,
                    open: true
                }
            )
        );
    }

    var originalCounts =
        window.counts;

    window.counts = function () {
        var result =
            originalCounts();

        var separationAlerts =
            hrmsSeparationAlerts();

        result.alerts =
            Number(result.alerts || 0) +
            separationAlerts.length;

        result.exitdesk =
            separationAlerts.length;

        return result;
    };

    var originalDashboard =
        window.rDash;

    window.rDash = function () {
        var rendered =
            originalDashboard();

        var insertionPoint =
            '<div class="grid g6"';

        var alertPanel =
            separationAlertPanel(true);

        if (
            rendered.indexOf(
                insertionPoint
            ) !== -1
        ) {
            rendered = rendered.replace(
                insertionPoint,
                alertPanel +
                insertionPoint
            );
        } else {
            rendered =
                alertPanel + rendered;
        }

        return rendered;
    };

    var originalAlerts =
        window.rAlerts;

    window.rAlerts = function () {
        var rendered =
            originalAlerts();

        return (
            rendered +
            separationAlertPanel(false)
        );
    };

    var originalExit =
        window.rExit;

    window.rExit = function () {
        var rendered =
            originalExit();

        var insertionPoint =
            '<div class="card" ' +
            'style="margin-bottom:13px">';

        var alertPanel =
            separationAlertPanel(false);

        if (
            rendered.indexOf(
                insertionPoint
            ) !== -1
        ) {
            rendered = rendered.replace(
                insertionPoint,
                alertPanel +
                insertionPoint
            );
        } else {
            rendered =
                alertPanel + rendered;
        }

        return rendered;
    };

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 26I " +
        "live separation alerts loaded"
    );
})();

</script>

<script id="life-hrms-step-26j-b">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    window.LIFE_EXIT_INDEX = {
        byEmployee: {},
        bySeparation: {},
        employeesWithExit: [],
        generation: 0
    };

    window.LIFE_EXIT_ALERT_CACHE = {
        generation: -1,
        scopeKey: "",
        alerts: []
    };

    function currentScopeKey() {
        return [
            typeof CUR !== "undefined"
                ? CUR
                : "ALL",
            typeof CURDEPT !== "undefined"
                ? CURDEPT
                : "ALL",
            typeof CURSTAT !== "undefined"
                ? CURSTAT
                : "ALL"
        ].join("|");
    }

    function clearExitCaches() {
        LIFE_EXIT_ALERT_CACHE = {
            generation: -1,
            scopeKey: "",
            alerts: []
        };
    }

    function rebuildExitIndex(
        employeeMap
    ) {
        var byEmployee = {};
        var bySeparation = {};
        var employeesWithExit = [];

        Object.keys(employeeMap || {}).forEach(
            function (employeeId) {
                var employee =
                    employeeMap[employeeId];

                if (!employee) {
                    return;
                }

                byEmployee[employeeId] =
                    employee;

                var records =
                    employee.separations || [];

                if (
                    !records.length
                    && employee.exit
                ) {
                    records = [
                        employee.exit
                    ];
                }

                if (records.length) {
                    employeesWithExit.push(
                        employee
                    );
                }

                records.forEach(
                    function (separation) {
                        if (
                            separation
                            && separation.id
                        ) {
                            bySeparation[
                                separation.id
                            ] = {
                                employee:
                                    employee,
                                separation:
                                    separation
                            };
                        }
                    }
                );
            }
        );

        LIFE_EXIT_INDEX = {
            byEmployee: byEmployee,
            bySeparation: bySeparation,
            employeesWithExit:
                employeesWithExit,
            generation:
                Number(
                    LIFE_EXIT_INDEX.generation ||
                    0
                ) + 1
        };

        clearExitCaches();
    }

    window.hrmsClearExitCaches =
        clearExitCaches;

    window.hrmsRebuildExitIndex =
        rebuildExitIndex;

    window.hrmsFindIndexedEmployee =
        function (employeeId) {
            return (
                LIFE_EXIT_INDEX.byEmployee[
                    employeeId
                ] || null
            );
        };

    window.hrmsFindIndexedSeparation =
        function (separationId) {
            return (
                LIFE_EXIT_INDEX.bySeparation[
                    separationId
                ] || null
            );
        };

    window.hrmsExtraMappers =
        window.hrmsExtraMappers || [];

    window.hrmsExtraMappers.push(
        function (data, employeeMap) {
            rebuildExitIndex(
                employeeMap
            );
        }
    );

    var originalSeparationAlerts =
        window.hrmsSeparationAlerts;

    if (
        typeof originalSeparationAlerts ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.hrmsSeparationAlerts =
            function () {
                var scopeKey =
                    currentScopeKey();

                var generation =
                    LIFE_EXIT_INDEX.generation;

                if (
                    LIFE_EXIT_ALERT_CACHE
                        .generation === generation
                    &&
                    LIFE_EXIT_ALERT_CACHE
                        .scopeKey === scopeKey
                ) {
                    return (
                        LIFE_EXIT_ALERT_CACHE
                            .alerts
                    );
                }

                var alerts =
                    originalSeparationAlerts();

                LIFE_EXIT_ALERT_CACHE = {
                    generation: generation,
                    scopeKey: scopeKey,
                    alerts: alerts
                };

                return alerts;
            };
    }

    var originalSetBranch =
        window.setBranch;

    if (
        typeof originalSetBranch ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.setBranch = function (
            branch
        ) {
            clearExitCaches();

            return originalSetBranch(
                branch
            );
        };
    }

    var originalSetDepartment =
        window.setDept;

    if (
        typeof originalSetDepartment ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.setDept = function (
            department
        ) {
            clearExitCaches();

            return originalSetDepartment(
                department
            );
        };
    }

    var originalSetStatus =
        window.setStat;

    if (
        typeof originalSetStatus ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.setStat = function (
            status
        ) {
            clearExitCaches();

            return originalSetStatus(
                status
            );
        };
    }

    var originalFilteredExits =
        window.hrmsFilteredExitEmployees;

    if (
        typeof originalFilteredExits ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.hrmsFilteredExitEmployees =
            function () {
                return originalFilteredExits();
            };
    }

    var originalApplyFilters =
        window.hrmsApplyExitFilters;

    var pendingFilterFrame = null;

    if (
        typeof originalApplyFilters ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.hrmsApplyExitFilters =
            function () {
                if (pendingFilterFrame) {
                    window.cancelAnimationFrame(
                        pendingFilterFrame
                    );
                }

                pendingFilterFrame =
                    window.requestAnimationFrame(
                        function () {
                            pendingFilterFrame = null;

                            originalApplyFilters();
                        }
                    );
            };
    }

    var originalExportExitExcel =
        window.hrmsExportExitExcel;

    if (
        typeof originalExportExitExcel ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.hrmsExportExitExcel =
            function () {
                if (pendingFilterFrame) {
                    window.cancelAnimationFrame(
                        pendingFilterFrame
                    );

                    pendingFilterFrame = null;

                    originalApplyFilters();
                }

                return originalExportExitExcel();
            };
    }

    window.addEventListener(
        "beforeunload",
        function () {
            if (pendingFilterFrame) {
                window.cancelAnimationFrame(
                    pendingFilterFrame
                );
            }
        }
    );

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 26J-B " +
        "frontend performance optimization loaded"
    );
})();

</script>

<script id="life-hrms-step-26k">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function diagnosticHasValue(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        );
    }

    function diagnosticText(value) {
        if (!diagnosticHasValue(value)) {
            return (
                '<span class="hrms-field-missing">' +
                    "MISSING" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        return esc(String(value));
    }

    window.hrmsSeparationHealth =
        function () {
            var liveData =
                window.LIFE_HRMS_LIVE || {};

            var liveSeparations =
                liveData.separations || [];

            var employeeIndex =
                window.LIFE_EXIT_INDEX &&
                LIFE_EXIT_INDEX.byEmployee
                    ? LIFE_EXIT_INDEX.byEmployee
                    : {};

            var auditData =
                window.LIFE_HRMS_SEPARATION_AUDIT ||
                {
                    comments: [],
                    versions: []
                };

            var fieldDefinitions = [
                {
                    key: "type",
                    label: "Separation Type"
                },
                {
                    key: "resignDate",
                    label: "Separation Start Date"
                },
                {
                    key: "lastDate",
                    label: "Last Working Day"
                },
                {
                    key: "reason",
                    label: "Separation Reason"
                },
                {
                    key: "rehire",
                    label: "Eligible for Rehire"
                },
                {
                    key: "clearance",
                    label: "Clearance Status"
                },
                {
                    key: "fnf",
                    label: "F&F Status"
                }
            ];

            var records = [];
            var missingCounts = {};
            var orphanRecords = [];
            var duplicateEmployees = [];

            fieldDefinitions.forEach(
                function (field) {
                    missingCounts[
                        field.key
                    ] = 0;
                }
            );

            liveSeparations.forEach(
                function (row) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeIndex[
                            row.employee
                        ];

                    if (!employee) {
                        orphanRecords.push({
                            separation:
                                row.name || "",
                            employee:
                                row.employee || "",
                            employeeName:
                                row.employee_name || ""
                        });

                        return;
                    }

                    var separation = null;

                    (
                        employee.separations || []
                    ).some(
                        function (record) {
                            if (
                                String(
                                    record.id || ""
                                ) ===
                                String(
                                    row.name || ""
                                )
                            ) {
                                separation = record;
                                return true;
                            }

                            return false;
                        }
                    );

                    if (
                        !separation &&
                        employee.exit
                    ) {
                        separation =
                            employee.exit;
                    }

                    if (!separation) {
                        orphanRecords.push({
                            separation:
                                row.name || "",
                            employee:
                                row.employee || "",
                            employeeName:
                                row.employee_name || ""
                        });

                        return;
                    }

                    var missing = [];

                    fieldDefinitions.forEach(
                        function (field) {
                            if (
                                !diagnosticHasValue(
                                    separation[
                                        field.key
                                    ]
                                )
                            ) {
                                missing.push(
                                    field.label
                                );

                                missingCounts[
                                    field.key
                                ] += 1;
                            }
                        }
                    );

                    records.push({
                        employee:
                            employee,
                        separation:
                            separation,
                        missing:
                            missing
                    });
                }
            );

            Object.keys(employeeIndex).forEach(
                function (employeeId) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeIndex[
                            employeeId
                        ];

                    var separationCount =
                        (
                            employee.separations ||
                            []
                        ).length;

                    if (separationCount > 1) {
                        duplicateEmployees.push({
                            employee:
                                employee,
                            count:
                                separationCount
                        });
                    }
                }
            );

            var missingTotal =
                Object.keys(
                    missingCounts
                ).reduce(
                    function (total, key) {
                        return (
                            total +
                            missingCounts[key]
                        );
                    },
                    0
                );

            var status = "Healthy";

            if (
                orphanRecords.length ||
                missingTotal
            ) {
                status = "Needs Attention";
            }

            if (
                !liveSeparations.length
            ) {
                status = "No Live Records";
            }

            return {
                status: status,
                total:
                    liveSeparations.length,
                mapped:
                    records.length,
                missingTotal:
                    missingTotal,
                missingCounts:
                    missingCounts,
                fields:
                    fieldDefinitions,
                records:
                    records,
                orphans:
                    orphanRecords,
                duplicates:
                    duplicateEmployees,
                comments:
                    (
                        auditData.comments ||
                        []
                    ).length,
                versions:
                    (
                        auditData.versions ||
                        []
                    ).length,
                indexGeneration:
                    window.LIFE_EXIT_INDEX
                        ? Number(
                            LIFE_EXIT_INDEX
                                .generation || 0
                        )
                        : 0
            };
        };

    function healthTag(status) {
        if (status === "Healthy") {
            return tag(
                status,
                "t-g"
            );
        }

        if (
            status === "No Live Records"
        ) {
            return tag(
                status,
                "t-n"
            );
        }

        return tag(
            status,
            "t-r"
        );
    }

    function healthPanel() {
        var health =
            hrmsSeparationHealth();

        return (
            '<div class="card" ' +
                'style="margin-bottom:13px">' +

                "<header>" +
                    '<i class="ic teal">✓</i>' +
                    "<h3>Separation Integration Health</h3>" +
                    '<span class="sub">' +
                        "Live data diagnostics" +
                    "</span>" +
                    '<span class="sp"></span>' +
                    healthTag(
                        health.status
                    ) +
                    '<button class="btn sm" ' +
                        'onclick="' +
                            "hrmsOpenSeparationHealth()" +
                        '">' +
                        "View Diagnostics" +
                    "</button>" +
                "</header>" +

                '<div class="body">' +
                    '<div class="grid g6">' +

                        '<div class="tile">' +
                            '<div class="v">' +
                                health.total +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="k">' +
                                "Live Separations" +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="d">' +
                                "From ERPNext" +
                            "</div>" +
                        "</div>" +

                        '<div class="tile">' +
                            '<div class="v">' +
                                health.mapped +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="k">' +
                                "Mapped Records" +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="d">' +
                                "Linked to employees" +
                            "</div>" +
                        "</div>" +

                        '<div class="tile ' +
                            (
                                health.missingTotal
                                    ? "t-crit"
                                    : "t-ok"
                            ) +
                        '">' +
                            '<div class="v">' +
                                health.missingTotal +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="k">' +
                                "Missing Values" +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="d">' +
                                "Required live fields" +
                            "</div>" +
                        "</div>" +

                        '<div class="tile ' +
                            (
                                health.orphans.length
                                    ? "t-crit"
                                    : "t-ok"
                            ) +
                        '">' +
                            '<div class="v">' +
                                health.orphans.length +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="k">' +
                                "Orphan Records" +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="d">' +
                                "Employee not mapped" +
                            "</div>" +
                        "</div>" +

                        '<div class="tile">' +
                            '<div class="v">' +
                                health.comments +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="k">' +
                                "Audit Comments" +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="d">' +
                                "Live comments" +
                            "</div>" +
                        "</div>" +

                        '<div class="tile">' +
                            '<div class="v">' +
                                health.versions +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="k">' +
                                "Version Entries" +
                            "</div>" +
                            '<div class="d">' +
                                "Live field changes" +
                            "</div>" +
                        "</div>" +

                    "</div>" +
                "</div>" +
            "</div>"
        );
    }

    function missingFieldTable(
        health
    ) {
        return (
            '<table class="tb">' +
                "<thead>" +
                    "<tr>" +
                        "<th>Field</th>" +
                        '<th class="c">Missing Count</th>' +
                        "<th>Status</th>" +
                    "</tr>" +
                "</thead>" +
                "<tbody>" +
                    health.fields.map(
                        function (field) {
                            var count =
                                health.missingCounts[
                                    field.key
                                ] || 0;

<script id="life-hrms-step-27b">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function appraisalHasValue(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        );
    }

    function appraisalMissing() {
        return (
            '<span class="hrms-field-missing">' +
                "MISSING" +
            "</span>"
        );
    }

    function appraisalText(value) {
        if (!appraisalHasValue(value)) {
            return appraisalMissing();
        }

        return esc(String(value));
    }

    function appraisalDate(value) {
        if (!appraisalHasValue(value)) {
            return appraisalMissing();
        }

        return fmtD(value);
    }

    function appraisalNumber(value) {
        if (!appraisalHasValue(value)) {
            return appraisalMissing();
        }

        var number = Number(value);

        if (isNaN(number)) {
            return appraisalText(value);
        }

        return number.toFixed(2)
            .replace(/\.00$/, "");
    }

    function appraisalPercentage(value) {
        if (!appraisalHasValue(value)) {
            return appraisalMissing();
        }

        var number = Number(value);

        if (isNaN(number)) {
            return appraisalText(value);
        }

        return (
            number.toFixed(2)
                .replace(/\.00$/, "") +
            "%"
        );
    }

    function appraisalDocumentStatus(
        docstatus
    ) {
        if (
            docstatus === undefined ||
            docstatus === null
        ) {
            return appraisalMissing();
        }

        if (Number(docstatus) === 1) {
            return tag(
                "Submitted",
                "t-g"
            );
        }

        if (Number(docstatus) === 0) {
            return tag(
                "Draft",
                "t-y"
            );
        }

        if (Number(docstatus) === 2) {
            return tag(
                "Cancelled",
                "t-r"
            );
        }

        return appraisalText(docstatus);
    }

    function appraisalSortValue(row) {
        return (
            row.end_date ||
            row.modified ||
            row.creation ||
            ""
        );
    }

    window.hrmsExtraMappers =
        window.hrmsExtraMappers || [];

    window.hrmsExtraMappers.push(
        function (data, employeeMap) {
            Object.keys(employeeMap).forEach(
                function (employeeId) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeMap[employeeId];

                    employee.appraisals = [];
                    employee.latestAppraisal = null;

                    /*
                     * Remove generated KPI/rating values.
                     * They are replaced only by live Appraisal data.
                     */
                    employee.kpi = null;
                    employee.rating = null;
                }
            );

            (
                data.appraisals || []
            ).forEach(function (row) {
                var employee =
                    employeeMap[row.employee];

                if (!employee) {
                    return;
                }

                var appraisal = {
                    id:
                        row.name || "",
                    employee:
                        row.employee || "",
                    employeeName:
                        row.employee_name || "",
                    department:
                        row.department || "",
                    designation:
                        row.designation || "",
                    company:
                        row.company || "",
                    cycle:
                        row.appraisal_cycle || "",
                    template:
                        row.appraisal_template || "",
                    startDate:
                        row.start_date || "",
                    endDate:
                        row.end_date || "",
                    manualGoals:
                        row.rate_goals_manually,
                    goalScore:
                        row.goal_score_percentage,
                    totalGoalScore:
                        row.total_score,
                    feedbackScore:
                        row.avg_feedback_score,
                    selfScore:
                        row.self_score,
                    finalScore:
                        row.final_score,
                    remarks:
                        row.remarks || "",
                    reflections:
                        row.reflections || "",
                    amendedFrom:
                        row.amended_from || "",
                    docstatus:
                        row.docstatus,
                    creation:
                        row.creation || "",
                    modified:
                        row.modified || "",
                    modifiedBy:
                        row.modified_by ||
                        row.owner ||
                        "ERPNext"
                };

                employee.appraisals.push(
                    appraisal
                );
            });

            Object.keys(employeeMap).forEach(
                function (employeeId) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeMap[employeeId];

                    employee.appraisals.sort(
                        function (left, right) {
                            return (
                                new Date(
                                    appraisalSortValue(
                                        right
                                    )
                                ) -
                                new Date(
                                    appraisalSortValue(
                                        left
                                    )
                                )
                            );
                        }
                    );

                    employee.latestAppraisal =
                        employee.appraisals.length
                            ? employee.appraisals[0]
                            : null;

                    if (
                        employee.latestAppraisal
                        && appraisalHasValue(
                            employee.latestAppraisal
                                .goalScore
                        )
                    ) {
                        employee.kpi = Number(
                            employee.latestAppraisal
                                .goalScore
                        );
                    }

                    if (
                        employee.latestAppraisal
                        && appraisalHasValue(
                            employee.latestAppraisal
                                .finalScore
                        )
                    ) {
                        employee.rating = Number(
                            employee.latestAppraisal
                                .finalScore
                        );
                    }
                }
            );

            window.LIFE_HRMS_APPRAISALS = {
                records:
                    data.appraisals || [],
                cycles:
                    data.appraisal_cycles || []
            };
        }
    );

        var appraisalTable = "";

<script id="life-hrms-step-27c">

(function () {
    "use strict";

    function profileHasValue(value) {
        return !(
            value === undefined ||
            value === null ||
            String(value).trim() === ""
        );
    }

    function profileMissing() {
        return (
            '<span class="hrms-field-missing">' +
                "MISSING" +
            "</span>"
        );
    }

    function profileText(value) {
        if (!profileHasValue(value)) {
            return profileMissing();
        }

        return esc(String(value));
    }

    function profileDate(value) {
        if (!profileHasValue(value)) {
            return profileMissing();
        }

        return fmtDL(value);
    }

    function profileNumber(value) {
        if (!profileHasValue(value)) {
            return profileMissing();
        }

        var number = Number(value);

        if (isNaN(number)) {
            return profileText(value);
        }

        return number.toFixed(2)
            .replace(/\.00$/, "");
    }

    function profilePercent(value) {
        if (!profileHasValue(value)) {
            return profileMissing();
        }

        return (
            profileNumber(value) +
            "%"
        );
    }

    function profileDocstatus(value) {
        if (
            value === undefined ||
            value === null
        ) {
            return profileMissing();
        }

        if (Number(value) === 1) {
            return tag(
                "Submitted",
                "t-g"
            );
        }

        if (Number(value) === 0) {
            return tag(
                "Draft",
                "t-y"
            );
        }

        if (Number(value) === 2) {
            return tag(
                "Cancelled",
                "t-r"
            );
        }

        return profileText(value);
    }

    function appraisalLink(appraisal) {
        if (
            !appraisal ||
            !profileHasValue(
                appraisal.id
            )
        ) {
            return profileMissing();

        return (
            '<a class="btn sm" ' +

            '">' +

<script id="life-hrms-step-27d-b">
(function () {
    "use strict";

    var appraisalOptions = {
        companies: [],
        branches: [],
        departments: [],
        designations: [],
        cycles: []
    };

    function hasValue(value) {
        return value !== undefined &&
            value !== null &&
            String(value).trim() !== "" &&
            String(value).trim()
                .toUpperCase() !== "MISSING";
    }

    function uniqueSorted(values) {
        var seen = {};

        return values.filter(
            function (value) {
                var clean = String(
                    value || ""
                ).trim();

                var key =
                    clean.toLowerCase();

                if (
                    !clean ||
                    clean.toUpperCase() ===
                        "MISSING" ||
                    seen[key]
                ) {
                    return false;
                }

                seen[key] = true;
                return true;
            }
        ).sort(
            function (left, right) {
                return String(left)
                    .localeCompare(
                        String(right)
                    );
            }
        );
    }

    function optionRows(
        values,
        selected,
        emptyLabel
    ) {
        var output =
            '<option value="">' +
                esc(
                    emptyLabel || "Select"
                ) +
            "</option>";

        values.forEach(
            function (value) {
                output +=
                    '<option value="' +
                        esc(value) +
                    '"' +
                    (
                        String(value) ===
                        String(
                            selected || ""
                        )
                            ? " selected"
                            : ""
                    ) +
                    ">" +
                        esc(value) +
                    "</option>";
            }
        );

        return output;
    }

    function fieldValue(id) {
        var element =
            document.getElementById(id);

        return element
            ? String(
                element.value || ""
            ).trim()
            : "";
    }

    function setSaving(
        buttonId,
        saving
    ) {
        var button =
            document.getElementById(
                buttonId
            );

        if (!button) {
            return;
        }

        button.disabled =
            !!saving;

        button.textContent =
            saving
                ? "Saving..."
                : button.getAttribute(
                    "data-label"
                );
    }

    window.hrmsExtraMappers =
        window.hrmsExtraMappers || [];

    window.hrmsExtraMappers.push(
        function (
            data,
            employeeMap
        ) {
            var employees =
                data.employees || [];

            var cycles =
                data.appraisal_cycles || [];

            employees.forEach(
                function (row) {
                    var employee =
                        employeeMap[
                            row.name
                        ];

                    if (employee) {
                        employee.company =
                            hasValue(
                                row.company
                            )
                                ? row.company
                                : "MISSING";

                        employee.branchName =
                            hasValue(
                                row.branch
                            )
                                ? row.branch
                                : "MISSING";
                    }
                }
            );

            appraisalOptions.companies =
                uniqueSorted(
                    employees.map(
                        function (row) {
                            return row.company;
                        }
                    )
                );

            appraisalOptions.branches =
                uniqueSorted(
                    employees.map(
                        function (row) {
                            return row.branch;
                        }
                    ).filter(
                        function (value) {
                            return String(
                                value || ""
                            ).trim()
                                .toLowerCase() !==
                                "testing branch";
                        }
                    )
                );

            appraisalOptions.departments =
                uniqueSorted(
                    employees.map(
                        function (row) {
                            return row.department;
                        }
                    )
                );

            appraisalOptions.designations =
                uniqueSorted(
                    employees.map(
                        function (row) {
                            return row.designation;
                        }
                    )
                );

            appraisalOptions.cycles =
                uniqueSorted(
                    cycles.filter(
                        function (row) {
                            return Number(
                                row.docstatus || 0
                            ) !== 2;
                        }
                    ).map(
                        function (row) {
                            return row.name;
                        }
                    )
                );

            window
                .LIFE_HRMS_APPRAISAL_OPTIONS =
                    appraisalOptions;
        }
    );

    function permitted() {
        return !!(
            window.ME &&
            ME.edit
        );
    }

    function actionPanel() {
        if (!permitted()) {
            return "";
        }

        return (
            '<div class="card" ' +
                'style="margin-bottom:13px">' +

                '<div class="sec">' +
                    "<b>Appraisal Actions</b>" +
                    "<span>" +
                        "Creates live ERPNext " +
                        "Draft records for review" +
                    "</span>" +
                    "<i></i>" +
                "</div>" +

                '<div style="' +
                    "display:flex;" +
                    "gap:8px;" +
                    "flex-wrap:wrap;" +
                    "padding:12px" +
                '">' +

                    '<button class="btn p" ' +
                        'onclick="' +
                            "openLiveAppraisalCycle()" +
                        '">' +
                        "＋ Create Appraisal Cycle" +
                    "</button>" +

                    '<button class="btn" ' +
                        'onclick="' +
                            "openLiveEmployeeAppraisal()" +
                        '">' +
                        "＋ Create Employee Appraisal" +
                    "</button>" +

                "</div>" +
            "</div>"
        );
    }

    var originalPerformanceRenderer =
        window.rPerf;

    if (
        typeof originalPerformanceRenderer ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.rPerf = function () {
            var rendered =
                originalPerformanceRenderer
                    .apply(
                        this,
                        arguments
                    );

            var panel =
                actionPanel();

            if (!panel) {
                return rendered;
            }

            var anchor =
                rendered.indexOf(
                    '<div class="grid'
                );

            return anchor >= 0
                ? (
                    rendered.slice(
                        0,
                        anchor
                    ) +
                    panel +
                    rendered.slice(
                        anchor
                    )
                )
                : panel + rendered;
        };

        rPerf = window.rPerf;
    }

    window.openLiveAppraisalCycle =
        function () {
            if (!permitted()) {
                toast(

                    "for this action",

                            "available." +

                    )

                        "</select>" +

                    '<div class="fg">' +
                        "<label>Designation</label>" +
                        '<select ' +
                            'id="' +
                                "app-cycle-designation" +
                            '">' +
                            optionRows(

                                    .designations,

                                "All designations"
                            ) +
                        "</select>" +
                    "</div>" +

                "</div>";

            var foot =
                '<button class="btn" ' +

                    "Cancel" +

                '<button ' +
                    'id="save-app-cycle" ' +
                    'class="btn p" ' +
                    'data-label="' +
                        "Create Draft Cycle" +
                    '" ' +
                    (
                        missingCompany
                            ? "disabled "
                            : ""
                    ) +
                    'onclick="' +
                        "saveLiveAppraisalCycle()" +
                    '">' +
                    "Create Draft Cycle" +
                "</button>";

            openModal(
                "Create Appraisal Cycle",
                "Live ERPNext record · " +
                    "saved as Draft",
                body,
                foot,
                "wide"
            );
        };

    window.saveLiveAppraisalCycle =
        function () {
            var payload = {
                cycle_name:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-name"
                    ),

                company:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-company"
                    ),

                start_date:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-start"
                    ),

                end_date:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-end"
                    ),

                branch:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-branch"
                    ),

                department:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-department"
                    ),

                designation:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-designation"
                    ),

                kra_evaluation_method:
                    fieldValue(
                        "app-cycle-method"
                    )
            };

            if (
                !payload.cycle_name ||
                !payload.company ||
                !payload.start_date ||

            ) {

            ) {

        function () {

            var missingCycle =
                !appraisalOptions
                    .cycles.length;

            var missingEmployee =
                !employeeValues.length;

            var body =
                missingCycle
                    ? (
                        '<div class="note n-r">' +
                            "<b>MISSING</b><br>" +
                            "No live Appraisal Cycle " +
                            "is available. Create a " +
                            "cycle first." +
                        "</div>"
                    )
                    : "";

            if (missingEmployee) {
                body +=
                    '<div class="note n-r">' +
                        "<b>MISSING</b><br>" +
                        "No active employee is " +
                        "available in the current " +
                        "scope." +
                    "</div>";
            }

            body +=
                '<div class="grid g2">' +

                    '<div class="fg">' +
                        "<label>Employee *</label>" +
                        '<select ' +
                            'id="new-app-employee">' +
                            employeeRows() +
                        "</select>" +
                    "</div>" +

                    '<div class="fg">' +
                        "<label>" +
                            "Appraisal Cycle *" +
                        "</label>" +
                        '<select ' +
                            'id="new-app-cycle">' +
                            optionRows(
                                appraisalOptions
                                    .cycles,
                                "",
                                "Select cycle"
                            ) +
                        "</select>" +
                    "</div>" +

                "</div>" +

                '<div class="fg">' +
                    "<label>Remarks</label>" +
                    '<textarea ' +
                        'id="new-app-remarks" ' +
                        'rows="3">' +
                    "</textarea>" +
                "</div>" +

                '<div class="fg">' +
                    "<label>Reflections</label>" +
                    '<textarea ' +
                        'id="new-app-reflections" ' +
                        'rows="3">' +
                    "</textarea>" +
                "</div>";

            var foot =
                '<button class="btn" ' +
                    'onclick="closeModal()">' +
                    "Cancel" +
                "</button>" +

                '<button ' +
                    'id="' +
                        "save-employee-appraisal" +
                    '" ' +
                    'class="btn p" ' +
                    'data-label="' +
                        "Create Draft Appraisal" +
                    '" ' +
                    (
                        missingCycle ||
                        missingEmployee
                            ? "disabled "
                            : ""
                    ) +
                    'onclick="' +
                        "saveLiveEmployeeAppraisal()" +
                    '">' +
                    "Create Draft Appraisal" +
                "</button>";

            openModal(
                "Create Employee Appraisal",
                "Live ERPNext record · " +
                    "saved as Draft",
                body,
                foot,
                "wide"
            );
        };

    window.saveLiveEmployeeAppraisal =
        function () {
            var payload = {
                employee:
                    fieldValue(
                        "new-app-employee"
                    ),

                appraisal_cycle:
                    fieldValue(
                        "new-app-cycle"
                    ),

                remarks:
                    fieldValue(
                        "new-app-remarks"
                    ),

                reflections:
                    fieldValue(
                        "new-app-reflections"
                    )
            };

            if (
                !payload.employee ||
                !payload.appraisal_cycle
            ) {
                toast(
                    "Employee and Appraisal Cycle " +
                    "are required",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            setSaving(
                "save-employee-appraisal",
                true
            );

            hrmsLiveRequest(
                "create_employee_appraisal",
                payload
            ).then(
                function (result) {
                    closeModal();

                    toast(
                        "Employee Appraisal created: " +
                        (
                            result.name ||
                            "Draft"
                        )
                    );

                    setTimeout(
                        function () {
                            window.location.reload();
                        },
                        700
                    );
                }
            ).catch(
                function (error) {
                    setSaving(
                        "save-employee-appraisal",
                        false
                    );

                    toast(
                        error.message ||
                        "Could not create " +
                        "Employee Appraisal",
                        "err"
                    );
                }
            );
        };

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 27D-B " +
        "appraisal creation UI loaded"
    );
}());
