<script id="life-hrms-step-27e-b">
(function () {
    "use strict";

    var pendingAppraisal = "";

    function hasValue(value) {
        return value !== undefined &&
            value !== null &&
            String(value).trim() !== "" &&
            String(value).trim()
                .toUpperCase() !== "MISSING";
    }

    function numberValue(value) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return null;
        }

        var number = Number(value);

        return isNaN(number)
            ? null
            : number;
    }

    function displayNumber(
        value,
        suffix
    ) {
        var number =
            numberValue(value);

        if (number === null) {
            return (
                '<span class="' +
                    'hrms-field-missing">' +
                    "MISSING" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        return esc(
            number.toFixed(2)
                .replace(/\.00$/, "") +
            (suffix || "")
        );
    }

    function scoreReadiness(
        appraisal
    ) {
        var scores = [
            appraisal.goalScore,
            appraisal.totalGoalScore,
            appraisal.feedbackScore,
            appraisal.selfScore,
            appraisal.finalScore
        ];

        var ready = scores.some(
            function (value) {
                var number =
                    numberValue(value);

                return (
                    number !== null &&
                    number > 0
                );
            }
        );

        return {
            ready: ready,
            text: ready
                ? "Ready to submit"
                : "MISSING scores"
        };
    }

    function canSubmit() {
        return !!(
            window.ME &&
            ME.edit
        );
    }

    function jsString(value) {
        return String(value || "")
            .replace(
                /\\/g,
                "\\\\"
            )
            .replace(
                /'/g,
                "\\'"
            )
            .replace(
                /[\r\n]+/g,
                " "
            );
    }

    function appraisalLink(
        appraisal
    ) {
        if (
            !appraisal ||
            !hasValue(appraisal.id)
        ) {
            return (
                '<span class="' +
                    'hrms-field-missing">' +
                    "MISSING" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        return (
            '<a class="btn sm" ' +
                'target="_blank" ' +
                'href="/app/appraisal/' +
                encodeURIComponent(
                    appraisal.id
                ) +
            '">' +
                esc(appraisal.id) +
            "</a>"
        );
    }

    function submitAction(
        appraisal
    ) {
        if (
            Number(
                appraisal.docstatus
            ) !== 0
        ) {
            return Number(
                appraisal.docstatus
            ) === 1
                ? tag(
                    "Submitted",
                    "t-g"
                )
                : tag(
                    "Cancelled",
                    "t-r"
                );
        }

        var readiness =
            scoreReadiness(appraisal);

        if (!canSubmit()) {
            return (
                '<span class="sm2">' +
                    "No submit permission" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        if (!readiness.ready) {
            return (
                '<div style="' +
                    "display:flex;" +
                    "gap:6px;" +
                    "align-items:center;" +
                    "justify-content:flex-end" +
                '">' +

                    tag(
                        "MISSING scores",
                        "t-r"
                    ) +

                    '<a class="btn sm" ' +
                        'target="_blank" ' +
                        'href="/app/appraisal/' +
                        encodeURIComponent(
                            appraisal.id
                        ) +
                    '">' +
                        "Enter Scores" +
                    "</a>" +

                "</div>"
            );
        }

        return (
            '<button class="btn sm p" ' +
                'onclick="' +
                    "event.stopPropagation();" +
                    "openLiveAppraisalSubmit('" +
                    jsString(
                        appraisal.id
                    ) +
                    "')" +
                '">' +
                "Submit" +
            "</button>"
        );
    }

    function readinessTable(
        items,
        employeeColumn
    ) {
        if (!items.length) {
            return (
                '<div class="empty">' +
                    "<b>No Draft Appraisals</b>" +
                    "There are no live Draft " +
                    "Appraisals in this scope." +
                "</div>"
            );
        }

        return tw(
            '<table class="tb">' +
                "<thead>" +
                    "<tr>" +

                        (
                            employeeColumn
                                ? "<th>Employee</th>"
                                : ""
                        ) +

                        "<th>Appraisal</th>" +
                        "<th>Cycle</th>" +
                        '<th class="c">Goal %</th>' +
                        '<th class="c">' +
                            "Feedback" +
                        "</th>" +
                        '<th class="c">Self</th>' +
                        '<th class="c">Final</th>' +
                        "<th>Readiness</th>" +
                        '<th class="r">Action</th>' +

                    "</tr>" +
                "</thead>" +

                "<tbody>" +

                    items.map(
                        function (item) {
                            var employee =
                                item.employee;

                            var appraisal =
                                item.appraisal;

                            var readiness =
                                scoreReadiness(
                                    appraisal
                                );

                            return (
                                "<tr>" +

                                    (
                                        employeeColumn
                                            ? (
                                                '<td class="nm">' +
                                                    esc(
                                                        employee.name
                                                    ) +
                                                    '<div class="sm2">' +
                                                        esc(
                                                            employee.id
                                                        ) +
                                                        " · " +
                                                        esc(
                                                            employee
                                                                .branchName
                                                        ) +
                                                    "</div>" +
                                                "</td>"
                                            )
                                            : ""
                                    ) +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        appraisalLink(
                                            appraisal
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        (
                                            hasValue(
                                                appraisal.cycle
                                            )
                                                ? esc(
                                                    appraisal.cycle
                                                )
                                                : (
                                                    '<span class="' +
                                                        "hrms-field-" +
                                                        "missing" +
                                                    '">' +
                                                        "MISSING" +
                                                    "</span>"
                                                )
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="c">' +
                                        displayNumber(
                                            appraisal.goalScore,
                                            "%"
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="c">' +
                                        displayNumber(
                                            appraisal
                                                .feedbackScore,
                                            ""
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="c">' +
                                        displayNumber(
                                            appraisal.selfScore,
                                            ""
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="c">' +
                                        displayNumber(
                                            appraisal.finalScore,
                                            ""
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    "<td>" +
                                        tag(
                                            readiness.text,
                                            readiness.ready
                                                ? "t-g"
                                                : "t-r"
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                    '<td class="r">' +
                                        submitAction(
                                            appraisal
                                        ) +
                                    "</td>" +

                                "</tr>"
                            );
                        }
                    ).join("") +

                "</tbody>" +
            "</table>"
        );
    }

    function scopedDrafts() {
        var rows = [];

        activeOf(
            scoped()
        ).forEach(
            function (employee) {
                (
                    employee.appraisals ||
                    []
                ).forEach(
                    function (appraisal) {
                        if (
                            Number(
                                appraisal
                                    .docstatus
                            ) === 0
                        ) {
                            rows.push({
                                employee:
                                    employee,
                                appraisal:
                                    appraisal
                            });
                        }
                    }
                );
            }
        );

        return rows;
    }

    function performanceReadinessPanel() {
        var drafts =
            scopedDrafts();

        var readyCount =
            drafts.filter(
                function (item) {
                    return scoreReadiness(
                        item.appraisal
                    ).ready;
                }
            ).length;

        var missingCount =
            drafts.length -
            readyCount;

        return acc(
            "✅ Draft Submission Readiness",
            drafts.length +
                " Draft · " +
                readyCount +
                " Ready · " +
                missingCount +
                " MISSING",

            readinessTable(
                drafts,
                true
            ),

            {
                key:
                    "appraisal-submit-readiness",

                cls:
                    missingCount
                        ? "a-crit"
                        : "a-teal",

                ic: "✓",

                icCls:
                    missingCount
                        ? "rose"
                        : "teal",

                flush:
                    !!drafts.length,

                open:
                    !!drafts.length
            }
        );
    }

    var previousPerformanceRenderer =
        window.rPerf;

    if (
        typeof previousPerformanceRenderer ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.rPerf = function () {
            return (
                previousPerformanceRenderer
                    .apply(
                        this,
                        arguments
                    ) +
                performanceReadinessPanel()
            );
        };

        rPerf = window.rPerf;
    }

    var previousEmployeePerformance =
        window
            .renderLiveEmployeePerformance;

    if (
        typeof previousEmployeePerformance ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.renderLiveEmployeePerformance =
            function (
                employee,
                keyPrefix
            ) {
                var rendered =
                    previousEmployeePerformance
                        .apply(
                            this,
                            arguments
                        );

                var drafts =
                    (
                        employee.appraisals ||
                        []
                    ).filter(
                        function (appraisal) {
                            return Number(
                                appraisal
                                    .docstatus
                            ) === 0;
                        }
                    ).map(
                        function (appraisal) {
                            return {
                                employee:
                                    employee,
                                appraisal:
                                    appraisal
                            };
                        }
                    );

                if (!drafts.length) {
                    return rendered;
                }

                return (
                    rendered +
                    acc(
                        "✅ Appraisal Submission",

                        drafts.length +
                            (
                                drafts.length === 1
                                    ? " Draft"
                                    : " Drafts"
                            ),

                        readinessTable(
                            drafts,
                            false
                        ),

                        {
                            key:
                                String(
                                    keyPrefix ||
                                    "emp-"
                                ) +
                                "appraisal-submit",

                            cls:
                                drafts.some(
                                    function (
                                        item
                                    ) {
                                        return (
                                            !scoreReadiness(
                                                item
                                                    .appraisal
                                            ).ready
                                        );
                                    }
                                )
                                    ? "a-crit"
                                    : "a-teal",

                            ic: "✓",
                            icCls: "teal",
                            flush: true,
                            open: true
                        }
                    )
                );
            };
    }

    window.openLiveAppraisalSubmit =
        function (appraisalId) {
            if (!canSubmit()) {
                toast(
                    "You do not have permission " +
                    "to submit Appraisals",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            var found = null;

            EMPLOYEES.some(
                function (employee) {
                    return (
                        employee.appraisals ||
                        []
                    ).some(
                        function (appraisal) {
                            if (
                                appraisal.id ===
                                appraisalId
                            ) {
                                found =
                                    appraisal;

                                return true;
                            }

                            return false;
                        }
                    );
                }
            );

            if (!found) {
                toast(
                    "Live Appraisal record " +
                    "is MISSING",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            if (
                Number(
                    found.docstatus
                ) !== 0
            ) {
                toast(
                    "Only a Draft Appraisal " +
                    "can be submitted",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            if (
                !scoreReadiness(
                    found
                ).ready
            ) {
                toast(
                    "Appraisal scores are MISSING",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            pendingAppraisal =
                appraisalId;

            var body =
                '<div class="' +
                    "hrms-source-banner live" +
                '">' +
                    "<i>✓</i>" +
                    "<div>" +
                        "<b>READY TO SUBMIT</b>" +
                        "<span>" +
                            "This submits the live " +
                            "ERPNext Appraisal." +
                        "</span>" +
                    "</div>" +
                "</div>" +

                '<div class="dgrid">' +

                    df(
                        "Appraisal",
                        esc(found.id)
                    ) +

                    df(
                        "Cycle",
                        hasValue(found.cycle)
                            ? esc(found.cycle)
                            : (
                                '<span class="' +
                                    "hrms-field-missing" +
                                '">' +
                                    "MISSING" +
                                "</span>"
                            )
                    ) +

                    df(
                        "Goal Score",
                        displayNumber(
                            found.goalScore,
                            "%"
                        )
                    ) +

                    df(
                        "Feedback Score",
                        displayNumber(
                            found.feedbackScore,
                            ""
                        )
                    ) +

                    df(
                        "Self Score",
                        displayNumber(
                            found.selfScore,
                            ""
                        )
                    ) +

                    df(
                        "Final Score",
                        displayNumber(
                            found.finalScore,
                            ""
                        )
                    ) +

                "</div>" +

                '<div class="note n-y" ' +
                    'style="margin-top:12px">' +

                    "<b>Confirm submission</b><br>" +
                    "A submitted Appraisal cannot " +
                    "be edited as a Draft." +

                "</div>";

            var foot =
                '<button class="btn" ' +
                    'onclick="closeModal()">' +
                    "Cancel" +
                "</button>" +

                '<button ' +
                    'id="' +
                        "confirm-appraisal-submit" +
                    '" ' +
                    'class="btn p" ' +
                    'data-label="' +
                        "Submit Appraisal" +
                    '" ' +
                    'onclick="' +
                        "submitLiveAppraisal()" +
                    '">' +
                    "Submit Appraisal" +
                "</button>";

            openModal(
                "Submit Appraisal",
                "Live ERPNext workflow action",
                body,
                foot,
                "wide"
            );
        };

    window.submitLiveAppraisal =
        function () {
            if (!pendingAppraisal) {
                toast(
                    "Appraisal ID is MISSING",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            var button =
                document.getElementById(
                    "confirm-appraisal-submit"
                );

            if (button) {
                button.disabled = true;
                button.textContent =
                    "Submitting...";
            }

            hrmsLiveRequest(
                "submit_employee_appraisal",
                {
                    appraisal:
                        pendingAppraisal
                }
            ).then(
                function (result) {
                    pendingAppraisal = "";

                    closeModal();

                    toast(
                        "Appraisal submitted: " +
                        (
                            result.appraisal ||
                            "Submitted"
                        )
                    );

                    setTimeout(
                        function () {
                            window.location.reload();
                        },
                        700
                    );
                }
            ).catch(
                function (error) {
                    if (button) {
                        button.disabled = false;
                        button.textContent =
                            "Submit Appraisal";
                    }

                    toast(
                        error.message ||
                        "Could not submit Appraisal",
                        "err"
                    );
                }
            );
        };

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 27E-B " +
        "live Appraisal submission UI loaded"
    );
}());
</script>

<script id="life-hrms-step-27f">
(function () {
    "use strict";

    var filters = {
        search: "",
        status: "ALL",
        cycle: "ALL",
        score: "ALL",
        overdue: false
    };

    var filteredCache = [];

    function hasValue(value) {
        return value !== undefined &&
            value !== null &&
            String(value).trim() !== "" &&
            String(value).trim()
                .toUpperCase() !== "MISSING";
    }

    function clean(value) {
        return hasValue(value)
            ? String(value).trim()
            : "MISSING";
    }

    function numberValue(value) {
        if (!hasValue(value)) {
            return null;
        }

        var number = Number(value);

        return isNaN(number)
            ? null
            : number;
    }

    function numberText(
        value,
        suffix
    ) {
        var number =
            numberValue(value);

        if (number === null) {
            return "MISSING";
        }

        return (
            number.toFixed(2)
                .replace(/\.00$/, "") +
            String(suffix || "")
        );
    }

    function statusText(value) {
        if (Number(value) === 0) {
            return "Draft";
        }

        if (Number(value) === 1) {
            return "Submitted";
        }

        if (Number(value) === 2) {
            return "Cancelled";
        }

        return "MISSING";
    }

    function statusBadge(value) {
        var text =
            statusText(value);

        return tag(
            text,
            text === "Submitted"
                ? "t-g"
                : (
                    text === "Draft"
                        ? "t-y"
                        : "t-r"
                )
        );
    }

    function scoreAvailable(
        appraisal
    ) {
        return [
            appraisal.goalScore,
            appraisal.totalGoalScore,
            appraisal.feedbackScore,
            appraisal.selfScore,
            appraisal.finalScore
        ].some(
            function (value) {
                return (
                    numberValue(value) !==
                    null
                );
            }
        );
    }

    function liveCycles() {
        return (
            (
                window
                    .LIFE_HRMS_APPRAISALS ||
                {}
            ).cycles || []
        ).filter(
            function (cycle) {
                return String(
                    cycle.branch || ""
                ).trim()
                    .toLowerCase() !==
                    "testing branch";
            }
        );
    }

    function buildCycleIndex() {
        var index = {};

        liveCycles().forEach(
            function (cycle) {
                index[cycle.name] =
                    cycle;
            }
        );

        return index;
    }

    function isOverdueCycle(cycle) {
        return !!(
            cycle &&
            hasValue(
                cycle.end_date
            ) &&
            String(
                cycle.end_date
            ) < String(TODAY) &&
            String(
                cycle.status || ""
            ).trim()
                .toLowerCase() !==
                "completed"
        );
    }

    function allRows() {
        var rows = [];
        var cycleIndex =
            buildCycleIndex();

        activeOf(
            scoped()
        ).forEach(
            function (employee) {
                (
                    employee.appraisals ||
                    []
                ).forEach(
                    function (appraisal) {
                        rows.push({
                            employee:
                                employee,

                            appraisal:
                                appraisal,

                            cycle:
                                cycleIndex[
                                    appraisal.cycle
                                ] || null
                        });
                    }
                );
            }
        );

        return rows;
    }

    function currentRows() {
        var query =
            filters.search
                .toLowerCase();

        filteredCache =
            allRows().filter(
                function (row) {
                    var employee =
                        row.employee;

                    var appraisal =
                        row.appraisal;

                    var searchable = [
                        employee.id,
                        employee.name,
                        employee.branchName,
                        employee.department,
                        employee.designation,
                        appraisal.id,
                        appraisal.cycle
                    ].join(" ")
                        .toLowerCase();

                    if (
                        query &&
                        searchable.indexOf(
                            query
                        ) === -1
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    if (
                        filters.status !==
                            "ALL" &&
                        statusText(
                            appraisal.docstatus
                        ) !== filters.status
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    if (
                        filters.cycle !==
                            "ALL" &&
                        appraisal.cycle !==
                            filters.cycle
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    if (
                        filters.score ===
                            "AVAILABLE" &&
                        !scoreAvailable(
                            appraisal
                        )
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    if (
                        filters.score ===
                            "MISSING" &&
                        scoreAvailable(
                            appraisal
                        )
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    if (
                        filters.overdue &&
                        !isOverdueCycle(
                            row.cycle
                        )
                    ) {
                        return false;
                    }

                    return true;
                }
            );

        return filteredCache;
    }

    function uniqueCycles() {
        var seen = {};

        return allRows().map(
            function (row) {
                return (
                    row.appraisal.cycle
                );
            }
        ).filter(
            function (value) {
                if (

    function excelEscape(value) {

        .replace(/>/g, ">")

    window.exportLiveAppraisalsExcel =

            var headers = [

            var table =

                            );

                    "</tr></thead>" +

                    rows.map(

                                    appraisal.id

                                clean(
                                    appraisal.endDate

                                    appraisal.goalScore,

                                ),
                                numberText(
                                    appraisal.totalGoalScore,
                                    ""
                                ),
                                numberText(
                                    appraisal.feedbackScore,
                                    ""
                                ),
                                numberText(
                                    appraisal.selfScore,
                                    ""
                                ),
                                numberText(
                                    appraisal.finalScore,

                                ),

                                    ? clean(
                                        row.cycle.status

            var blob = new Blob(

            var url =

            setTimeout(

            toast(

    window

    console.log(

        "Appraisal analytics loaded"
    );
}());

<script id="life-hrms-step-27-complete">
(function () {
    "use strict";

    function hasValue(value) {
        return value !== undefined &&
            value !== null &&
            String(value).trim() !== "" &&
            String(value).trim()
                .toUpperCase() !== "MISSING";
    }

    function scoreAvailable(row) {
        return [
            row.goal_score_percentage,
            row.total_score,
            row.avg_feedback_score,
            row.self_score,
            row.final_score
        ].some(
            function (value) {
                if (!hasValue(value)) {
                    return false;
                }

                return !isNaN(
                    Number(value)
                );
            }
        );
    }

    function diagnostics() {
        var live =
            window
                .LIFE_HRMS_APPRAISALS ||
            {};

        var records =
            live.records || [];

        var cycles =
            live.cycles || [];

        var employeeIndex = {};
        var cycleIndex = {};
        var duplicateIndex = {};
        var duplicateNames = [];

        EMPLOYEES.forEach(
            function (employee) {
                employeeIndex[
                    employee.id
                ] = employee;
            }
        );

        cycles.forEach(
            function (cycle) {
                if (
                    String(
                        cycle.branch || ""
                    ).trim()
                        .toLowerCase() !==
                        "testing branch"
                ) {
                    cycleIndex[
                        cycle.name
                    ] = cycle;
                }
            }
        );

        var orphanEmployees = [];
        var missingCycles = [];
        var companyMismatches = [];
        var scoreGaps = [];
        var draftReady = [];

        records.forEach(
            function (row) {
                if (
                    Number(
                        row.docstatus
                    ) === 2
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                var employee =
                    employeeIndex[
                        row.employee
                    ];

                var cycle =
                    cycleIndex[
                        row.appraisal_cycle
                    ];

                var duplicateKey =
                    String(
                        row.employee ||
                        "MISSING"
                    ) +
                    "||" +
                    String(
                        row.appraisal_cycle ||
                        "MISSING"
                    );

                duplicateIndex[
                    duplicateKey
                ] =
                    duplicateIndex[
                        duplicateKey
                    ] || [];

                duplicateIndex[
                    duplicateKey
                ].push(
                    row.name ||
                    "MISSING"
                );

                if (!employee) {
                    orphanEmployees.push(
                        row.name ||
                        "MISSING"
                    );
                }

                if (
                    !hasValue(
                        row.appraisal_cycle
                    ) ||
                    !cycle
                ) {
                    missingCycles.push(
                        row.name ||
                        "MISSING"
                    );
                }

                if (
                    employee &&
                    hasValue(
                        row.company
                    ) &&
                    hasValue(
                        employee.company
                    ) &&
                    String(
                        row.company
                    ) !==
                    String(
                        employee.company
                    )
                ) {
                    companyMismatches.push(
                        row.name ||
                        "MISSING"
                    );
                }

                if (
                    !scoreAvailable(row)
                ) {
                    scoreGaps.push(
                        row.name ||
                        "MISSING"
                    );
                } else if (
                    Number(
                        row.docstatus
                    ) === 0
                ) {
                    draftReady.push(
                        row.name ||
                        "MISSING"
                    );
                }
            }
        );

        Object.keys(
            duplicateIndex
        ).forEach(
            function (key) {
                if (
                    duplicateIndex[
                        key
                    ].length > 1
                ) {
                    duplicateNames.push(
                        duplicateIndex[
                            key
                        ].join(", ")
                    );
                }
            }
        );

        var overdueCycles =
            Object.keys(
                cycleIndex
            ).filter(
                function (name) {
                    var cycle =
                        cycleIndex[
                            name
                        ];

                    return (
                        hasValue(
                            cycle.end_date
                        ) &&
                        String(
                            cycle.end_date
                        ) <
                        String(TODAY) &&
                        String(
                            cycle.status ||
                            ""
                        ).trim()
                            .toLowerCase() !==
                            "completed"
                    );
                }
            );

        return {
            records:
                records.length,

            cycles:
                Object.keys(
                    cycleIndex
                ).length,

            duplicates:
                duplicateNames,

            orphanEmployees:
                orphanEmployees,

            missingCycles:
                missingCycles,

            companyMismatches:
                companyMismatches,

            scoreGaps:
                scoreGaps,

            draftReady:
                draftReady,

            overdueCycles:
                overdueCycles
        };
    }

    function issueRows(report) {
        var groups = [
            [
                "Duplicate Employee + Cycle",
                report.duplicates
            ],
            [
                "Employee Link MISSING",
                report.orphanEmployees
            ],
            [
                "Appraisal Cycle MISSING",
                report.missingCycles
            ],
            [
                "Company Mismatch",

                    'hrms-field-missing">' +

            );

    function raw(value) {
        return hasValue(value)
            ? String(value)
            : "MISSING";

        value,
        currency
    ) {
        if (
            !hasValue(value) ||
            isNaN(Number(value))
        ) {
            return (
                '<span class="' +
                    'hrms-field-missing">' +
                    "MISSING" +
                "</span>"
            );
        }

        var prefix =
            hasValue(currency)

            '<span class="tnum">' +
                esc(
                    prefix +
                    Number(value)

                "&"
            )
            .replace(
                /</g,
                "<"
            )
            .replace(
                />/g,
                ">"
            )
            .replace(
                /"/g,
                """
            );
    }

    window.exportLivePayrollExcel =
        function () {
            if (!permitted()) {
                toast(
                    "Payroll data is restricted",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            var groups = [
                [
                    "Salary Slip",
                    rows("salarySlips")
                ],
                [
                    "Salary Structure Assignment",
                    rows("salaryStructures")
                ],
                [
                    "Additional Salary",
                    rows("additionalSalaries")
                ],
                [
                    "Employee Advance",
                    rows("employeeAdvances")
                ],
                [
                    "Expense Claim",
                    rows("expenseClaims")
                ],
                [
                    "Employee Benefit Application",
                    rows("benefitApplications")
                ]
            ];

            var exportRows = [];

            groups.forEach(
                function (group) {
                    group[1].forEach(
                        function (row) {
                            exportRows.push([
                                group[0],

                                raw(
                                    row.name
                                ),

                                raw(
                                    row.employee
                                ),

                                raw(
                                    row.employee_name
                                ),

                                raw(
                                    row.posting_date ||
                                    row.payroll_date ||
                                    row.from_date ||
                                    row.date
                                ),

                                raw(
                                    row.status ||
                                    row.approval_status
                                ),

                                raw(
                                    row.currency
                                ),

                                raw(
                                    row.net_pay ||
                                    row.amount ||
                                    row.pending_amount ||
                                    row.total_claimed_amount ||
                                    row.total_amount
                                )
                            ]);
                        }
                    );
                }
            );

            if (!exportRows.length) {
                toast(
                    "No live payroll records "
                    + "to export",
                    "err"
                );

                return;
            }

            var headers = [
                "Record Type",
                "Reference",
                "Employee ID",
                "Employee Name",
                "Date",
                "Status",
                "Currency",
                "Primary Amount"
            ];

            var tableHtml =
                "<table>" +
                    "<thead><tr>" +

                    headers.map(
                        function (value) {
                            return (
                                "<th>" +
                                    excelEscape(
                                        value
                                    ) +
                                "</th>"
                            );
                        }
                    ).join("") +

                    "</tr></thead>" +
                    "<tbody>" +

                    exportRows.map(
                        function (values) {
                            return (
                                "<tr>" +

                                values.map(
                                    function (value) {
                                        return (
                                            "<td>" +
                                                excelEscape(
                                                    value
                                                ) +
                                            "</td>"
                                        );
                                    }
                                ).join("") +

                                "</tr>"
                            );
                        }
                    ).join("") +

                    "</tbody>" +
                "</table>";

            var blob = new Blob(
                [
                    '<html><head>' +
                        '<meta charset="UTF-8">' +
                    "</head><body>" +
                        tableHtml +
                    "</body></html>"
                ],
                {
                    type:
                        "application/vnd.ms-excel;" +
                        "charset=utf-8"
                }
            );

            var url =
                URL.createObjectURL(
                    blob
                );

            var linkNode =
                document.createElement(
                    "a"
                );

            linkNode.href =
                url;

            linkNode.download =
                "LIFE_HRMS_Payroll_" +
                String(TODAY) +
                ".xls";

            document.body.appendChild(
                linkNode
            );

            linkNode.click();
            linkNode.remove();

            setTimeout(
                function () {
                    URL.revokeObjectURL(
                        url
                    );
                },
                1000
            );

            toast(
                exportRows.length +
                " live payroll records exported",
                "ok"
            );
        };

    var previousReports =
        window.rReports;

    if (
        typeof previousReports ===
        "function"
    ) {
        window.rReports = function () {
            return (
                previousReports.apply(
                    this,

                ) +
                payrollDashboard()
            );
        };

        rReports =

                        "emp-"
                    )
                );
            };
    }

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Step 28 "
        + "Payroll integration complete"
    );
}());
</script>

<script id="life-hrms-sidebar-shortcuts-js">
(function () {
    "use strict";

    var collapsed = false;

    var shortcutIcons = {
        dash: "⌂",
        alerts: "!",
        emps: "👥",
        contacts: "☎",
        org: "⌘",
        addemp: "+",
        post: "📣",
        reqreg: "▤",
        applicants: "👤",
        onboard: "🚪",
        onbtrack: "✓",
        attend: "◷",
        leave: "▣",
        perf: "📈",
        train: "🎓",
        exitdesk: "↗",
        reports: "▧",
        masters: "⚙",
        access: "🔐"
    };

    function escapeAttribute(value) {
        return esc(
            String(value || "")
        ).replace(
            /`/g,
            "`"
        );
    }

    function applySidebarState() {
        var side =
            document.querySelector(
                ".side"
            );

        var button =
            document.getElementById(
                "hrms-side-toggle"
            );

        if (!side) {
            return;
        }

        side.classList.toggle(
            "hrms-side-collapsed",
            collapsed
        );

        if (button) {
            button.textContent =
                collapsed
                    ? "»"
                    : "«";

            button.title =
                collapsed
                    ? "Expand sidebar"
                    : "Collapse sidebar";

            button.setAttribute(
                "aria-label",
                button.title
            );

            button.setAttribute(
                "aria-expanded",
                collapsed
                    ? "false"
                    : "true"
            );
        }
    }

    function installToggle() {
        var header =
            document.querySelector(
                ".side .side-h"
            );

        if (
            !header ||
            document.getElementById(
                "hrms-side-toggle"
            )
        ) {
            return;
        }

        var button =
            document.createElement(
                "button"
            );

        button.type = "button";
        button.id = "hrms-side-toggle";
        button.className =
            "hrms-side-toggle";

        button.onclick =
            function (event) {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.stopPropagation();

                window
                    .toggleHrmsSidebar();
            };

        header.appendChild(
            button
        );

        applySidebarState();
    }

    window.toggleHrmsSidebar =
        function () {
            if (
                window.innerWidth <= 880
            ) {
                var mobileSide =
                    document.querySelector(
                        ".side"
                    );

                if (mobileSide) {
                    mobileSide.classList
                        .toggle("show");
                }

                return;
            }

            collapsed = !collapsed;

            applySidebarState();
        };

    window.expandHrmsSidebar =
        function () {
            collapsed = false;
            applySidebarState();
        };

    window.collapseHrmsSidebar =
        function () {
            if (
                window.innerWidth > 880
            ) {
                collapsed = true;
                applySidebarState();
            }
        };

    window.buildNav =
        function () {
            var nav =
                hrmsEl("nav");

            if (!nav) {
                return;
            }

            nav.innerHTML =
                NAV.map(
                    function (section) {
                        return (
                            '<div class="ngrp' +
                                (
                                    ALLG ||
                                    OPENG ===
                                        section.g
                                        ? " open"
                                        : ""
                                ) +
                            '">' +

                                '<div class="ghead" ' +
                                    'onclick="' +
                                        "toggleG('" +
                                        section.g +
                                        "')" +
                                    '">' +

                                    '<i class="ic sm ' +
                                        section.cls +
                                    '">' +
                                        section.ic +
                                    "</i>" +

                                    "<b>" +
                                        esc(
                                            section.g
                                        ) +
                                    "</b>" +

                                    '<span class="n">' +
                                        section
                                            .items.length +
                                    "</span>" +

                                    '<span class="cv">' +
                                        "▶" +
                                    "</span>" +

                                "</div>" +

                                '<div class="gitems">' +

                                    section.items.map(
                                        function (
                                            item
                                        ) {
                                            var icon =
                                                shortcutIcons[
                                                    item[0]
                                                ] ||
                                                "•";

                                            return (
                                                '<a data-v="' +
                                                    item[0] +
                                                '" ' +

                                                'title="' +
                                                    escapeAttribute(
                                                        item[1] +
                                                        " — " +
                                                        item[2]
                                                    ) +
                                                '" ' +

                                                'aria-label="' +
                                                    escapeAttribute(
                                                        item[1]
                                                    ) +
                                                '" ' +

                                                'onclick="' +
                                                    "go('" +
                                                    item[0] +
                                                    "')" +
                                                '">' +

                                                    '<i class="' +
                                                        "nav-short-icon" +
                                                    '">' +
                                                        esc(
                                                            icon
                                                        ) +
                                                    "</i>" +

                                                    '<span class="' +
                                                        "nav-title" +
                                                    '">' +
                                                        esc(
                                                            item[1]
                                                        ) +
                                                    "</span>" +

                                                    '<span class="' +
                                                        "nav-desc" +
                                                    '">' +
                                                        esc(
                                                            item[2]
                                                        ) +
                                                    "</span>" +

                                                    '<span class="' +
                                                        "pill" +
                                                    '" id="pl-' +
                                                        item[0] +
                                                    '" style="' +
                                                        "display:none" +
                                                    '">' +
                                                    "</span>" +

                                                "</a>"
                                            );
                                        }
                                    ).join("") +

                                "</div>" +
                            "</div>"
                        );
                    }
                ).join("");

            markNav();
            applySidebarState();
        };

    buildNav =
        window.buildNav;

    installToggle();

    if (
        window.NAV &&
        document.getElementById(
            "nav"
        )
    ) {
        buildNav();

        if (
            typeof badges ===
            "function"
        ) {
            badges();
        }
    }

    window.addEventListener(
        "resize",
        function () {
            if (
                window.innerWidth <= 880 &&
                collapsed
            ) {
                collapsed = false;
            }

            applySidebarState();
        }
    );

    console.log(
        "[LIFE HRMS 360] Sidebar " +
        "shortcuts and icon rail loaded"
    );
}());
</script>

 cursor:pointer
}
.hrms-select-wrap.is-disabled
.hrms-select-input{
 background:#f2efe8!important;
 color:#7b877f!important;
 cursor:not-allowed
}
#hrms-select-menu{
 position:fixed;
 z-index:11000;
 display:none;
 max-height:280px;

 border-radius:9px;
 background:#fff;
 box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(6,35,22,.24)
}
#hrms-select-menu.open{
 display:block
}
.hrms-select-option{
 display:block;
 width:100%;
 padding:9px 10px;
 border:0;
 border-radius:6px;
 background:#fff;
 color:var(--ink,#12211a);
 font:inherit;

 white-space:normal;
 cursor:pointer
}
.hrms-select-option:hover,
.hrms-select-option.keyboard{
 background:var(--mint,#e9f5ed);
 color:var(--green-d,#06331f)
}

 font-weight:800
}

  max-height:230px
 }

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";

var activeSelect=null;
var activeInput=null;
var keyboardIndex=-1;
var scheduled=false;

var menu=document.getElementById(
 "hrms-select-menu"
);

if(!menu){
 menu=document.createElement("div");
 menu.id="hrms-select-menu";

 menu.setAttribute(
  "role",
  "listbox"
 );

 document.body.appendChild(menu);
}

function escapeHtml(value){
 return String(
  value==null
   ?""
   :value
 )
 .replace(/&/g,"&")
 .replace(/</g,"<")
 .replace(/>/g,">")
 .replace(/\"/g,""")
 .replace(/'/g,"'");
}

function optionText(option){
 return String(
  option
   ?(
    option.textContent
    ||option.innerText
    ||""
   )
   :""
 ).trim();
}

function selectedText(select){
 return optionText(
  select.options[
   select.selectedIndex
  ]
 );
}

function positionMenu(){
 if(
  !activeInput
  ||!menu.classList.contains("open")
 ){
  return;
 }

 var rect=
  activeInput.getBoundingClientRect();

 var height=Math.min(
  280,
  menu.scrollHeight||280
 );

 var top=rect.bottom+4;

 if(
  window.innerHeight-rect.bottom
   <Math.min(160,height)
  &&rect.top>height
 ){
  top=Math.max(
   8,
   rect.top-height-4
  );
 }

 menu.style.left=
  Math.max(8,rect.left)+"px";

 menu.style.top=
  top+"px";

 menu.style.width=
  Math.max(200,rect.width)+"px";

 menu.style.maxWidth=
  Math.max(
   200,
   window.innerWidth
    -Math.max(8,rect.left)
    -8
  )+"px";
}

function closeMenu(restore){
 if(
  restore
  &&activeSelect
  &&activeInput
 ){
  activeInput.value=
   selectedText(activeSelect);
 }

 if(activeInput){
  activeInput.setAttribute(
   "aria-expanded",
   "false"
  );
 }

 menu.classList.remove("open");
 menu.innerHTML="";

 activeSelect=null;
 activeInput=null;
 keyboardIndex=-1;
}

function selectOption(index){
 if(
  !activeSelect
  ||index<0
  ||index>=activeSelect.options.length
 ){
  return;
 }

 var select=activeSelect;
 var input=activeInput;
 var option=select.options[index];

 if(option.disabled){
  return;
 }

 select.selectedIndex=index;
 input.value=optionText(option);

 closeMenu(false);

 select.dispatchEvent(
  new Event(
   "input",
   {bubbles:true}
  )
 );

 select.dispatchEvent(
  new Event(
   "change",
   {bubbles:true}
  )
 );
}

function renderOptions(query){
 if(!activeSelect){
  return;
 }

 var needle=String(
  query||""
 )
 .trim()
 .toLowerCase();

 var rows=[];

 Array.prototype.forEach.call(
  activeSelect.options,
  function(option,index){
   var text=optionText(option);

   var value=String(
    option.value||""
   );

   if(
    !needle
    ||text.toLowerCase()
      .indexOf(needle)!==-1
    ||value.toLowerCase()
      .indexOf(needle)!==-1
   ){
    rows.push({
     option:option,
     index:index,
     text:text
    });
   }
  }
 );

 keyboardIndex=
  rows.length?0:-1;

 if(!rows.length){
  menu.innerHTML=
   '<div class="hrms-select-empty">'+
   'MISSING: No matching option'+
   '</div>';
 }else{
  menu.innerHTML=rows.map(
   function(row,position){
    var classes=
     "hrms-select-option";

    if(position===keyboardIndex){
     classes+=" keyboard";
    }

    if(
     row.index===
     activeSelect.selectedIndex
    ){
     classes+=" selected";
    }

    return(
     '<button type="button" '+
      'class="'+classes+'" '+
      'data-index="'+row.index+'"'+
      (
       row.option.disabled
        ?" disabled"
        :""
      )+
     '>'+
      escapeHtml(
       row.text||"MISSING"
      )+
     '</button>'
    );
   }
  ).join("");
 }

 menu.classList.add("open");

 activeInput.setAttribute(
  "aria-expanded",
  "true"
 );

 positionMenu();
}

function openMenu(
 select,
 input,
 searching
){
 if(select.disabled){
  return;
 }

 if(
  activeSelect
  &&activeSelect!==select
 ){
  closeMenu(true);
 }

 activeSelect=select;
 activeInput=input;

 if(!searching){
  input.value="";
 }

 renderOptions(input.value);
}

function syncSelect(select){
 var wrapper=
  select.nextElementSibling;

 if(
  !wrapper
  ||!wrapper.classList.contains(
   "hrms-select-wrap"
  )
 ){
  return;
 }

 var input=
  wrapper.querySelector(
   ".hrms-select-input"
  );

 if(!input){
  return;
 }

 wrapper.classList.toggle(
  "is-disabled",
  !!select.disabled
 );

 input.disabled=
  !!select.disabled;

 if(activeSelect!==select){
  input.value=
   selectedText(select);
 }
}

function enhanceSelect(select){
 if(
  !select
  ||select.multiple
  ||Number(select.size||0)>1
 ){
  return;
 }

 if(
  select.dataset.hrmsCustomSearch
  ==="1"
 ){
  syncSelect(select);
  return;
 }

 var width=
  select.getBoundingClientRect().width;

 var wrapper=
  document.createElement("span");

 var input=
  document.createElement("input");

 var arrow=
  document.createElement("button");

 wrapper.className=
  "hrms-select-wrap";

 if(width>0){
  wrapper.style.width=
   Math.round(width)+"px";
 }

 input.type="text";

 input.className=
  "hrms-select-input";

 input.autocomplete="off";
 input.spellcheck=false;

 input.placeholder=
  "Search and select";

 input.value=
  selectedText(select);

 input.setAttribute(
  "role",
  "combobox"
 );

 input.setAttribute(
  "aria-autocomplete",
  "list"
 );

 input.setAttribute(
  "aria-expanded",
  "false"
 );

 arrow.type="button";

 arrow.className=
  "hrms-select-arrow";

 arrow.textContent="▼";

 arrow.setAttribute(
  "aria-label",
  "Show options"
 );

 wrapper.appendChild(input);
 wrapper.appendChild(arrow);

 select.insertAdjacentElement(
  "afterend",
  wrapper
 );

 select.classList.add(
  "hrms-native-select"
 );

 select.dataset.hrmsCustomSearch="1";

 input.addEventListener(
  "focus",
  function(){
   openMenu(
    select,
    input,
    false
   );
  }
 );

 input.addEventListener(
  "input",
  function(){
   openMenu(
    select,
    input,
    true
   );
  }
 );

 input.addEventListener(
  "keydown",
  function(event){
   var options=
    menu.querySelectorAll(
     ".hrms-select-option"+
     ":not(:disabled)"
    );

   if(
    event.key==="ArrowDown"
    ||event.key==="ArrowUp"
   ){
    event.preventDefault();

    if(
     !menu.classList.contains("open")
    ){
     openMenu(
      select,
      input,
      false
     );

     options=
      menu.querySelectorAll(
       ".hrms-select-option"+
       ":not(:disabled)"
      );
    }

    if(!options.length){
     return;
    }

    keyboardIndex+=
     event.key==="ArrowDown"
      ?1
      :-1;

    keyboardIndex=
     (
      keyboardIndex+
      options.length
     )%options.length;

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
     options,
     function(node,index){
      node.classList.toggle(
       "keyboard",
       index===keyboardIndex
      );
     }
    );

    options[
     keyboardIndex
    ].scrollIntoView({
     block:"nearest"
    });
   }else if(
    event.key==="Enter"
    &&menu.classList.contains("open")
   ){
    event.preventDefault();

    if(options.length){
     selectOption(
      Number(
       options[
        Math.max(
         0,
         keyboardIndex
        )
       ].getAttribute(
        "data-index"
       )
      )
     );
    }
   }else if(
    event.key==="Escape"
   ){
    closeMenu(true);
   }
  }
 );

 arrow.addEventListener(
  "click",
  function(event){
   event.preventDefault();
   event.stopPropagation();

   if(
    menu.classList.contains("open")
    &&activeSelect===select
   ){
    closeMenu(true);
   }else{
    input.focus();
   }
  }
 );

 select.addEventListener(
  "change",
  function(){
   window.setTimeout(
    function(){
     syncSelect(select);
    },
    0
   );
  }
 );

 syncSelect(select);
}

function enhanceAll(){
 scheduled=false;

 Array.prototype.forEach.call(
  document.querySelectorAll(
   "select"
  ),
  enhanceSelect
 );
}

function scheduleEnhance(){
 if(scheduled){
  return;
 }

 scheduled=true;

 window.requestAnimationFrame(
  enhanceAll
 );
}

menu.addEventListener(
 "mousedown",
 function(event){
  var button=
   event.target.closest(
    ".hrms-select-option"
   );

  if(
   !button
   ||button.disabled
  ){
   return;
  }

  event.preventDefault();

  selectOption(
   Number(
    button.getAttribute(
     "data-index"
    )
   )
  );
 }
);

document.addEventListener(
 "mousedown",
 function(event){
  if(
   !menu.contains(event.target)
   &&!event.target.closest(
    ".hrms-select-wrap"
   )
  ){
   closeMenu(true);
  }
 }
);

window.addEventListener(
 "resize",
 positionMenu
);

document.addEventListener(
 "scroll",
 positionMenu,
 true
);

new MutationObserver(
 scheduleEnhance
).observe(
 document.body,
 {
  childList:true,
  subtree:true
 }
);

enhanceAll();

window.hrmsRefreshSearchableSelects=
 enhanceAll;

console.log(
 "[LIFE HRMS 360] "+
 "Clean searchable selects loaded"
);
}());
</script>

<script id="life-hrms-live-job-opening">
(function(){
"use strict";

function hasValue(value){
 return(
  value!==undefined
  &&value!==null
  &&String(value).trim()!==""
  &&String(value)
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase()!=="MISSING"
 );
}

function branchValue(){
 if(typeof brName==="function"){
  return String(
   brName(POST.branch)||""
  ).trim();
 }

 return String(
  POST.branch||""
 ).trim();
}

function liveCompany(branch){
 var employees=
  Array.isArray(window.EMPLOYEES)
   ?window.EMPLOYEES
   :[];

 var fallback="";

 for(
  var index=0;
  index<employees.length;
  index+=1
 ){
  var employee=
   employees[index]||{};

  var company=
   employee.company||"";

  var employeeBranch=
   employee.branchName
   ||employee.branch
   ||"";

  if(
   hasValue(company)
   &&!fallback
  ){
   fallback=String(company).trim();
  }

  if(
   hasValue(company)
   &&String(employeeBranch).trim()
     ===branch
  ){
   return String(company).trim();
  }
 }

 return fallback;
}

function setButtonBusy(
 button,
 busy
){
 if(!button){
  return;
 }

 if(busy){
  button.dataset.liveLabel=
   button.innerHTML;

  button.disabled=true;

  button.innerHTML=
   "Saving in ERPNext…";
 }else{
  button.disabled=false;

  button.innerHTML=
   button.dataset.liveLabel
   ||"📣 Publish & get apply link";
 }
}

if(
 typeof TAB_STATUS==="object"
 &&TAB_STATUS.post
){
 TAB_STATUS.post.status="live";

 TAB_STATUS.post.text=
  "Job Opening creation and publishing "+
  "are connected to ERPNext.";
}

applyLink=function(){
 return(
  "MISSING: Publish to generate "+
  "the live ERP apply link"
 );
};

copyLink=function(){
 toast(
  "Publish the Job Opening first "+
  "to receive its live ERP link.",
  "wn"
 );
};

publishPost=function(){
 if(
  typeof window.hrmsLiveRequest
  !=="function"
 ){
  toast(
   "MISSING: Live ERP request "+
   "function is unavailable.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 var branch=
  branchValue();

 var company=
  liveCompany(branch);

 var button=
  document.querySelector(
   '[onclick="publishPost()"]'
  );

 if(!hasValue(company)){
  toast(
   "MISSING: No live Company value "+
   "is available for this branch.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 if(
  !hasValue(POST.desig)
  ||!hasValue(branch)
  ||!hasValue(POST.deadline)
 ){
  toast(
   "Designation, Branch and "+
   "Apply-before date are mandatory.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 if(Number(POST.vac||0)<=0){
  toast(
   "Vacancies must be greater "+
   "than zero.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 setButtonBusy(
  button,
  true
 );

 window.hrmsLiveRequest(
  "manage_recruitment",
  {
   operation:
    "create_job_opening",
   designation:
    POST.desig,
   department:
    POST.dept||"",
   company:
    company,
   location:
    branch,
   employment_type:
    POST.type||"",
   closes_on:
    POST.deadline,
   vacancies:
    POST.vac,
   priority:
    POST.prio||"MISSING",
   grade:
    POST.grade||"MISSING",
   experience_min:
    POST.expMin,
   experience_max:
    POST.expMax,
   education:
    POST.edu||"MISSING",
   skills:
    POST.skills||"MISSING",
   responsibilities:
    POST.kra||"MISSING",
   selection_rounds:
    POST.rounds||"MISSING",
   hiring_manager:
    POST.hm||"MISSING",
   contact_phone:
    POST.hmph||"MISSING",
   contact_email:
    POST.hmml||"MISSING",
   lower_range:
    POST.ctcMin||0,
   upper_range:
    POST.ctcMax||0
  }
 )
 .then(function(result){
  var route=
   hasValue(result.apply_link)
    ?result.apply_link
    :"MISSING";

  var fullLink=
   route==="MISSING"
    ?"MISSING"
    :window.location.origin+
      (
       route.charAt(0)==="/"
        ?route
        :"/"+route
      );

  openModal(
   "✅ Job Opening Created",
   esc(
    result.job_opening
    ||"MISSING"
   )
   +" · "+
   esc(
    result.job_title
    ||POST.desig
   ),
   '<div class="note n-g">'+
    '<b>Saved in ERPNext</b>'+
    'This vacancy is a live Job Opening record. '+
    'No browser record was created.'+
   '</div>'+
   '<div class="dgrid">'+
    df(
     "Job Opening",
     esc(
      result.job_opening
      ||"MISSING"
     )
    )+
    df(
     "Status",
     esc(
      result.status
      ||"MISSING"
     )
    )+
    df(
     "Branch",
     esc(branch)
    )+
    df(
     "Company",
     esc(company)
    )+
   '</div>'+
   '<div class="fg" style="margin-top:11px">'+
    '<label>Live apply link</label>'+
    '<input readonly value="'+
     esc(fullLink)+
    '" onclick="this.select()">'+
   '</div>',
   '<button class="btn" '+
    'onclick="closeModal()">'+
    'Close'+
   '</button>'+
   '<a class="btn p" href="/app/job-opening/'+
    encodeURIComponent(
     result.job_opening||""
    )+
    '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'+
    'Open ERP record →'+
   '</a>'+
   '<button class="btn g" '+
    'onclick="window.location.reload()">'+
    'Refresh live data'+
   '</button>'
  );
 })
 .catch(function(error){
  toast(
   error&&error.message
    ?error.message
    :"ERP Job Opening creation failed.",
   "err"
  );
 })
 .finally(function(){
  setButtonBusy(
   button,
   false
  );
 });
};

console.log(
 "[LIFE HRMS 360] "+
 "Live Job Opening creation loaded"
);
}());
</script>

<script id="life-hrms-recruitment-workflow-ui">
(function(){
"use strict";

function recruitmentData(){
 return (
  window.LIFE_HRMS_RECRUITMENT
  ||{
   jobOpenings:[],
   jobApplicants:[],
   interviewRounds:[],
   interviews:[],
   interviewFeedback:[],
   jobOffers:[]
  }
 );
}

function valueOf(id){
 var field=document.getElementById(id);

 return field
  ?String(field.value||"").trim()
  :"";
}

function optionHtml(
 value,
 label
){
 return(
  '<option value="'+
  esc(value)+
  '">'+
  esc(label)+
  '</option>'
 );
}

function openJobOpenings(){
 return recruitmentData()
  .jobOpenings
  .filter(function(row){
   return row.status==="Open";
  });
}

function applicantByName(name){
 var applicants=
  recruitmentData().jobApplicants;

 for(
  var index=0;
  index<applicants.length;
  index+=1
 ){
  if(applicants[index].name===name){
   return applicants[index];
  }
 }

 return null;
}

function openingByName(name){
 var openings=
  recruitmentData().jobOpenings;

 for(
  var index=0;
  index<openings.length;
  index+=1
 ){
  if(openings[index].name===name){
   return openings[index];
  }
 }

 return null;
}

function roundsForApplicant(
 applicant
){
 var rounds=
  recruitmentData().interviewRounds;

 if(!applicant){
  return [];
 }

 return rounds.filter(
  function(round){
   return(
    !round.designation
    ||!applicant.designation
    ||round.designation===
      applicant.designation
   );
  }
 );
}

function reloadRecruitment(){
 window.location.href=
  window.location.pathname+
  "?recruitment_refresh="+
  Date.now();
}

function showLiveError(error){
 toast(
  error&&error.message
   ?error.message
   :"Live Recruitment action failed.",
  "err"
 );
}

window.openLiveApplicantForm=
function(){
 var openings=openJobOpenings();

 var openingOptions=
  '<option value="">'+
  'Select live Job Opening'+
  '</option>';

 if(openings.length){
  openingOptions+=openings.map(
   function(row){
    return optionHtml(
     row.name,
     (
      row.job_title
      ||row.designation
      ||row.name
     )+
     " · "+
     row.name
    );
   }
  ).join("");
 }else{
  openingOptions=
   '<option value="">'+
   'MISSING: No Open Job Openings'+
   '</option>';
 }

 openModal(
  "Create Job Applicant",
  "Live ERPNext Job Applicant",
  '<div class="note n-i">'+
   '<b>Live ERP record</b>'+
   'The applicant will be saved directly '+
   'in ERPNext. No browser record is created.'+
  '</div>'+
  '<div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:12px">'+
   '<div class="fg">'+
    '<label>Applicant Name '+
     '<span class="rq">*</span></label>'+
    '<input id="live-app-name" '+
     'autocomplete="off">'+
   '</div>'+
   '<div class="fg">'+
    '<label>Email Address '+
     '<span class="rq">*</span></label>'+
    '<input type="email" id="live-app-email" '+
     'autocomplete="off">'+
   '</div>'+
   '<div class="fg">'+
    '<label>Phone Number '+
     '<span class="rq">*</span></label>'+
    '<input id="live-app-phone" '+
     'inputmode="numeric" maxlength="10" '+
     'autocomplete="off">'+
   '</div>'+
   '<div class="fg">'+
    '<label>Job Opening</label>'+
    '<select id="live-app-opening">'+
     openingOptions+
    '</select>'+
   '</div>'+
  '</div>',
  '<button class="btn" '+
   'onclick="closeModal()">Cancel</button>'+
  '<button class="btn p" '+
   'onclick="saveLiveApplicant()">'+
   'Save in ERPNext</button>'
 );
};

window.saveLiveApplicant=
function(){
 var applicantName=
  valueOf("live-app-name");

 var email=
  valueOf("live-app-email");

 var phone=
  valueOf("live-app-phone");

 var opening=
  valueOf("live-app-opening");

 if(
  !applicantName
  ||!email
  ||!phone
 ){
  toast(
   "Applicant Name, Email and Phone "+
   "Number are mandatory.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 if(!/^\d{10}$/.test(phone)){
  toast(
   "Phone Number must contain "+
   "exactly 10 digits.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 window.hrmsLiveRequest(
  "manage_recruitment_workflow",
  {
   operation:"create_job_applicant",
   applicant_name:applicantName,
   email_id:email,
   phone_number:phone,
   job_opening:opening
  }
 )
 .then(function(result){
  toast(
   "Job Applicant saved: "+
   (
    result.job_applicant
    ||"MISSING"
   ),
   "ok"
  );

  reloadRecruitment();
 })
 .catch(showLiveError);
};

window.openLiveInterview=
function(encodedApplicant){
 var applicantName=
  decodeURIComponent(
   encodedApplicant
  );

 var applicant=
  applicantByName(
   applicantName
  );

 if(!applicant){
  toast(
   "MISSING: Live Job Applicant "+
   "could not be found.",
   "err"
  );
  return;
 }

 var rounds=
  roundsForApplicant(
   applicant
  );

 if(!rounds.length){
  openModal(
   "Interview Round MISSING",
   esc(
    applicant.applicant_name
    ||applicant.name
   ),
   '<div class="note n-c">'+

<script id="life-hrms-communication-task-ui">

  }

function liveFieldValue(id){
 var field=
  document.getElementById(id);

 return field
  ?String(field.value||"").trim()
  :"";
}

function cleanContent(value){
 var holder=
  document.createElement("div");

 holder.innerHTML=
  String(value||"");

 return String(
  holder.textContent
  ||holder.innerText
  ||""
 ).trim();
}

function reloadCommunication(){
 window.location.href=
  window.location.pathname+
  "?communication_refresh="+
  Date.now();
}

function showTaskError(error){
 toast(
  error&&error.message
   ?error.message
   :"Live HR task action failed.",
  "err"
 );
}

function taskUserOptions(){
 var rows=[];
 var seen={};

 EMPLOYEES.forEach(
  function(employee){
   var source=
    employee.liveSource||{};

   var userId=
    String(
     source.user_id||""
    ).trim();

   if(
    !userId
    ||seen[userId]
    ||employee.status!=="Active"
   ){
    return;
   }

   seen[userId]=true;

   rows.push({
    user:userId,
    employee:
     employee.name
     ||employee.id
   });
  }
 );

 rows.sort(function(a,b){
  return a.employee.localeCompare(
   b.employee
  );
 });

 if(!rows.length){
  return(
   '<option value="">'+
   'MISSING: No active Employee users'+
   '</option>'
  );
 }

 return(
  '<option value="">Select user</option>'+
  rows.map(function(row){
   return(
    '<option value="'+
     esc(row.user)+
    '">'+
     esc(row.employee)+
     " · "+
     esc(row.user)+
    '</option>'
   );
  }).join("")
 );
}
