       ||record.status
       ||"MISSING",
       record.delivery_status==="Sent"
        ?"t-g"
        :"t-n"
      )+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      (
       record.communication_date
        ?fmtD(record.communication_date)
        :"MISSING"
      )+
     '</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }
 );

 if(!rows){
  rows=emptyRow(
   8,
   "MISSING: No live HR Communications",
   "No communication records are available."
  );
 }

 return acc(
  "📣 Live HR Communications",
  communications.length+" records",
  tw(
   '<table class="tb stick">'+
    '<thead><tr>'+
     '<th>Communication</th>'+
     '<th>Subject / Medium</th>'+
     '<th>Direction</th>'+
     '<th>Sender</th>'+
     '<th>Recipients</th>'+
     '<th>Reference</th>'+
     '<th>Status</th>'+
     '<th>Date</th>'+
    '</tr></thead>'+
    '<tbody>'+
     rows+
    '</tbody>'+
   '</table>'
  ),
  {
   key:"live-communications",
   flush:true,
   ic:"📣",
   icCls:"gold"
  }
 );
}

function renderLiveNotifications(data){
 var notifications=
  data.notifications||[];

 var rows="";

 notifications.forEach(
  function(record){
   rows+=
    '<tr>'+
     '<td class="mono">'+
      esc(record.name)+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      '<div class="nm">'+
       esc(
        record.subject
        ||"MISSING"
       )+
      '</div>'+
      '<div class="sm2">'+
       esc(
        cleanContent(
         record.email_content
        )
        ||"MISSING"
       )+
      '</div>'+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      esc(
       record.type
       ||"MISSING"
      )+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      esc(
       record.from_user
       ||"MISSING"
      )+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      esc(
       record.document_type
       ||"MISSING"
      )+
      '<div class="sm2">'+
       esc(
        record.document_name
        ||"MISSING"
       )+
      '</div>'+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      (
       Number(record.read||0)
        ?tag("Read","t-g")
        :tag("Unread","t-y")
      )+
     '</td>'+
     '<td>'+
      (
       record.creation
        ?fmtD(record.creation)
        :"MISSING"
      )+
     '</td>'+
    '</tr>';
  }
 );

 if(!rows){
  rows=emptyRow(
   7,
   "MISSING: No Notifications",
   "No Notification Log records "+
   "exist for the logged-in user."
  );
 }

 return acc(
  "🔔 My Notifications",
  notifications.length+" records",
  tw(
   '<table class="tb stick">'+
    '<thead><tr>'+
     '<th>Notification</th>'+
     '<th>Subject / Message</th>'+
     '<th>Type</th>'+
     '<th>From</th>'+
     '<th>Document</th>'+
     '<th>Status</th>'+
     '<th>Date</th>'+
    '</tr></thead>'+
    '<tbody>'+
     rows+
    '</tbody>'+
   '</table>'
  ),
  {
   key:"live-notifications",
   flush:true,
   ic:"🔔",
   icCls:"amber"
  }
 );
}

window.rComms=function(){
 var data=
  liveCommunicationData();

 var tab=
  window.HRMS_COMM_TAB;

 var headerAction=
  data.allowed
   ?'<button class="btn p" '+
     'onclick="openLiveTaskForm()">'+
     '＋ New HR Task</button>'
   :"";

 var html=ph(
  "HR COMMUNICATION · LIVE",
  "Communication, Notifications & Tasks",
  "Live ERPNext records with "+
  "permission-aware task actions.",
  headerAction
 );

 html+=
  '<div class="tabs" '+
   'style="margin-bottom:13px">'+
   '<button class="'+
    (
     tab==="tasks"
      ?"active"
      :""
    )+
    '" onclick="'+
     "setLiveCommunicationTab('tasks')"+
    '">HR Tasks ('+
     data.tasks.length+
    ')</button>'+
   '<button class="'+
    (
     tab==="communications"
      ?"active"
      :""
    )+
    '" onclick="'+
     "setLiveCommunicationTab('communications')"+
    '">Communications ('+
     data.communications.length+
    ')</button>'+
   '<button class="'+
    (
     tab==="notifications"
      ?"active"
      :""
    )+
    '" onclick="'+
     "setLiveCommunicationTab('notifications')"+
    '">My Notifications ('+
     data.notifications.length+
    ')</button>'+
  '</div>';

 if(tab==="communications"){
  html+=renderLiveCommunications(
   data
  );
 }else if(tab==="notifications"){
  html+=renderLiveNotifications(
   data
  );
 }else{
  html+=renderLiveTasks(
   data
  );
 }

 return html;
};

if(typeof RENDERS==="object"){
 RENDERS.comms=window.rComms;
 RENDERS.communication=window.rComms;
}

console.log(
 "[LIFE HRMS 360] "+
 "Live Communication and HR Task UI loaded"
);
}());
</script>
